heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 只要给了敌法师积累力量的机会，他的碾压将无法阻挡。进，他会枯竭敌人的魔力，退，他可短距离传送。想将他逼入困境绝非易事。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Should Anti-Mage have the opportunity to gather his full strength, few can stop his assaults. Draining mana from enemies with every strike or teleporting short distances to escape an ambush, cornering him is a challenge for any foe.

abilities.name: antimage_mana_break
abilities.description_zh: 每次攻击损毁目标魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
notes_zh: 幻象继承法力损毁的燃烧魔法为%illusion_percentage%%%。
notes_en: Mana Break has %illusion_percentage%%% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升每次攻击燃烧的最大魔法值。

abilities.name: antimage_blink
abilities.description_zh: 短距离传送，能让敌法师自由出入战场。
abilities.description_en: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
notes_zh: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
notes_en: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

scepter_loc.en: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within %empowered_mana_break_duration%s burns an additional %empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.
scepter_loc.zh: 施放闪烁后，%empowered_mana_break_duration%秒内的法力损毁将额外燃烧%empowered_max_burn_pct_tooltip%%%最大魔法值，并且阻止目标在短时间内恢复或获得魔法。这个负面状态无法驱散。

abilities.name: antimage_counterspell
abilities.description_zh: 被动提升魔法抗性。可以主动开启法术反制，创造一个环绕敌法师的反魔法外壳，抵挡和反弹所有指向性技能。
abilities.description_en: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动魔法抗性失效。
notes_en: Break disables the passive magic resistance.

shard_loc.en: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.
shard_loc.zh: 开启后反弹指向性技能时会在敌方施法者身边制造一个敌法师的闪烁碎片。

facet_text_en: Counterspell burns a percentage of the countered spell's mana cost from its caster and does damage based on %damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%% of the burned mana cost, up to a maximum of %max_damage_from_mana_drain% damage per reflected spell.
facet_text_zh: 法术反制会使施法者被燃烧该技能魔法消耗的一定百分比，并且造成%damage_from_mana_drain_percent%%%燃烧魔法的伤害，最高为每次反弹技能造成%max_damage_from_mana_drain%点伤害。

abilities.name: antimage_persectur
abilities.description_zh: 攻击会根据敌人缺失的魔法值造成减速。%mana_threshold%%%魔法时造成最低减速，0%%魔法时造成最高减速。敌人高于%mana_threshold%%%魔法时没有效果。
abilities.description_en: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.
notes_zh: 幻象造成全额效果。
notes_en: Full effect if caused by illusions.

abilities.name: antimage_mana_void
abilities.description_zh: 根据目标损失的魔法值，对目标和其周围的敌人造成伤害。所有受到伤害的单位都会被短暂眩晕。
abilities.description_en: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
notes_zh: 伤害的计算根据主目标失去的魔法，但是对作用范围内所有敌人均有效。
notes_en: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.
facet_text_en:
Passively grants attack damage when an enemy hero's mana falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their mana falls further.

If the enemies mana falls below %threshold_pct%%% Anti-Mage gains the maximum amount of damage, as well as vision and True Sight of that hero. Applies to enemy heroes within %thirst_range% range. Bonuses stack per hero.
facet_text_zh:
敌方英雄的魔法值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%时会被动提供攻击力，而且魔法值越低，提升效果越大。

如果敌人的魔法值低于%threshold_pct%%%，敌法师获得攻击力加成的最大值，以及该英雄的视野和真实视域。会施加给%thirst_range%范围内的敌方英雄。每个英雄提供的加成效果可以叠加。

Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at %mana_threshold%%% mana, up to max slow at 0%% mana. No effect if enemy is above %mana_threshold%%% mana.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 一个接着一个，斧王将他的敌人斩落。作为团队的先锋，他使敌人陷入战斗，致命的旋斧会对他们的攻击作出回应。一旦敌人出现衰迹，他将挥舞着淘汰之刃挺身而出。
heroes.hero_summary_en: One after another, Axe cuts down his foes. Marching ahead of his team, he locks his enemies in battle then counters their blows with a deadly spin of his weapon. Slamming his culling blade through a weakened enemy, he is always charging onward.

abilities.name: axe_berserkers_call
abilities.description_zh: 斧王嘲讽附近的敌方单位，强迫他们攻击自己，同时获得额外护甲。
abilities.description_en: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.

shard_loc.en: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.
shard_loc.zh: 狂战士之吼会对作用下单位施加战斗饥渴。

facet_text_en: Berserker's Call gives Axe increased bonus armor and increases the attack speed of the affected units.
facet_text_zh: 狂战士之吼提供的护甲更高，而且增加了受作用单位的攻击速度。

abilities.name: axe_battle_hunger
abilities.description_zh: 激怒一个敌方单位，使他受到持续伤害，直到他杀死一个单位或者持续时间结束。敌人只要背朝斧王还将被减速。
abilities.description_en: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
notes_zh: 摧毁建筑也能移除该状态效果。
notes_en: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.

shard_loc.en: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.
shard_loc.zh: 多个战斗饥渴效果可以叠加在单个目标身上。

abilities.name: axe_counter_helix
abilities.description_zh: 受到一定次数攻击后，斧王就会做出螺旋反击，对附近所有敌方单位造成纯粹伤害。
abilities.description_en: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 反击螺旋会在斧王受到攻击时触发。
拥有神杖后自身幻象的攻击不会计入触发计数。
notes_en: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.

scepter_loc.en: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 反击螺旋现在对击中的敌人施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使其对斧王造成的攻击伤害减少。反击螺旋不再具有冷却时间，并且斧王的攻击也会计入触发记数。

abilities.name: axe_culling_blade
abilities.description_zh:
斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。

每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。
abilities.description_en:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
notes_zh: 淘汰之刃的斩杀效果无法被薄葬等技能阻止。
notes_en: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

abilities.name: axe_one_man_army
abilities.description_zh: 只要斧王附近%radius%范围内没有友方英雄，他就会获得%armor_pct_as_strength%%%自身护甲值的力量加成。这个效果在接近一名友军后会在%bonus_linger_duration%秒内消失。
abilities.description_en: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_culling_blade_speed_duration
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_speed_duration}s Culling Blade Kill Buff Bonus Duration

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_axe_8
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_speed_bonus}% Movement Speed per active Battle Hunger

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 祸乱之源掌中的控制技能让敌人们望而生畏。无论是困住敌人的传染性噩梦，还是让敌人动弹不得的魔爪，他总是能为盟友争取到歼灭敌人的时间。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Bane brings terror to his enemies with his arsenal of disabling abilities. Whether trapping a foe within a contagious nightmare, or gripping an enemy in place, he gives allies all the time they need to slay their enemy.

abilities.name: bane_enfeeble
abilities.description_zh: 每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。
abilities.description_en: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.

abilities.name: bane_brain_sap
abilities.description_zh: 暴食一个敌方单位的生命能量，造成伤害并回复自身生命值。
abilities.description_en: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%. Causes Brain Sap to become a %shard_radius% AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for %shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成%shard_radius%作用范围的技能。次级目标只有%shard_secondary_target_heal_pct%%%治疗效果。

abilities.name: bane_nightmare
abilities.description_zh: 让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
abilities.description_en: Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely. Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
notes_zh: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。
notes_en: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.
facet_text_en: Bane has increased attack speed when attacking Nightmared units.
Nightmared units walk in Bane's chosen direction.
facet_text_zh: 祸乱之源在攻击噩梦中单位时获得额外的攻击速度。
噩梦中单位会朝选定方向走去。

abilities.name: bane_fiends_grip
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 抓住一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并持续受到大量伤害，同时每%fiend_grip_tick_interval%秒按目标最大魔法值一定比例吸取魔法。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take %scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.
scepter_loc.zh: 魔爪的冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受%scepter_incoming_illusion_damage%%%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

abilities.name: bane_ichor_of_nyctasha
abilities.description_zh: 每次祸乱之源击杀敌方英雄，或者他们在祸乱之源的负面效果下阵亡，他们都会在游戏的剩余时间内获得一层恐惧的效果，使敌人对祸乱之源施加的负面状态的状态抗性减少。
abilities.description_en: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.
Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every %fiend_grip_tick_interval% seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 血魔可以使他的敌人陷入两难的境地。他用血祀为一片区域洗礼，迫使敌人后撤，而他冷血的大招让敌人要么原地不动，要么倒在血泊之中。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Bloodseeker forces difficult decisions on his enemies. Able to drive his foes to a retreat by bathing a large area with a damaging ritual, his gruesome ultimate asks his opponents to hold still, or die.

abilities.name: bloodseeker_bloodrage
abilities.description_zh: 使血魔陷入渴望鲜血的狂怒中，以每秒流失一定百分比生命的代价获得攻击速度和技能增强加成。
abilities.description_en: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
notes_zh: 对血魔造成的伤害不致死。
notes_en: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.

shard_loc.en: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal %max_health_dmg_pct%%% of the target's max health as Pure damage.
shard_loc.zh: 血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成%max_health_dmg_pct%%%目标最大生命值的纯粹伤害。

abilities.name: bloodseeker_blood_bath
abilities.description_zh: 血魔用圣血为一片区域洗礼。%delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip%秒后祭祀完成，区域范围内所有敌人都会受到伤害，并被沉默。
abilities.description_en: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
notes_zh: 总时间为%delay%秒的施法时间加上%castpoint_tooltip%秒的生效延迟。
notes_en: Total time is a %delay% second delay plus a %abilitycastpoint% second cast time.

abilities.name: bloodseeker_thirst
abilities.description_zh: 血魔能够感知到敌人的伤口中涌出的鲜血，敌方英雄的生命值低于%min_bonus_pct%%%，他的移动速度就会提升，而且生命值越低，提升效果越大。如果生命值低于%invis_threshold_pct%%%，他还将获得该英雄的视野和真实视域。焦渴的效果可以叠加。血魔可以突破最大速度限制。
abilities.description_en: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below %min_bonus_pct%%%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
notes_zh: 幻象不能触发该技能。
移动速度加成在敌人生命值低于%max_bonus_pct%%%时达到上限。
目标死亡后效果延续%linger_duration%秒。
notes_en: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below %max_bonus_pct%%%.
Effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds if a target dies.
facet_text_en: Can be activated to grant bonus movement speed and %sanguivore_multiplier%x Sanguivore heal bonus for a short duration. While on cooldown, passive Thirst move speed is reduced by %inactive_penalty_pct%%% . Cannot be cast when all enemy heroes are at full health.
facet_text_zh: 可以主动开启，短时间内获得移动速度加成和%sanguivore_multiplier%倍食血动物治疗加成。技能冷却时焦渴的被动移速加成减少%inactive_penalty_pct%%%。无法在所有敌方英雄满血时施放。

abilities.name: bloodseeker_sanguivore
abilities.description_zh: 血魔每杀死一个单位都会回复部分生命，回复量为基础%base_heal%点加上该单位最大生命值的一定百分比。友军击杀了附近的敌方英雄时会回复半额数值。
abilities.description_en: Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to %base_heal% health plus a percentage of the units max health.Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
notes_zh: 非英雄单位的吸血效果减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。
notes_en: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%.

abilities.name: bloodseeker_rupture
abilities.description_zh: 让一个敌方单位皮开肉绽，根据其当前生命值造成初始伤害。单位移动后会根据移动的距离受到伤害。
abilities.description_en: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.

scepter_loc.en: Increases initial damage and grants %AbilityCharges% Rupture Charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升初始伤害，并且提供%AbilityCharges%点割裂能量点数。

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After %delay_plus_castpoint_tooltip% seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.

If an enemy hero's health falls below %invis_threshold_pct%%%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 有了水晶室女，盟友的魔法将源源不断，敌人的死亡在她的减速下得到了保障，对于任何团队，她都是有力的帮手。良机出现之时，她还将发动大规模的终极技能给敌人带去毁灭。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Able to keep her allies supplied with mana as she slows down enemies to ensure a kill, Crystal Maiden is a helpful addition to any team. And, when the opportunity arises, she can unleash her massive ultimate ability to devastate her foes.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
abilities.description_zh: 召唤具有破坏性的冰爆，降低目标区域内的敌人的移动速度。
abilities.description_en: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
notes_zh: 冰霜新星在持续时间内提供目标区域的视野。
notes_en: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.
facet_text_en: Crystal Nova has increased radius and grants allied heroes a physical damage barrier. Barrier is increased for Crystal Maiden.
facet_text_zh: 冰霜新星拥有更大的作用范围，并且为友方英雄提供一个物理伤害护盾。水晶室女身上的护盾数值更高。

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_frostbite
abilities.description_zh: 操控冰霜包围一个敌方单位，禁止移动和攻击，并持续造成伤害。对非远古的普通单位施放将造成%creep_multiplier%倍伤害。
abilities.description_en: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals %creep_multiplier%x damage to non-ancient creeps.
notes_zh: 冰封禁制为捆缚效果。
notes_en: Frostbite is considered a root.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_brilliance_aura
abilities.description_zh: 地图上所有友方单位获得额外魔法恢复。水晶室女附近%proximity_bonus_radius%范围内友军获得更高的魔法恢复。水晶室女被动获得魔法恢复增强。
abilities.description_en: Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a %proximity_bonus_radius% radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.
facet_text_en: Activating Arcane Aura temporarily increases Crystal Maiden's spell amplification and mana costs. During the duration, Crystal Maiden restores her own and her allies' Mana when casting spells. Does not affect items. Duration is paused while channeling Freezing Field.
facet_text_zh: 主动开启奥术光环会临时提升水晶室女的技能增强，但技能的魔法消耗也会增加。在持续时间内，只要水晶室女施放技能，她和她的友军都会回复魔法。不会影响物品。极寒领域的持续施法期间持续时间会暂停。

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_crystal_clone
abilities.description_zh: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近%frostbite_radius%范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a %frostbite_radius% AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_glacial_guard
abilities.description_zh: 水晶室女消耗在她技能上的一部分魔法会转化为物理护盾。
abilities.description_en: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

abilities.name: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤%num_explosions%次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
notes_zh: 减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续%slow_duration%秒）。
每%explosion_interval_tooltip%秒产生一次爆炸。
notes_en: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts %slow_duration% second).
Explosions occur every %explosion_interval_tooltip% seconds.

scepter_loc.en: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低%shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%%。冰爆总数提升%shard_bonus_explosion%%%。对极寒领域内停留超过%frostbite_delay%秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mana_multiplier}% Glacial Guard Mana Spent To Barrier

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 一旦卓尔游侠箭所能及，再想逃脱绝非易事。一阵寒风吹过，敌人全部噤声，一阵冰箭射过，敌人无一幸免。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Not many can escape Drow Ranger once she's within range. After her foes have been silenced with a chilling blast, she finishes them off with a barrage of slowing, ice-tipped arrows that few can survive.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。
notes_en: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.

scepter_loc.en: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.
scepter_loc.zh: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。

abilities.name: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
abilities.description_zh: 释放一阵狂风，沉默敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。
abilities.description_en: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_multishot
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
notes_zh: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。
notes_en: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_glacier
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。
abilities.description_en: Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_trueshot
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠根据她自身的当前敏捷和英雄等级获得敏捷加成。附近远程英雄获得%trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%%敏捷加成。
abilities.description_en: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received %trueshot_agi_bonus_allies_pct%%% of the bonus agility.

abilities.name: drow_ranger_marksmanship
abilities.description_zh: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果%disable_range%范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
abilities.description_en: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
notes_zh: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。
notes_en: Marksmanship procs have true strike.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 断绝敌人后路，分割敌人实力，抑或是震撼众敌脚下的大地，撼地者最擅长出其不意的袭击。就算侥幸挺过了余震，一记强大的图腾还在后面等着。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Whether blocking an enemy's escape, dividing their forces, or shattering the ground beneath gathered foes, Earthshaker is at his best when he strikes without warning. Whatever survives the aftershocks still has a swing from his mighty totem to look forward to.

abilities.name: earthshaker_fissure
abilities.description_zh: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
abilities.description_en: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
notes_zh: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。
notes_en: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.

shard_loc.en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.
shard_loc.zh: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

facet_text_en: Enemy heroes stunned by Fissure emit an echo to each nearby unit within a %echoes_radius% radius, dealing damage equal to %echoes_damage_multiplier%%% of Echo Slam's current echo damage.
facet_text_zh: 被沟壑击中的敌方英雄会对%echoes_radius%范围内附近每个单位释放一道回音，造成的伤害等同于回音击的%echoes_damage_multiplier%%%当前回音伤害。

abilities.name: earthshaker_enchant_totem
abilities.description_zh: 强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和%bonus_attack_range%攻击距离加成。
abilities.description_en: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。
notes_en: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.

scepter_loc.en: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.
scepter_loc.zh: 强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。

abilities.name: earthshaker_aftershock
abilities.description_zh: 撼地者施放技能时会引起脚下的大地震动，眩晕附近的敌方单位并造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
notes_zh: 使用物品不会触发余震。
notes_en: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

abilities.name: earthshaker_echo_slam
abilities.description_zh: 穿过地面的冲击波，伤害敌方单位。每个受到攻击的敌人都会引起伤害附近单位的反射波。英雄本体将引起两次反射。
abilities.description_en: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.

abilities.name: earthshaker_slugger
abilities.description_zh: 利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 一阵刀光剑影过后，主宰的敌人就已被他斩落。他以剑刃的旋转切入战斗，在战场上英勇无畏，迅疾非常，敌人基本没有招架的余地，抵挡住主宰就跟从他手中逃脱一样绝非易事。
heroes.hero_summary_en: In a flurry of slashes, Juggernaut cuts down his foes. Sprinting and spinning into battle with reckless abandon, and nearly invincible once he is able to begin his assault, stopping Juggernaut can often be just as difficult as surviving him.

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_fury
abilities.description_zh: 舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得减益免疫状态，魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%，并且每%blade_fury_damage_tick%秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。
abilities.description_en: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
notes_zh: 剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。
主宰在施放剑刃风暴的过程中依然可以进行物理攻击。但是只有不受剑刃风暴伤害的单位，如守卫和建筑才会受到这些物理伤害。
notes_en: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.

scepter_loc.en: Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect. Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升作用范围并减速范围内的敌人。主宰每%attack_interval%秒对作用的敌人发动一次攻击。

abilities.name: juggernaut_healing_ward
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一个治疗守卫，按周围友军单位最大生命值的一定比例治疗他们。治疗守卫可以移动，移动速度为%healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip%。持续%abilityduration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 可以控制治疗守卫。
多个治疗守卫的效果不会叠加。
notes_en: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.

shard_loc.en: Increases ward healing and health.
shard_loc.zh: 提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。

abilities.name: juggernaut_blade_dance
abilities.description_zh: 主宰有一定概率在攻击时触发致命一击。
abilities.description_en: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

abilities.name: juggernaut_swift_slash
abilities.description_zh: 发动一次短时间的无敌斩，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Performs a short Omnislash for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: juggernaut_bladeform
abilities.description_zh: 主宰未受到伤害时每%stack_gain_time%秒获得一层剑心的叠加层数。每层叠加效果提供基础敏捷和移动速度加成。叠加效果在受到任何伤害时会粘滞%linger_duration%秒后再消失。
abilities.description_en: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every %stack_gain_time%s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after %linger_duration%s upon taking any damage.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: juggernaut_omni_slash
abilities.description_zh:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 米拉娜在战场的远处将致命的箭矢瞄准敌人，而她时刻准备着跃入战场。盟友可以在她的祝福下不被敌人探查，保证己方永远都在潜行。
heroes.hero_summary_en: As she takes aim from a distance with her deadly arrow, Mirana must always be ready to leap into battle. Able to shield her allies from the eyes of her enemies, she ensures that her team is always on the prowl.

abilities.name: mirana_starfall
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。%starfall_secondary_radius%范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
abilities.description_en: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
notes_zh: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。
notes_en: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.
facet_text_en: Starstorm's second meteor deals more damage and blinds the target.
facet_text_zh: 群星风暴的第二颗流星会造成更多伤害，并具有致盲效果。

abilities.name: mirana_arrow
abilities.description_zh: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
abilities.description_en: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
notes_zh: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。
notes_en: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.
scepter_loc.zh: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。

abilities.name: mirana_leap
abilities.description_zh: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。速度加成持续%leap_bonus_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.

shard_loc.en: Grants +%additional_charges% Leap charge.
shard_loc.zh: 获得+%additional_charges%跳跃能量点数。

facet_text_en: Upon landing, Leap roots targets in a %root_radius% radius for %root_duration%s.
facet_text_zh: 落地时跳跃会缠绕米拉娜附近%root_radius%范围内的目标，持续%root_duration%秒。

abilities.name: mirana_celestial_quiver
abilities.description_zh: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。
abilities.description_en: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.

shard_loc.en: Grants %quiver_restore% temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.
shard_loc.zh: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得%quiver_restore%点临时能量。

abilities.name: mirana_invis
abilities.description_zh: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入隐身状态。米拉娜在持续时间内获得伤害输出加成。只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入隐身。
abilities.description_en: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位会自动停止攻击敌人。
notes_en: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_mirana_5
talents_raw.desc_loc: Evasion works at all times during the buff

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_mirana_2
talents_raw.desc_loc: The extra arrows are launched in a cone shape, {s:bonus_extra_arrows_angle} degrees to the left and right of the original arrow, and cannot hit the same target.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.

Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 影魔无时不在俘获手下的亡魂，力量也无时不在汇聚。每一次出手，每一记精准的阴影，收下人头的同时也让他释放积聚灵魂产生的夺命冲击更具威力。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Capturing souls from every kill he makes, Shadow Fiend is always gathering his power. Every assault, each carefully aimed raze that kills an enemy, brings him closer to unleashing his gathered souls in a deadly blast of scouring energy.

abilities.name: nevermore_shadowraze1
abilities.description_zh: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。
notes_en: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.

shard_loc.en: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

facet_text_en: Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.
facet_text_zh: 对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

abilities.name: nevermore_frenzy
abilities.description_zh:
影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续%duration%秒。在持续时间内，每%soul_collection_interval%秒他从%soul_collection_radius%范围内的%soul_collection_per_interval%个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留%linger_duration%秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。

从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。
abilities.description_en:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

abilities.name: nevermore_dark_lord
abilities.description_zh: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 与其他降低护甲的技能和光环完全叠加。
notes_en: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.
facet_text_en: Presence of the Dark Lord temporarily reduces more armor after nearby enemy heroes are killed.
facet_text_zh: 在附近敌方英雄阵亡后魔王降临的降低护甲效果将会暂时提升。

abilities.name: nevermore_requiem
abilities.description_zh: 影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。
notes_en: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every %requiem_soul_conversion% soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.
scepter_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

abilities.name: nevermore_necromastery
abilities.description_zh: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得%necromastery_damage_per_soul%点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得%souls_per_hero_kill%个灵魂。影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
notes_zh: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

scepter_loc.en: Increases max souls.
scepter_loc.zh: 提高灵魂数量上限。

facet_text_en: Every hero kill increases max souls by %max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill% until Shadow Fiend dies.
facet_text_zh: 每次击杀英雄会使灵魂上限增加%max_soul_increase_on_hero_kill%个，直到影魔阵亡。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_frenzy_max_collection_count
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_soul_collection_per_hero} Feast of Souls Souls Collected Per Hero

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_6
talents_raw.desc_loc: Max Fear duration increased by +{s:bonus_requiem_slow_duration_max}s

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_frenzy_castspeed
talents_raw.name_loc: Feast of Souls Grants +{s:bonus_cast_speed_pct}% Cast Speed

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_nevermore_raze_procsattacks
talents_raw.desc_loc: Does not apply attack modifiers.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.

Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for %duration% seconds. For the duration of the effect, every %soul_collection_interval%s he collects souls from %soul_collection_per_interval% enemies in a %soul_collection_radius% radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for %linger_duration%s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.
Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.

Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 变体精灵可以转换属性来适应情势，他擅长金蝉脱壳，也能夺人性命。不论是乘着波浪从旁袭击敌人，或者在逃入迷惑性极强的复制体前使自己的生命猛增，他总是不给人击杀的希望。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Shifting his attributes to suit his situation, Morphling can be as elusive as he is deadly. Whether riding a wave to flank an enemy, or boosting his health before escaping into his deceptive replication, few can hope to corner him.

abilities.name: morphling_waveform
abilities.description_zh: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。
abilities.description_en: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.
facet_text_en: Waveform attacks enemies in his path. Does not apply on-hit effects.
facet_text_zh: 波浪形态会攻击路径上的敌人。不会施加攻击特效。

abilities.name: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
abilities.description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
abilities.description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
notes_en: Projectile moves at %projectile_speed% speed.
facet_text_en: Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength.
facet_text_zh: 变体打击会根据变体精灵的力量值造成眩晕。

abilities.name: morphling_morph_agi
abilities.description_zh: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些力量以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成敏捷。该过程可逆。
abilities.description_en: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
notes_zh: 属性变换不能转化物品提供的属性加成。
升级敏捷获取时也会升级力量获取。
notes_en: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.

shard_loc.en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard_loc.zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

abilities.name: morphling_morph_str
abilities.description_zh: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些敏捷以%morph_rate%点/秒的速率转化成力量。该过程可逆。
abilities.description_en: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of %morph_rate%. The process is reversible.
notes_zh: 属性变换不能转换物品提供的属性加成。
升级力量获取时也会升级敏捷获取。
notes_en: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.

shard_loc.en: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.
shard_loc.zh: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

abilities.name: morphling_replicate
abilities.description_zh: 使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标改变自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
abilities.description_en: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
notes_zh: 变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。
notes_en: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.

scepter_loc.en: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.
scepter_loc.zh: 变形增加多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。

abilities.name: morphling_ebb_and_flow
abilities.description_zh: 变体精灵根据当前力量值获得额外施法距离和减速抗性，根据当前敏捷值获得攻击距离和移动速度。这些效果在他变形为其他英雄时仍然有效。
abilities.description_en: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
notes_zh: 变形期间的攻击距离加成只有在变形为远程英雄时有效。
notes_en: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 幻影长矛手操控源源不断的复制体展开攻势，让敌人应接不暇。带领着他的幻象大军，密集的攻击将撕裂敌阵，使对手喘不过气来，还能派出分身向敌方推进，一旦局势不妙就运用神形百变迷惑对手，逃之夭夭。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Phantom Lancer storms enemy forces with an endless supply of clones. Leading his illusory army, he can cut foes apart in a breathtaking flurry of attacks, send clones to push into enemy territory, or use his doppelgangers to mislead and elude foes if cornered.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
abilities.description_zh: 对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
abilities.description_en: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
notes_zh: 幻影长矛手附近%fake_lance_distance%范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
notes_en: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.

scepter_loc.en: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 灵魂之矛可以向范围内敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先。提升灵魂之矛的幻象继承攻击力。

facet_text_en: Spirit Lances from Phantom Lancer's illusions deal %illusion_lance_damage_pct%%% Lance Damage.
facet_text_zh: 幻影长矛手幻象放出的灵魂之矛会造成%illusion_lance_damage_pct%%%长矛伤害。

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
abilities.description_zh:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过%delay%秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受%illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少%illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。
notes_en: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.
facet_text_en: Spawns an additional illusion per %hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%% of health that Phantom Lancer is missing.
facet_text_zh: 幻影长矛手每缺失%hp_missing_per_extra_illusion_pct%%%生命都会额外产生一个幻象。

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
abilities.description_zh: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
abilities.description_en: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
notes_zh: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为%bonus_speed%。
notes_en: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every %illusion_spawn_travel_distance% units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋%illusion_spawn_travel_distance%距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
abilities.description_zh: 幻影长矛手只要制造出幻象，该幻象的继承攻击力不会低于一定值，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
abilities.description_zh: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续%illusion_duration%秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续%illusion_from_illusion_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.

shard_loc.en: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to %invis_duration% seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by %invis_movespeed%%% during this invisibility.
shard_loc.zh: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续%invis_duration%秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升%invis_movespeed%%%。

facet_text_en: Juxtapose Illusions spawn on random nearby units and deal more damage but can't be controlled.
facet_text_zh: 并列的幻象会在附近随机单位身旁产生，继承更高的攻击力，但是无法控制。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_phantom_lancer_illusion_lances
talents_raw.desc_loc: Spirit Lances from illusions hit for a percentage of the normal damage amount

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 帕克脑海中有很多跟敌人开玩笑的恶作剧，它也因此天生就拥有将敌人搅得莫名其妙的本事。它可以传送到伤人的光球身上进行短距离跳跃，挥洒大量粉尘将敌人沉默。还没等敌人开始反应，帕克早已逃之夭夭。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Puck has a talent for confounding its enemies with playfully elusive mischief. By teleporting to its damaging orb in order to hop short distances, it attacks foes with bursts of silencing dust. By the time its enemies can react, Puck has long since escaped.

abilities.name: puck_illusory_orb
abilities.description_zh:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每%damage_interval%秒会在作用范围内额外造成%damage_over_time_pct%%%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。

在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
abilities.description_en:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt. Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
notes_zh: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。
notes_en: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

abilities.name: puck_waning_rift
abilities.description_zh: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。
abilities.description_en: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.
facet_text_en: Waning Rift pushes enemies away. If the ability is in alt-cast state, it will pull them instead.
facet_text_zh: 新月之痕会把敌人推开。如果技能设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），会把他们拉近。

abilities.name: puck_phase_shift
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
notes_zh: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。
notes_en: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.

shard_loc.en: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.
shard_loc.zh: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

abilities.name: puck_puckish
abilities.description_zh: 每当帕克躲避攻击时，它就会分别回复最大生命值和最大魔法值的%mana_and_health_restore_pct%%%。躲避指向性技能的弹道将回复%dodged_spell_multiplier%倍数值。防御塔的攻击不会对此生效。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores %mana_and_health_restore_pct%%% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores %dodged_spell_multiplier%x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

abilities.name: puck_dream_coil
abilities.description_zh: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.

scepter_loc.en: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to %attack_rate_pct%%% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.
scepter_loc.zh: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的%attack_rate_pct%%%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional %damage_over_time_pct%%% of its impact damage every %damage_interval%s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt. Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 帕吉每次精准地甩出标志性的长钩时都将恐惧深深印入敌人心中。他将敌人拉到身边，用屠刀大卸八块，而自己从阵亡的敌人身上获得了额外的力量和攻击力，不遑多时就会成为势不可挡的杀手。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Each carefully aimed throw of Pudge's signature hook strikes fear into his foes. Pulling his enemies near to carve them with his cleavers, he gains additional health and damage with every kill, and soon becomes an unstoppable killer.

abilities.name: pudge_meat_hook
abilities.description_zh: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
abilities.description_en: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
notes_zh: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。
notes_en: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.

shard_loc.en: When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%.
shard_loc.zh: 肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少%cooldown_reduction_pct_allied_hook%%%。

facet_text_en: Meat Hook deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled, but base damage is reduced.
facet_text_zh: 肉钩会根据牵引的距离造成额外伤害，但基础伤害减少。

abilities.name: pudge_rot
abilities.description_zh: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
notes_zh: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。
notes_en: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 腐烂的作用范围提升%bonus_rot_radius%，伤害提升%bonus_rot_damage%点，并且可以降低敌人的%scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%生命回复。

abilities.name: pudge_flesh_heap
abilities.description_zh: 帕吉用一层血肉包裹自己，可以格挡所有来源的所有类型伤害。
abilities.description_en: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.

abilities.name: pudge_innate_graft_flesh
abilities.description_zh: 每次帕吉击杀敌方英雄时，他的皮肤就会永久变厚，获得的每层叠加效果为%flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount%点额外力量。
abilities.description_en: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining %flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount% bonus Strength for each stack.
notes_zh: 帕吉附近%flesh_heap_range%范围内敌方英雄阵亡时他都会获得一层叠加效果，不论击杀者是谁。
notes_en: Enemy Heroes that die within %flesh_heap_range% of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

abilities.name: pudge_dismember
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒%pull_units_per_second%的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引%pull_distance_limit%距离。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.
notes_zh: 即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。
notes_en: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.
facet_text_en: Dismember increases Strength when dealing damage to heroes.
facet_text_zh: 肢解每次对英雄造成伤害时都会提升自身力量值。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_pudge_1
talents_raw.name_loc: {s:bonus_flesh_heap_strength_buff_amount}x Flesh Heap and Meat Shield bonuses

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.

CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.

CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of %pull_units_per_second% units, up to a minimum of %pull_distance_limit% range.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 掌控着致命的闪电风暴，雷泽在战场上横冲直撞。他展开电气的等离子环烧灼敌人，与敌人链接的同时将他们的力量收为己用。
heroes.hero_summary_en: With a deadly lightning storm at his command, Razor charges into battle. Deploying a sweeping ring of electrified plasma to fry his enemies, he links with foes to drain them of their power and use it against them.

abilities.name: razor_plasma_field
abilities.description_zh: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。
abilities.description_en: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.

abilities.name: razor_static_link
abilities.description_zh: 在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
abilities.description_en: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
notes_zh: 链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过%drain_range_buffer%后断裂。
notes_en: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes %drain_range_buffer% units greater than Static Link's cast range.

shard_loc.en: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.
shard_loc.zh: 提升施法距离。减缓目标的移动速度，数值为连接生效时%move_speed_factor%倍的攻击力窃取量。

abilities.name: razor_storm_surge
abilities.description_zh: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
abilities.description_en: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

shard_loc.en: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为%eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%倍，打击冷却时间减少%strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

abilities.name: razor_unstable_current
abilities.description_zh: 被动提升雷泽的移动速度。
abilities.description_en: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.

abilities.name: razor_eye_of_the_storm
abilities.description_zh: 强大的闪电风暴，打击生命值最低的敌方单位，造成伤害并削弱护甲。
abilities.description_en: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
notes_zh: 每次打击都会以范围内血量最低的敌方单位为目标。
风暴之眼优先打击受到静电连接作用的英雄。
连续施放的风暴之眼可以叠加。
notes_en: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.
scepter_loc.zh: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_razor_2
talents_raw.name_loc: -{s:bonus_strike_interval}s Eye of the Storm Strike Interval

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_razor_plasmafield_second_ring
talents_raw.name_loc: Creates A Second Plasma Field Delayed By {s:bonus_second_ring_delay}s
talents_raw.desc_loc: The second plasma field does {s:bonus_second_ring_reduction}% less damage

Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 能够逃过沙王伏击的寥寥无几。他从地下突袭敌人，将他们晕在原地，再操控终极技能释放出数波致命的震荡，摧毁周围的一切，而敌人的反击则被隐藏在沙暴中的他尽数躲过。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Not many can survive an ambush from Sand King. Demolishing everything around him with waves of deadly vibration from his ultimate, he evades counterattacks by hiding himself in a scouring gust of sand, and stuns foes by striking them from beneath.

abilities.name: sandking_burrowstrike
abilities.description_zh: 沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
abilities.description_en: Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: sandking_sand_storm
abilities.description_zh: 沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得隐身效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
abilities.description_en: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
notes_zh: 沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。%fade_delay%秒后将再次隐形。
notes_en: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.
facet_text_en: Sand Storm has increased radius and grants Sand King Invisibility while in it.

Sand Storm follows Sand King at a rate of %sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%% of his movement speed and is still active at a distance of up to %sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster% units away from Sand King.
When Sand King attacks enemies in Sand Storm, he applies a blinding debuff to the target.
facet_text_zh: 沙尘暴的作用范围提升，并且沙王在其中获得隐身效果。
沙尘暴能以%sand_storm_move_speed_pct%%%沙王移速的速度跟随沙王，并且只要和沙王相距不超过%sand_storm_max_distance_from_caster%就不会消失。
当沙王在沙尘暴中攻击敌人时，他会对目标施加致盲的负面状态。

abilities.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
abilities.description_zh: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心%inner_radius%范围内敌人将受到%inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
abilities.description_en: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.

shard_loc.en: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.
shard_loc.zh: 被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

abilities.name: sandking_caustic_finale
abilities.description_zh: 沙王的攻击对敌方单位注入毒液，使他们死亡时发生剧烈爆炸，造成固定数值的伤害加上基于阵亡单位最大生命值的额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

abilities.name: sandking_epicenter
abilities.description_zh: 经过%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
abilities.description_en: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
notes_zh: 地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
notes_en: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.

scepter_loc.en: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).
scepter_loc.zh: 地震的脉冲开始时每%spine_tick_rate%秒会在随机地点产生%scepter_explosions_per_pulse%片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的%scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%%，对击中的敌人造成%spine_damage_pct%%%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生%shard_explosions_per_pulse%次攻击。

shard_loc.en: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
shard_loc.zh: 每%shard_interval%秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_sand_king_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: Enemy units in range of Sand Storm have their movement speed slowed by {s:bonus_sand_storm_slow}% and miss {s:bonus_blind_pct}% of their attacks.

Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 风暴之灵从未错失一场战斗。将自己压缩于一道闪电中在战场中穿梭，他运用爆炸性的残影和饱含电荷的攻击从四面八方奇袭敌人，而敌人还在手忙脚乱的时候他已经不知去向。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Storm Spirit is never one to miss a fight. Zipping from across the battlefield in a bolt of lightning, he strikes enemies from every direction with exploding remnants and charged attacks, then disappears while his enemies are still scrambling to react.

abilities.name: storm_spirit_static_remnant
abilities.description_zh: 风暴之灵制造一个充满爆炸性能量的自身残影，会向目标地点走去，持续%abilityduration%秒。如果有人接近就会引爆造成伤害，残影持续%abilityduration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Creates an explosively charged image of Storm Spirit that walks to the target position and lasts for %abilityduration% seconds. Will detonate and deal damage if an enemy unit comes near it.
notes_zh: 残影在技能施放%static_remnant_delay%秒后才能实体化。
残影在持续时间内拥有顺畅视野。
残影爆炸将伤害%static_remnant_damage_radius%码作用范围内的单位，但是触发范围是%static_remnant_radius%码。
可以对自身施放，这样会原地施放。
notes_en: Remnants take %static_remnant_delay% second to materialize after the spell is cast.
Remnants grant unobstructed vision for their duration.
The explosion actually hits units in a %static_remnant_damage_radius% radius, but will only be triggered in %static_remnant_radius%.
Can be self-cast to cast in place.

abilities.name: storm_spirit_electric_vortex
abilities.description_zh: 将一个敌人拖到风暴之灵所在位置的涡流。
abilities.description_en: A vortex that pulls an enemy unit to Storm Spirit's location.

scepter_loc.en: Electric Vortex affects all enemies within a radius around Storm Spirit.
scepter_loc.zh: 电子涡流变成范围型技能，可以作用于风暴之灵周围所有敌人。

facet_text_en: Electric Vortex applies a debuff to the enemy that lasts for %enemy_overload_duration%s making their next attack target themself and trigger an Overload Charge.
facet_text_zh: 电子涡流会对敌人施加%enemy_overload_duration%秒的负面效果，使敌人下次攻击会以自身为目标，并触发一次超负荷。

abilities.name: storm_spirit_overload
abilities.description_zh: 施法时会产生电荷，在风暴之灵下次攻击时被释放，对附近敌人造成伤害并减速。
abilities.description_en: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 使用物品不会触发超负荷。
超负荷效果不会叠加。
notes_en: Using items doesn't trigger Overload.
Overload charges do not stack.

shard_loc.en: Can be activated to grant Storm Spirit and nearby allied heroes %shard_activation_charges% Overload charges. Provides bonus Attack Speed. Lasts up to %shard_activation_duration% seconds or until the charges are depleted.
shard_loc.zh: 施放后风暴之灵和附近友方英雄获得%shard_activation_charges%次超负荷效果。提供额外攻击速度。持续最多%shard_activation_duration%秒，或效果用尽。

abilities.name: storm_spirit_ball_lightning
abilities.description_zh: 风暴之灵变成不稳定的电流在战场上横冲直撞，直到他的魔法耗尽或到达目标才停下。施法消耗为%ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%%，每移动100距离消耗%ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+总魔法量的%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%%，本技能造成的伤害每飞行100距离就会递增。
abilities.description_en: Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.
notes_zh: 行进过程中可以使用技能和物品。
该技能可以摧毁树木。
风暴之灵在球状闪电期间是无敌状态。
notes_en: Abilities and items can be used while traveling.
This ability will destroy trees.
Storm Spirit is invulnerable during Ball Lightning.

abilities.name: storm_spirit_galvanized
abilities.description_zh: 风暴之灵每次击杀都会获得一点提供%mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复的能量，每%level_divisor%级也会获得一点能量。每次阵亡会损失%charges_per_death%点能量。另外每次获得一点能量时他还会永久获得%perma_mp_per_kill%点/秒魔法恢复。
abilities.description_en: Storm Spirit gains a charge of %mp_per_kill% mana regeneration per kill, and a charge every %level_divisor% levels. Loses %charges_per_death% charges per death. Additionally every time he gains a charge he also gains %perma_mp_per_kill% Mana Regen permanently.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法通过击杀获得新的叠加效果。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks from kills.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_storm_spirit_7
talents_raw.desc_loc: Bouncing attacks deal {s:bonus_overload_damage_pct}% damage.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_storm_spirit_4
talents_raw.name_loc: {s:bonus_auto_remnant_interval} Distance Auto Remnant in Ball Lightning
talents_raw.desc_loc: Every {s:bonus_auto_remnant_interval} distance travelled in Ball Lightning creates a Static Remnant.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
Casting a spell creates an electrical charge, which is released in a burst on Storm's next attack, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.

Storm Spirit becomes volatile electricity, charging across the battlefield until he depletes his mana or reaches his target. The activation mana cost is %ball_lightning_initial_mana_base%+%ball_lightning_initial_mana_percentage%%% of his total mana pool, and the cost per 100 units traveled is %ball_lightning_travel_cost_base%+%ball_lightning_travel_cost_percent%%% of his total mana pool.  Damage is expressed in damage per 100 units traveled.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 斯温总是渴望投入战斗。他在作战中击晕聚拢的敌人，而他一旦激发了终极技能就会大幅提升攻击力，挥舞几下手中的巨剑就能将敌人一一斩落。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Sven is always eager to charge into a fight. He stuns grouped enemies as he wades into battle, and once he ignites his damage-boosting ultimate, a few swings of his massive sword are often more than enough to slay his foes.

abilities.name: sven_storm_bolt
abilities.description_zh: 斯温用他充满魔力的手套对目标周围内所有敌人造成伤害和眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Sven unleashes his magical gauntlet that deals damage and stuns enemy units in a small area around the target.

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and applies a basic dispel on the target. Affects invulnerable units. If alt-cast, it deals an additional %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and Sven travels with the Storm Hammer.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离，并且对目标施加弱驱散效果。可以影响无敌目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，额外造成%scepter_bonus_damage%点伤害并且斯温会跟随风暴之拳行进。

abilities.name: sven_great_cleave
abilities.description_zh: 斯温以巨力攻击，并对所有附近的敌方单位造成分裂攻击伤害。
abilities.description_en: Sven strikes with great force, cleaving all nearby enemy units with his attack.

abilities.name: sven_warcry
abilities.description_zh: 斯温的战吼激励着同伴作战，提升他们的护甲和移动速度。持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Sven's Warcry heartens his allied heroes for battle, increasing their armor and movement speed. Lasts %duration% seconds.

shard_loc.en: Increases radius and bonus movement speed. Warcry is now undispellable and provides a %base_barrier_amount% physical damage barrier.
shard_loc.zh: 提升作用范围和移动速度加成。现在战吼不可驱散，并提供%base_barrier_amount%点物理伤害护盾。

abilities.name: sven_gods_strength
abilities.description_zh: 斯温爆发出他流浪剑客的力量，获得攻击力加成和减速抗性，持续%abilityduration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Sven channels his rogue strength, granting bonus damage and slow resistance for %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 额外攻击力是基于斯温的基础攻击力和主属性数值。
notes_en: The bonus damage is based on base damage and the primary attribute of Sven.

abilities.name: sven_wrath_of_god
abilities.description_zh: 斯温从力量中获得额外攻击力。
abilities.description_en: Sven gains additional attack damage from Strength.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 随着战斗的推进，小小的身材和力量都将成长到惊人的地步，而他的威力也会非常可怕。他向敌人们投掷英雄，或者让他们在山崩下昏迷。只要给他机会发挥出完全的实力，他就能摧枯拉朽般毁灭敌方的基地。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Growing to tremendous size and strength as the battle progresses, Tiny's power can quickly become terrifying. He tosses heroes and creeps at his enemies, or stuns them beneath an avalanche. Should he gather his full strength, he can demolish the enemy's base with ease.

abilities.name: tiny_avalanche
abilities.description_zh: 用岩石轰炸一块区域，对敌方单位造成短间隔的伤害并眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.

abilities.name: tiny_toss
abilities.description_zh: 抓起小小身旁%grab_radius%范围内最近的单位，不论敌友，扔向目标单位或神符，落地时将造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Grabs the nearest unit in a %grab_radius% radius around Tiny, ally or enemy, and launches it at the target unit or rune to deal damage where they land.
notes_zh: 你可以投掷队友，但他们不会受到伤害。
投掷对建筑物造成33%的伤害。
可以对减益免疫单位施放，但是不能将他们扔起，或对他们造成伤害。
飞行时间是%duration%秒。
notes_en: You can toss allies, but they don't take damage.
Toss deals 33% of its damage to buildings.
Debuff Immune units can be targeted but cannot be tossed.
Flight time is %duration%s.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_grab
abilities.description_zh: 抓起一棵树，使小小在有限次数的攻击里获得攻击距离加成、攻击力加成和溅射攻击。可以将树木扔出，对远距离的敌人造成攻击伤害。
abilities.description_en: Grabs a tree and causes Tiny to have bonus range, damage, and a splashing attack for a limited number of attacks.  The tree can be thrown, to deal your attack to a unit at a distance.
notes_zh: 树木扔出后技能进入冷却。
notes_en: The cooldown begins when the tree is thrown.

abilities.name: tiny_tree_channel
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 小小进行持续施法，随机将自身周围的树木扔向目标范围。每棵树对该区域内敌人造成的伤害为小小的攻击伤害加上扔树的额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Tiny channels to throw random trees within range towards the targeted area. Deals Tiny's attack with Tree Throw bonuses.

abilities.name: tiny_insurmountable
abilities.description_zh: 小小从力量中获得状态和减速抗性。减速抗性还会降低攻击速度减少的影响。
abilities.description_en: Tiny gains Status and Slow Resistance from Strength. Slow Resistance also reduces the impact of Attack Speed slows.
notes_zh: 不可逾越不会减少长大的攻击速度降低效果。
notes_en: Insurmountable does not reduce the effect of Grow's Attack Speed Reduction.

abilities.name: tiny_grow
abilities.description_zh: 小小崎岖的身体不断成长，提升了攻击力、移动速度、护甲和投掷的威力，但攻击速度降低。
abilities.description_en: Tiny gains craggy mass, increasing his attack damage, movement speed and armor, and toss power while slowing his attack speed.

shard_loc.en: Units tossed by Toss or trees tossed by Tree Throw or Tree Volley now deal additional damage and slow in a larger area of effect at their landing location.
shard_loc.zh: 现在投掷扔出的单位，扔树和树木连掷扔出的树木都会在落地点的更大范围内造成额外伤害和减速效果。

abilities.name: tiny_toss_tree
abilities.description_zh: 将树木扔向目标单位，触发自身对其的攻击，并且对周围目标造成溅射伤害。
abilities.description_en: Throws the tree at the target unit, proccing your attack on it and splashing damage around the target.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_tiny_5
talents_raw.desc_loc: Toss can target the ground as well as enemy units.

Bombards an area with rocks, continously doing small intervals of damage and stun to enemy units.
