heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 众人永远能感受到复仇之魂的存在，不管她是生是死。她可以与周围任何英雄交换位置，击晕敌人，不幸阵亡还能让凶手的输出大打折扣。有她在场，给敌人带去的混乱将源源不断。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Vengeful Spirit's presence is felt at all times, whether she is alive or dead. Able to swap positions with any nearby hero, stun enemies, and reduce her killer's effectiveness if she falls, she constantly brings confusion and chaos to her foes.

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_magic_missile
abilities.description_zh: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，眩晕并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.

shard_loc.en: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within %bounce_range_pct%%% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.
shard_loc.zh: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的%bounce_range_pct%%%魔法箭施法距离内。

facet_text_en: Magic Missile deals %damage_per_lasthit% bonus damage for every creep the enemy has killed.
facet_text_zh: 魔法箭造成额外伤害，敌人每击杀一个非英雄单位为%damage_per_lasthit%点额外伤害。

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_wave_of_terror
abilities.description_zh: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。
abilities.description_en: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_command_aura
abilities.description_zh: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得%self_multiplier%%%额外加成。
abilities.description_en: Vengeful Spirit's presence increases the damage of nearby friendly heroes. Vengeful Spirit herself receives %self_multiplier%%% extra bonus.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。
notes_en: Break disables the damage aura.

scepter_loc.en: Increases self multiplier. Upon death, creates a strong illusion of Vengeful Spirit that deals full damage, and can cast all of her spells.If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_retribution
abilities.description_zh: 复仇之魂的攻击同时被视为远程和近战，可以获得相应加成。只要敌方英雄击杀了复仇之魂，他们会获得一个负面效果，直到下次阵亡，期间复仇之魂会对他们造成%bonus_damage%%%额外伤害。同一时间只能存在一个负面效果。
abilities.description_en: Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals %bonus_damage%%% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

abilities.name: vengefulspirit_nether_swap
abilities.description_zh: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
abilities.description_en: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。
notes_en: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_vengeful_spirit_wave_of_terror_steal
talents_raw.name_loc: Wave Of Terror Steals {s:bonus_steal_pct}% Of Reduced Damage And Armor

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.
Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 风行者身法轻灵多变，总是在寻找出手的角度。她要么张弓射出强力致命的一箭，要么将敌人束缚在一起，向他们射出箭雨，风行者永远都是那么雷厉风行。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Evasive and swift, the nimble Windranger is always seeking the right angle to attack. Whether she's clearing the way with a draw of her deadly powershot, or shackling enemies together to pepper them with arrows, she's always on the move.

abilities.name: windrunner_shackleshot
abilities.description_zh: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则眩晕时间减少至%fail_stun_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
notes_zh: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多%shackle_distance%距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。
notes_en: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.
facet_text_en: Shackleshot applies to all units and trees behind the target unit and grants Windranger bonus attack damage for each additional shackled unit and tree. Creeps and trees grant less bonus damage.
facet_text_zh: 束缚击会对目标单位身后的所有单位和树木施加，每个额外束缚的单位和树木都会使风行者获得攻击力加成。非英雄单位和树木提供的攻击力加成较少。

abilities.name: windrunner_powershot
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
notes_en: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.
facet_text_en: Enemy heroes hit are executed if below a health threshold. The execute threshold is based on the arrow's power.
facet_text_zh: 被击中的敌方英雄血量低于临界值就会被秒杀。秒杀血量是基于箭矢的威力。

abilities.name: windrunner_windrun
abilities.description_zh: 提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。
abilities.description_en: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

abilities.name: windrunner_gale_force
abilities.description_zh: 以矢量为目标。召唤出一阵强风，将目标区域内所有敌人朝目标方向推去。
abilities.description_en: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

abilities.name: windrunner_focusfire
abilities.description_zh: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加%bonus_attack_speed%，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
abilities.description_en: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
notes_zh: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。
notes_en: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.
facet_text_en: Focus Fire no longer requires a target, instead firing at random enemies within Windranger's attack range + %bonus_range%. Fires a fixed number of attacks per second, and can only hit the same enemy every 4 shots. Prioritizes Heroes.
facet_text_zh: 集中火力不再需要施法目标，而是对风行者攻击距离 + %bonus_range%范围内的随机敌人发动攻击。每秒发动固定次数的攻击，并且每4箭才会击中一次同个敌人。以英雄优先。

abilities.name: windrunner_tailwind
abilities.description_zh:
施放技能会召唤一阵顺风，向风行者提供短时间的移动速度爆发。移动速度加成在顺风持续时间的半途开始逐渐衰减。

被动提升风行者的移动速度上限。
abilities.description_en:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

scepter_loc.en: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.
scepter_loc.zh: 攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_7
talents_raw.name_loc: Powershot Executes Enemy Heroes Under {s:bonus_max_execute_threshold}% Max HP
talents_raw.desc_loc: Execute Threshold ranges from {s:bonus_min_execute_threshold}% to {s:bonus_max_execute_threshold}% Max HP based on the arrow's power.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_windranger_2
talents_raw.name_loc: Focus Fire Kills Advance Cooldown by {s:bonus_cooldown_reduction_per_kill}s

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 宙斯面前所有人都无处遁形，他召唤的一道惊雷会让周围的英雄暴露无遗，放出的弧形闪电可以游遍附近的敌人，而号令的可怕霹雳将打击一切仇敌。无论敌人何在，宙斯都将找到他们。
heroes.hero_summary_en: None can hide from Zeus, whether he's calling down a bolt to reveal the surroundings, sending an arc coursing through his nearest enemies, or summoning a terrifying volley of lightning upon all enemies. Wherever his foes are, Zeus will find them.

abilities.name: zuus_arc_lightning
abilities.description_zh: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

abilities.name: zuus_lightning_bolt
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。施放后，雷击在目标周围%sight_radius_night%范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于%spread_aoe%范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
abilities.description_en: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a %sight_radius_night% radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in %spread_aoe% range.
notes_zh: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。
notes_en: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

abilities.name: zuus_heavenly_jump
abilities.description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。
abilities.description_en: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: zuus_cloud
abilities.description_zh: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
abilities.description_en: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得%cloud_bounty_tooltip%金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。
notes_en: Grants %cloud_bounty_tooltip% gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.

abilities.name: zuus_lightning_hands
abilities.description_zh: 宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。
abilities.description_en: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

abilities.name: zuus_thundergods_wrath
abilities.description_zh: 用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害，无论他们身在何处。在打击前提供每个英雄的真实视域。
abilities.description_en: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.
facet_text_en: Damage is dealt to one enemy at a time, moving from lowest health hero to highest. If an enemy is killed by this ability, the damage for all subsequent enemies is increased.
facet_text_zh: 从最低生命值的英雄开始，逐一对敌人造成伤害，最后是生命值最高的敌人。如果有敌人被这个技能击杀，那么接下来所有敌人受到的伤害都会增加。

abilities.name: zuus_static_field
abilities.description_zh: 宙斯攻击或通过技能击中敌人都会电击他们，造成他们当前生命值一定百分比的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.
facet_text_en: Static Field deals more damage to nearby enemies.
facet_text_zh: 静电场对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 昆卡总是对敌人的动向了如指掌。他可以操控一股涌流或一艘幽灵船对一个地点发动袭击，如果目标无误，他和他的盟友就能毫不费力地收拾残局。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Kunkka is always predicting where his enemies will go next. Able to attack a location with a geyser of water or a ghostly shipwreck, should his aim prove true, he and his allies will have no trouble cleaning up whatever is left.

abilities.name: kunkka_torrent
abilities.description_zh: 召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、眩晕和减速。
abilities.description_en: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes_zh: 初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。
notes_en: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

abilities.name: kunkka_tidebringer
abilities.description_zh: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
abilities.description_en: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.
facet_text_en: Tidebringer cooldown is reduced per enemy hero it hits.
facet_text_zh: 潮汐使者每击中一名英雄，冷却时间都会减少。

abilities.name: kunkka_x_marks_the_spot
abilities.description_zh: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。
abilities.description_en: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.
facet_text_en: When X Marks the Spot returns its target, Kunkka and allies near the return spot gain Ghostship's Admiral's Rum buff.
facet_text_zh: X标记送回目标后，昆卡和回归点附近友军都会获得幽灵船的统帅朗姆酒效果。

abilities.name: kunkka_admirals_rum
abilities.description_zh: 如果昆卡受到来自敌方英雄、建筑或肉山的伤害会使他的生命低于%damage_threshold%%%临界值，那么他会浸在统帅朗姆酒中，获得移动速度加成，并且延后承受即将受到的%ghostship_absorb%%%伤害，持续%buff_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below %damage_threshold%%% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to %ghostship_absorb%%% of incoming damage for %buff_duration%s.
notes_zh: 在朗姆酒效果消失后造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。
notes_en: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

abilities.name: kunkka_tidal_wave
abilities.description_zh: 释放一道在昆卡身后出现的潮汐波。造成点伤害，并将敌人沿着波浪拖拽距离。敌人被拖拽时无法攻击。
abilities.description_en: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

abilities.name: kunkka_ghostship
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
abilities.description_en: Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
notes_zh: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为%ghostship_speed%。
notes_en: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of %ghostship_speed%.

scepter_loc.en: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽灵船在目标地点以%fleet_interval%秒的间隔产生%fleet_count%艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射%num_cannon_volleys%波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成%cannon_ball_damage_pct%%%幽灵船伤害。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 极其致命的莉娜也很容易薄命，她可以毫不费力地击杀任何落单的笨蛋。每次施法后她都能获得攻击速度，运用烈焰和热闪电肃清敌人，确保没人能顶住她的袭击。
heroes.hero_summary_en: As deadly as she is fragile, Lina effortlessly strikes down any foe foolish enough to be caught alone. Gaining attack speed with each spell she casts, she scours enemies with flame and heat lightning, ensuring few can survive her assaults.

abilities.name: lina_dragon_slave
abilities.description_zh: 莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
abilities.description_en: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
notes_zh: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: lina_light_strike_array
abilities.description_zh: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并眩晕敌人。
abilities.description_en: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
notes_zh: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
notes_en: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.

abilities.name: lina_fiery_soul
abilities.description_zh: 莉娜每次利用技能击中一个敌人都会使她获得攻击和移动速度加成。可以叠加。持续%fiery_soul_stack_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts %fiery_soul_stack_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 每次技能击中敌人时都会刷新持续时间。
使用物品不会触发炽魂。
notes_en: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.

abilities.name: lina_flame_cloak
abilities.description_zh: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。
abilities.description_en: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

abilities.name: lina_slow_burn
abilities.description_zh: 莉娜的技能会在%burn_duration%秒内额外造成%burn_damage_pct%%%原伤害的烧灼伤害。
abilities.description_en: Lina's abilities deal an additional %burn_damage_pct%%% damage as burn damage over %burn_duration%s.

abilities.name: lina_laguna_blade
abilities.description_zh: 对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
abilities.description_en: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
notes_zh: 神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
notes_en: Laguna Blade has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.

shard_loc.en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
shard_loc.zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

facet_text_en: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.
facet_text_zh: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 在战场间飘行的同时献祭小兵，为自己的袭击补充魔法，巫妖随时可以操控减速的冰霜帮助队友消灭他们的敌人。对于蠢到聚在一起的敌人，他极富弹跳性的终极技能将确保他们的灭亡。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Drifting from battle to battle and sacrificing creeps to fuel his assaults, Lich is always ready to help his fellow heroes destroy their enemies with slowing frost. Should his foes be foolish enough to gather, his bouncing ultimate will ensure their demise.

abilities.name: lich_frost_nova
abilities.description_zh: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续%abilityduration%秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。
abilities.description_en: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for %abilityduration% seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.

abilities.name: lich_frost_shield
abilities.description_zh: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每%interval%秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
abilities.description_en: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every %interval% seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
notes_zh: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。
notes_en: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.
facet_text_en: Whenever an enemy dies under the effect of Frost Shield, its duration is increased.
facet_text_zh: 每当敌人死于冰霜魔盾的效果下，技能的持续时间都会增加。

abilities.name: lich_sinister_gaze
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

scepter_loc.en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
scepter_loc.zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

abilities.name: lich_ice_spire
abilities.description_zh: 在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受%max_hero_attacks%次英雄攻击或%max_creep_attacks%次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。
abilities.description_en: Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take %max_hero_attacks% hero hits or %max_creep_attacks% creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

abilities.name: lich_death_charge
abilities.description_zh: 牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
abilities.description_en: Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes_zh: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。
notes_en: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

abilities.name: lich_chain_frost
abilities.description_zh: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
abilities.description_en: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes_zh: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。
notes_en: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of %projectile_speed%.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.
facet_text_en: Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
Killing an enemy with Chain Frost increases the number of bounces.
facet_text_zh: 连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
连环霜冻击杀敌人后会增加弹跳次数。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 有莱恩在，敌人反击的机会微乎及微。一排伤人的尖刺能使人头晕目眩，强大的变形术会将敌人暂时变成人畜无害的小动物，就算手中的魔法还不够强大，他和盟友有充足的时间斩落他们的敌人。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Lion gives enemies little chance to retaliate. Stunning targets with a damaging row of spikes, or temporarily transforming them into a harmless critter, even if his powerful spells aren't enough, he and his allies should still have all the time they need to slay their foes.

abilities.name: lion_impale
abilities.description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
abilities.description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: The spikes move at %speed% units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: lion_voodoo
abilities.description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，受害者无法使用所有特殊能力。
abilities.description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
notes_zh: 即刻摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。
notes_en: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

abilities.name: lion_mana_drain
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.  Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。
notes_en: Prevents heroes from going invisible.

shard_loc.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
shard_loc.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。

facet_text_en: Mana Drain deals damage equal to %damage_pct%%% of mana stolen.
facet_text_zh: 法力吸取会造成%damage_pct%%%吸魔量的伤害。

abilities.name: lion_to_hell_and_back
abilities.description_zh: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供%debuff_amp%%%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续%duration%秒的%spell_amp%%%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。
abilities.description_en: Lion gains %debuff_amp%%% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.Lion gains %spell_amp%%% spell amplification for %duration%s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

abilities.name: lion_finger_of_death
abilities.description_zh: 撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为%punch_attack_range%，并拥有移动速度加成。每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
abilities.description_en: Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with %punch_attack_range% range with bonus movement speed.Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
notes_zh: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有%damage_delay%秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后%grace_period%秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。
notes_en: Finger of Death has a %damage_delay% delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within %grace_period% seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.

scepter_loc.en: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_11
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_spell_amp}% To Hell And Back Debuff/Spell Amp

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_8
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_damage_per_kill} Finger of Death Damage Per Kill

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_lion_10
talents_raw.name_loc: Earth Spike affects a 30 degree cone

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 暗影萨满可以为友军迅速开出一条直捣敌军基地的行进之路。运用闪电魔法打击敌人，操控妖术干扰敌军，强大的毒蛇守卫将轻松摧毁敌人的防御工事。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Shadow Shaman quickly clears the way for his team's forces to march on the enemy base. Blasting enemies with shocking spells and interrupting attackers with hexes, his powerful serpent wards destroy enemy defenses with ease.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_ether_shock
abilities.description_zh: 利用虚空能量制造出分叉的闪电，打击多个敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Creates a cone of ethereal energy that strikes multiple enemy units.
notes_zh: 最远可以伤害1000距离外的次级单位。
notes_en: Can hit secondary targets up to 1000 distance away.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_voodoo
abilities.description_zh: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，使其无法攻击和使用技能。
abilities.description_en: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless creature, disabling their attacks and abilities.
notes_zh: 立即摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为%movespeed%，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。
notes_en: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of %movespeed%, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_shackles
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使用魔法绑住一个敌方单位，使其无法攻击和移动，同时持续吸取他们的生命能量。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Magically binds an enemy unit so that it cannot move or attack, absorbing their life energy over time.

scepter_loc.en: Increase cast range. Every %scepter_shock_interval% seconds, shackled units emit a radial Ether Shock hitting all other units within %scepter_shock_radius% of the target for %scepter_shock_pct%%% of Ether Shock's normal damage. Shackles can now also be cast on allies and Mass Serpent Wards that stay within %ally_break_range% units of Shadow Shaman. Allied units are not disabled by Shackle.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离。被绑住的单位每%scepter_shock_interval%秒会释放一次辐射状的苍穹震击，作用于%scepter_shock_radius%范围内其他所有单位，造成伤害的数值为%scepter_shock_pct%%%苍穹震击普通伤害。另外还能使枷锁可以对暗影萨满附近%ally_break_range%范围内的友军和群蛇守卫施放。友方单位不会被控制。

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_fowl_play
abilities.description_zh:
受到致死伤害时，暗影萨满会获得强驱散效果，并且以1点生命的小鸡继续存活。受到的伤害将降为零，持续较短时间，并且额外产生若干只小鸡，迷惑敌人。冷却时间会在暗影萨满复活时重置。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 无法阻止斧王的淘汰之刃和瘟疫法师的死神镰刀的致死伤害。
受到的伤害减免效果会阻止生命移除类效果杀死暗影萨满。
notes_en: Lethal Damage from Axe's Culling Blade and Necrophos's Reaper's Scythe will not be prevented.
Incoming damage reduction buff will prevent certain sources of HP removal from killing Shadow Shaman.

shard_loc.en: Increases the amount of time incoming damage is reduced to %damage_reduction_duration% seconds. When Fowl Play is triggered, Shadow Shaman becomes invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds. %chicken_illusions% additional uncontrollable chickens are created that last for %ally_voodoo_duration% seconds. While Shadow Shaman is transformed, he can now use items.
shard_loc.zh: 伤害减免时间提升至%damage_reduction_duration%秒。触发禽戏时暗影萨满会变为无敌，持续%invuln_duration%秒。额外产生%chicken_illusions%个不可控的小鸡，持续%ally_voodoo_duration%秒。另外还能使暗影萨满在变形期间可以使用物品。

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_urnaconda
abilities.description_zh: 向一个地点扔出一个蛇罐，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害，并产生一个巨蛇守卫，守卫的生命值和攻击力为平常群蛇守卫的%megaward_multiplier_tooltip%倍，持续%ward_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Throw a snake jar at the target location, damaging all enemies in the AoE and creating a Massive Serpent Ward that has %megaward_multiplier_tooltip%x the base Serpent Ward damage and health there that lasts %ward_duration%s.

abilities.name: shadow_shaman_mass_serpent_ward
abilities.description_zh: 召唤%ward_count%个群蛇守卫攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫免疫魔法。非英雄单位对毒蛇守卫造成半额伤害。
abilities.description_en: Summons %ward_count% Serpent Wards to attack enemy units and structures. The Wards are immune to magic. Creeps deal half damage to the Serpent Ward.

shard_loc.en: Allows to create a Mega Ward using the Urnaconda ability.
shard_loc.zh: 可以使用巨蟒之瓮技能制造一个巨蛇守卫。

facet_text_en: Summons a single massive Serpent Ward with %mega_ward_multiplier_damage%x damage and %mega_ward_multiplier_health%x health and bounty values.
facet_text_zh: 召唤一个巨大的毒蛇守卫，攻击力为%mega_ward_multiplier_damage%倍，生命值和击杀金钱为%mega_ward_multiplier_health%倍。

When taking lethal damage, Shadow Shaman receives a strong dispel and survives as a 1 HP chicken with increased movement speed. Incoming damage is reduced to zero for a short duration and additional chickens are created to confuse the enemy. Cooldown resets when Shadow Shaman respawns.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 斯拉达在战场上蜿蜒急行，随时可以找到敌军并将其碾压。敌人将暴露无遗，防御力也会遭到粉碎，他靠近敌人后三叉戟有力的重击将重创敌人，使他们动弹不得。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Ready to find and demolish his foes, Slardar quickly slithers into battle. After exposing an enemy's position and shattering their defenses, he closes the distance to lock them in place with crushing blows and powerful bashes from his trident.

abilities.name: slardar_sprint
abilities.description_zh: 斯拉达向前蜿行，移动速度得到显著提升，并且可以穿越单位。在最初%speed_burst_max_duration%内斯拉达获得%slow_resistance_tooltip%%%减速抗性。减速抗性会在剩余的冲刺时间内逐渐衰减。
abilities.description_en: Slardar slithers ahead, moving significantly faster and passing through units. Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.
notes_zh: 开启此技能不会打断持续施法。
notes_en: Activating this skill doesn't interrupt channeling abilities.
facet_text_en: Slardar has slow resistance and even more movement speed at the beginning of Guardian Sprint.
facet_text_zh: 守卫冲刺开始时斯拉达获得减速抗性和额外的移动速度。

abilities.name: slardar_slithereen_crush
abilities.description_zh: 猛击地面，留下一片水洼，对附近敌方单位造成伤害并眩晕。眩晕结束后还会受到减速。
abilities.description_en: Slams the ground, leaving a puddle of water, and stunning and damaging nearby enemy units.  After the stun, the affected units are slowed.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Slithereen Crush puddle radius and duration.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升鱼人碎击水洼的作用范围和持续时间。

shard_loc.en: Slithereen Crush now applies Corrosive Haze for a short time to units affected.
shard_loc.zh: 鱼人碎击会对受到作用的单位施加短时间的侵蚀雾霭。

abilities.name: slardar_bash
abilities.description_zh: %attack_count%次攻击后，下次攻击会重击目标。
abilities.description_en: After %attack_count% attacks, your next attack will bash the target.
notes_zh: 不能与碎颅锤叠加。
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

abilities.name: slardar_seaborn_sentinel
abilities.description_zh: 斯拉达在水洼、水迹或河道中将获得移动速度、生命恢复、攻击力和护甲加成。
abilities.description_en: Slardar gains bonus movement speed, health regeneration, attack damage, and armor while in a puddle, trail, or river.

scepter_loc.en: Provides additional HP Regen, Armor and Status Resistance while in a puddle, trail, or river. Increases puddle/trail radius by %scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%% and puddle/trail duration by %scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 在水洼、水迹或河道中获得额外生命恢复、护甲，还有状态抗性。水洼/水迹的作用范围提升%scepter_puddle_radius_tooltip%%%，水洼的持续时间提升%scepter_puddle_duration_increase_tooltip%秒。

abilities.name: slardar_amplify_damage
abilities.description_zh: 削弱敌人的护甲，加深他受到的物理伤害，同时提供目标的真实视域，显示隐身单位。敌方单位将在身后留下水迹。
abilities.description_en: Reduces enemy armor to amplify physical damage and provides True Sight and vision of the targeted unit, revealing invisibility. The enemy unit leaves a trail of water behind it.
facet_text_en: Corrosive Haze increases Slardar's armor by %armor_pct%%% of the total armor reduced.
facet_text_zh: 斯拉达的护甲提升，数值为侵蚀雾霭降低护甲总数的%armor_pct%%%。

Slardar has %slow_resistance_tooltip%%% slow resistance for the first %speed_burst_max_duration%s. The slow resistance gradually fades over the remaining sprint duration.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 潮汐猎人昂首阔步地走在队伍的前面，他总是在留意出手的时机。时机来临时，他会释放毁灭性的终极技能，为盟友留下一堆头晕目眩的敌人任他们宰割。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Stalking ahead of his team, Tidehunter is always on the lookout for the right time to strike. When the moment comes, he unleashes his massive and devastating ultimate, paving the way for his allies to slay their stunned enemies.

abilities.name: tidehunter_gush
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一股巨浪攻击一个敌方单位，减速并削弱护甲。
abilities.description_en: Summons a gush of water to damage an enemy unit, reducing their movement speed and armor.

scepter_loc.en: Gush becomes a ground targeted wave ability that affects enemy units in a line.  Decreases cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 巨浪变成点地施放的波形技能，可以作用于直线上的单位。降低冷却时间。

abilities.name: tidehunter_kraken_shell
abilities.description_zh:
加厚潮汐猎人的外皮，可以被动格挡物理伤害。对非英雄单位的格挡伤害有所减少。潮汐猎人的外皮在他受到的伤害超过临界值后还将移除负面的状态效果。

可以主动开启，以%active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%%移动速度的代价使伤害格挡量加倍。持续%active_duration%秒。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
Thickens Tidehunter's hide to passively block a portion of any incoming physical attack damage. Reduced block amount versus creeps. The hide also removes negative status effects if the damage taken crosses a threshold.

Can be activated to double the block amount at the cost of %active_move_speed_penalty_pct%%% movement speed. Lasts %active_duration%s.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
facet_text_en: Kraken Shell gains permanent Damage Block when an enemy hero dies under the effects of Anchor Smash.
facet_text_zh: 锚击效果下的敌方英雄阵亡会使海妖外壳获得永久伤害格挡。

abilities.name: tidehunter_anchor_smash
abilities.description_zh: 潮汐猎人挥动他巨大的锚攻击附近的敌人，攻击时获得攻击力加成，同时降低敌人的攻击力。锚击的作用范围为潮汐猎人的攻击距离 + %additional_range%。
abilities.description_en: Tidehunter swings his mighty anchor to attack and deal bonus damage to nearby enemies and reduce their attack damage. The radius of Anchor Smash is Tidehunter's attack range plus %additional_range% units.
notes_zh: 锚击对远古生物同样有效，不过对肉山无效。
海妖外壳净化触发的锚击造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Anchor Smash works on all Ancient creeps except for Roshan.
Damage done by Anchor Smashes triggered by Kraken Shell Cleanse is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: tidehunter_dead_in_the_water
abilities.description_zh: 潮汐猎人将一只重锚栓到一名敌方英雄身上。被栓到锚上的英雄处于被束缚状态。尝试移动到距离巨锚%chain_length%距离外会导致英雄的移动速度降低至%max_movement_speed%，而且会一直拽着长锚。巨锚承受%attacks_to_destroy%次英雄攻击后会被摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Tidehunter attaches a heavy anchor to an enemy hero. The hero is leashed while attached to the anchor. Attempting to move more than %chain_length% units away from the anchor forces the hero to %max_movement_speed% move speed, dragging the anchor behind them. The anchor can be destroyed with %attacks_to_destroy% hero attacks.

abilities.name: tidehunter_ravage
abilities.description_zh: 猛击地面，触手向各个方向穿出，伤害并眩晕附近所有敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Slams the ground, causing tentacles to erupt in all directions, damaging and stunning all nearby enemy units.
notes_zh: 毁灭能伤害隐身单位。
毁灭以%speed%的速度向外扩散。
notes_en: Ravage will hit invisible units.
Ravage waves move outwards at a speed of %speed%.

abilities.name: tidehunter_leviathans_catch
abilities.description_zh: 每当敌方英雄被潮汐猎人击杀，或者阵亡时带着他的负面状态，他们原地都会出现一条鱼；潮汐猎人可以吃掉鱼，永久获得%fish_health_bonus%点最大生命值，%fish_attack_range%攻击距离和%fish_damage_block%额外伤害格挡。潮汐猎人每次升到偶数等级都会自动吃下一条鱼。
abilities.description_en: Whenever an enemy hero is killed by Tidehunter or dies under his debuffs, a fish appears in their place; Tidehunter can eat the fish to permanently gain %fish_health_bonus% Health, %fish_attack_range% Attack Range, and %fish_damage_block% Bonus Damage Block.Tidehunter eats a free fish every time he reaches an even hero level.
notes_zh: 敌人可以摧毁鱼。
额外伤害格挡只会在有伤害格挡来源施加给即将受到的物理攻击时才会施加
notes_en: Enemies can destroy the fish.
Bonus Damage Block only applies if another source of Damage Block will be affecting the incoming physical attack.

talents_raw.name_loc: Kraken Shell Cleanse triggers Anchor Smash
talents_raw.desc_loc: Triggered attack has {s:bonus_smash_on_purge}% damage and is reflected damage.

talents_raw.desc_loc: Deals {s:bonus_building_pct_damage}% damage to buildings.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 巫医可以为团队提供所需的一切。持续的治疗、眩晕和诅咒保证了团队每个人头，强大的终极技能则让他自己在舞蹈中毁灭敌人，他技能的全面实在是少有匹敌。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Witch Doctor is whatever his team needs him to be. Whether aiding his team with gradual healing, stunning and cursing foes to ensure a kill, or destroying enemies himself with a dance by his mighty ultimate, few can match Witch Doctor's versatility.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask
abilities.description_zh: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，眩晕击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
abilities.description_en: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
notes_zh: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。
notes_en: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.
facet_text_en: Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.
facet_text_zh: 麻痹药剂每次弹跳造成额外伤害。

abilities.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration
abilities.description_zh: 巫医集中魔力治疗附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
abilities.description_en: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
notes_zh: 治疗间隔为%heal_interval%秒。
对减益免疫单位有效。
notes_en: Healing is done in %heal_interval% second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.
facet_text_en: Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.
facet_text_zh: 巫毒疗法对敌人造成伤害，只会治疗巫医自身。

abilities.name: witch_doctor_maledict
abilities.description_zh: 对一个较小区域内所有敌方英雄和玩家控制的目标施放诅咒，他们将每秒受到固定伤害，并且从诅咒开始每4秒根据失去的血量再受到爆发伤害。
abilities.description_en: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
notes_zh: 受到作用的英雄如果在结算时当前血量高于原血量，则额外伤害为0。
notes_en: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.
facet_text_en: Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.
facet_text_zh: 被诅咒的敌人阵亡后会对%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，数值等于下次爆发伤害的%spread_pct%%%。

abilities.name: witch_doctor_voodoo_switcheroo
abilities.description_zh: 巫医暂时变成死亡守卫，死亡守卫的攻击速度有所降低。这段时间内自己为隐藏状态。
abilities.description_en: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_gris_gris
abilities.description_zh: 巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的%death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每%gold_tick_interval_tooltip%秒会增加1金。右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。
abilities.description_en: Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, %death_gold_lost_reduction_pct_tooltip%%% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip%s.  Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

abilities.name: witch_doctor_death_ward
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。死亡守卫拥有%bonus_accuracy%%%额外必中率。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
notes_zh: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。
notes_en: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.

scepter_loc.en: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。

facet_text_en: Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.
facet_text_zh: 死亡守卫同时攻击%initial_target_count%个目标，但伤害降低。次级目标受到%secondary_attack_damage_pct%%%伤害。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_maledict_spread
talents_raw.name_loc: Maledict bursts deal {s:bonus_spread_pct}% damage in a {s:bonus_spread_radius} AoE
talents_raw.desc_loc: Sends projectiles that deal {s:bonus_spread_pct}% of the burst damage at all enemy units within {s:bonus_spread_radius} range

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_witch_doctor_2
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_heal_percent}% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Heal
facets_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_heal_percent}% Target Max Health Voodoo Restoration Damage

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 力丸在敌人的眼皮底下潜行于战场。他仔细挑选时机，在一阵沉默的烟雾中骤然出现，敌人还未察觉之前背后已遭中伤。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Riki stalks the battlefield, unseen by the enemy. He chooses his moment carefully and bursts forth in a puff of silencing smoke, stabbing at his foes before they even know he's there.

abilities.name: riki_smoke_screen
abilities.description_zh: 丢下一个烟雾弹，沉默其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
abilities.description_en: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
notes_zh: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。
不能阻止使用物品。
notes_en: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.

shard_loc.en: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.
shard_loc.zh: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低%armor_reduction%点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

abilities.name: riki_blink_strike
abilities.description_zh: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成%slow_pct_tooltip%%%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。
abilities.description_en: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

abilities.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的%interval_targets%个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离至%AbilityCastRange%。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有%scepter_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升%scepter_bonus_duration%秒，并且额外发动%scepter_bonus_attacks%次攻击。

facet_text_en: Tricks of the Trade has %creep_agility_multiplier%x Agility Bonus when attacking non-hero units. When Riki kills a non-hero unit during Tricks of the Trade, the cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%s.
facet_text_zh: 绝杀秘技攻击非英雄单位时拥有%creep_agility_multiplier%倍敏捷加成。只要力丸在绝杀秘技期间击杀一个非英雄单位，冷却时间就会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_creep_kill%秒。

abilities.name: riki_innate_backstab
abilities.description_zh: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。
abilities.description_en: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes_zh: 反补友方单位时具有%ally_multiplier%%%效果。
力丸的幻象也会有背刺的动作，但是不会造成额外伤害。
notes_en: Works when denying friendly units at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.
facet_text_en: Riki receives bonus experience for assists and kills.
facet_text_zh: 力丸获得助攻和击杀时会获得额外经验。

abilities.name: riki_backstab
abilities.description_zh: 力丸遁入阴影，变为隐身状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。
abilities.description_en: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_riki_tricks_dmg
talents_raw.name_loc: {s:bonus_base_attack_damage_pct}% of Riki's Base damage added to Tricks of the Trade

Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 谜团身怀无人不怕的终极技能，他可以召唤出使敌人动弹不得的黑洞，让友军将他们一网打尽。时常有一队虚灵体陪伴左右，他无需近身就能消灭敌人。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Widely feared for his ultimate ability, Enigma can summon a black hole capable of entrapping enemy forces, so that allies can then destroy them. An ever-present contingent of eidolons at his side, he pummels foes with ranged attacks.

abilities.name: enigma_malefice
abilities.description_zh: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被眩晕。每%tick_rate%秒眩晕一次。
abilities.description_en: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.

shard_loc.en: Increases Malefice stun duration by %shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.
shard_loc.zh: 憎恶的眩晕时间增加%shard_bonus_stun_duration_tooltip%秒，并且每次眩晕都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

abilities.name: enigma_demonic_conversion
abilities.description_zh: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的%current_health_pct%%%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。
abilities.description_en: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

abilities.name: enigma_midnight_pulse
abilities.description_zh: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成%base_damage% + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.

abilities.name: enigma_event_horizon
abilities.description_zh: %radius%范围内的单位远离谜团时会受到移速惩罚。
abilities.description_en: Units in a %radius% radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

abilities.name: enigma_black_hole
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.

scepter_loc.en: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.
scepter_loc.zh: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位%scepter_pct_damage%%%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个%scepter_radius%范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为%scepter_drag_speed%。

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every %tick_rate% seconds.

Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by %current_health_pct%%% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.
Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing %base_damage% + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
Units in a %radius% radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.
CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 修补匠运用众多致命的器具摧毁敌人。如果他能集齐所需的资源，瞬间刷新技能的力量可以让他在各大前线引领着他的团队。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Tinker demolishes foes with swarms of machines and a host of deadly gadgets. If he can gather the resources he needs, the power that instantly refreshes his abilities enables him to lead his team from every front.

abilities.name: tinker_laser
abilities.description_zh: 发射强烈的能量光束，对目标造成伤害和致盲。被致盲的单位，所有物理攻击都会落空。
abilities.description_en: Fires an intense energy beam, damaging and blinding the target. Blinded targets miss all physical attacks.

scepter_loc.en: Upgrades Tinker's Laser into a Shrink Ray, reducing the main target's size, current health, and maximum health by %scepter_reduction_pct%%% (stacking). Does not pierce debuff immunity.
scepter_loc.zh: 修补匠的激光升级成缩小射线，使主目标的模型大小、当前生命值和最大生命值减少%scepter_reduction_pct%%%（可以叠加）。

abilities.name: tinker_march_of_the_machines
abilities.description_zh: 征募一支机器人军队，摧毁修补匠周围的敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.
notes_zh: 机器人的产生速率是每秒%machines_per_sec%个。
notes_en: Robots spawn at a rate of %machines_per_sec% per second.

scepter_loc.en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
scepter_loc.zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

facet_text_en: March of the Machines applies a non-stacking heal over time when passing through allied heroes.
facet_text_zh: 机械行军在穿过友方英雄时会施加不可叠加的持续治疗效果。

abilities.name: tinker_deploy_turrets
abilities.description_zh: 在目标地点部署3个不可控的炮塔。被炮塔撞击的敌人受到伤害，并向远离落地点的方向推去。如果修补匠被撞击，他也会被推走。部署完毕后，炮塔开始向最近敌方英雄的方向发射导弹。
abilities.description_en: Deploys 3 uncontrollable turrets at the target location. Enemies hit by the impact take damage and are pushed away from the landing point. If Tinker is hit, he also gets pushed by the impact. Once deployed, the turret fires missiles in the direction of the nearest enemy hero.

scepter_loc.en: Turrets fire missiles %missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%% faster.
scepter_loc.zh: 炮塔发射导弹的速度加快%missile_attack_rate_tooltip%%%。

abilities.name: tinker_warp_grenade
abilities.description_zh: 向一个敌人扔出一枚光弹，造成伤害，将其向远离修补匠的方向传送并且缠绕，同时降低施法和攻击距离，持续%debuff_duration%秒。目标距离修补匠越近，传送距离越大。
abilities.description_en: Throws a flare towards an enemy, dealing damage, teleporting them away, rooting them and reducing their Cast and Attack Range for %debuff_duration% seconds.The target is teleported further the closer they are to Tinker.
notes_zh: 最大传送距离为%warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%%折跃耀光施法距离，在最大施法距离时降至0。
notes_en: Max teleportation distance is %warp_distance_pct_tooltip%%% of Warp Flare's cast range, which decreases down to 0 at max cast range.

abilities.name: tinker_rearm
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 重置修补匠技能的冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Resets the cooldown on Tinker's abilities.

abilities.name: tinker_eureka
abilities.description_zh: 修补匠的每%int_per_one_cdr%点智力提供%one_percent_tooltip%%%物品冷却时间减少，最多为%max_cdr%%%。
abilities.description_en: Tinker gains %one_percent_tooltip%%% item cooldown reduction per %int_per_one_cdr% Intelligence, up to a maximum of %max_cdr%%%.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Enlists an army of robotic minions to destroy enemy units in an area around Tinker.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 杀人于千里之外是狙击手的绝技。固定的火力弹幕让敌人应接不暇，接着抓住时机，使出一记杀手枪将他们带走。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Death from a distance is Sniper's specialty. He keeps his enemies on their toes with a steady barrage of firepower, and then, when the time is right, picks them off with a kill shot.

abilities.name: sniper_shrapnel
abilities.description_zh: 消耗一点能量射出一发带有爆炸弹片的榴霰弹，在目标区域降下弹雨。区域内的敌军受到伤害并被减速。榴霰弹将给予目标区域的视野。榴霰弹的能量每过%abilitychargerestoretime%秒恢复1点。
abilities.description_en: Consumes a charge to launch a ball of shrapnel that showers the target area in explosive pellets. Enemies are subject to damage and slowed movement. Reveals the targeted area. Shrapnel charges restore every %abilitychargerestoretime% seconds.
notes_zh: 总共造成11次伤害，第一次在技能生效时，接下来每秒造成一次伤害。
不会对建筑造成伤害。
将拥有目标区域的视野。
notes_en: Damage is dealt 11 times, immediately at spell effect then every second.
Does not damage buildings.
Provides vision in the targeted area.
facet_text_en: Shrapnel slow and damage are increased, but duration is decreased.
facet_text_zh: 榴霰弹的减速和伤害提升，但是持续时间减少。

abilities.name: sniper_headshot
abilities.description_zh: 狙击手提高他的精确度，有一定概率造成%damage%点额外伤害并击退敌人。敌人距离狙击手越近，击退距离越远。爆头会短暂地降低敌人%slow%%%移动和攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Sniper increases his accuracy, giving him a chance to deal %damage% extra damage and knock back his enemies. Knockback distance increases based on how close the enemy is to Sniper. Headshots briefly slow enemy movement and attack speed by %slow%%%.

abilities.name: sniper_take_aim
abilities.description_zh:
被动提升狙击手%passive_attack_range_bonus%攻击距离。

主动开启后，狙击手的视野距离、爆头几率和攻击距离提升。自身在持续时间内减速%slow%%%，并且视野限制在前方的锥形区域内。
abilities.description_en:
Passively increases Sniper's attack range by %passive_attack_range_bonus%.

On cast, Sniper gains increased vision, Headshot chance, and attack range. Slows you by %slow%%% for the duration and restricts your vision to a frontal cone.

abilities.name: sniper_concussive_grenade
abilities.description_zh: 向目标区域扔出一枚手雷，对敌人造成伤害并将他们和狙击手一同击退。受到作用的敌人被击退后还会被缴械和减速。
abilities.description_en: Launches a grenade at the target area, dealing damage to enemies and knocking them and Sniper back. Enemies affected are disarmed and have their movement slowed after the knockback.

shard_loc.en: Reduces cooldown, increases damage, and allows the knockback to affect Sniper as well.
shard_loc.zh: 降低冷却时间，提升伤害并允许技能也能击退狙击手。

abilities.name: sniper_keen_scope
abilities.description_zh: 狙击手和目标相距每%bonus_damage_distance%距离，他的攻击都会造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Sniper’s attacks deal bonus damage for every %bonus_damage_distance% units of distance Sniper is from the target.

abilities.name: sniper_assassinate
abilities.description_zh: 狙击手锁定一个目标敌方单位，经过短时间瞄准后射出一发毁灭性的子弹，从远距离对目标造成狙击手的攻击伤害 + 额外伤害，并且短暂眩晕目标。每当狙击手击杀敌方英雄，暗杀的冷却时间就会重置。
abilities.description_en: Sniper locks onto a target enemy unit and, after a short aiming duration, fires a devastating shot that deals Sniper's attack damage plus bonus damage at long range and mini-stuns the target. Whenever Sniper kills an enemy hero, Assassinate is refreshed.
notes_zh: 准星效果只对队友可见。
隐身不能躲避该技能弹道。
notes_en: Crosshair effect is only visible to allies.
Invisibility doesn't disjoint the projectile.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Assassinate to fire quicker and stun the enemy target.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗杀释放得更快，并且敌方目标的眩晕时间更久。

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 瘟疫法师所到之处，仇敌萎靡不振，盟友精神焕发。每次死亡脉冲都可以治疗战友，伤害敌人，一旦有敌人在他的存在下消溶，他将召出一把镰刀，延长其往生的时间。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Wherever Necrophos goes, enemies wither as allies thrive. Restoring health to his friends and harming enemies with each death pulse, once his very presence has eaten away at an enemy, he summons the reaper to lengthen their stay in the afterlife.

abilities.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
abilities.description_zh: 瘟疫法师向他的周围释放死亡波纹，伤害敌方单位并治疗友军单位。
abilities.description_en: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
notes_zh: 死亡脉冲不能被躲避。
notes_en: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

abilities.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
abilities.description_zh: 瘟疫法师步入将生者与死者相隔的领域。散发出一片灵气，减缓周围敌人的移动速度。在这个形态下，瘟疫法师为虚无状态，无法攻击或被攻击，受到的魔法伤害增加，但是生命/魔法恢复效果加强。
abilities.description_en: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.
facet_text_en: Necrophos gains movement speed equal to %movement_transfer%%% of the movement speed lost by enemies. Enemies lose %enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%% of the restoration amplification gained by Necrophos.
facet_text_zh: 瘟疫法师获得移动速度加成，数值等于%movement_transfer%%%敌人损失移速。敌人的恢复增强减少，数值等于瘟疫法师获得的%enemies_negative_heal_bonus_as_pct_of_self%%%。

abilities.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
abilities.description_zh: 瘟疫法师让敌人的心脏停跳，使附近敌方单位按最大生命值一定百分比持续流失生命。
abilities.description_en: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
notes_zh: 伤害不会禁用像闪烁匕首等物品。
不能作用于远古生物。
notes_en: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.

scepter_loc.en: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.
scepter_loc.zh: 竭心光环的生命流失伤害提升，数值为瘟疫法师当前生命恢复的%heal_regen_to_damage%%%。

abilities.name: necrolyte_death_seeker
abilities.description_zh: 瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。
abilities.description_en: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell reflect.

abilities.name: necrolyte_sadist
abilities.description_zh: 瘟疫法师每次击杀单位都将获得可叠加的恢复效果，持续%regen_duration%秒。击杀英雄后获得数倍的效果。
abilities.description_en: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
abilities.description_zh: 眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
abilities.description_en: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
notes_zh: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。
notes_en: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_necrophos_reaper_scythe_damage_per_health
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_damage_per_health} Reaper's Scythe Damage Per Missing HP

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 召唤出他的烈狱魔像，术士为敌人们带来毁灭，将他们的防御工事摧毁殆尽。然而即使没有魔像，他吟唱暗黑魔法还能破坏敌阵，只靠一句咒语就能治疗盟友，伤害敌人，或者让敌人相互连接，共同负担受到的痛苦。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Summoning forth his demonic golem, Warlock brings ruin to enemies and destroys their defenses. Yet even without his golem, his dark spells can still wreak havoc, whether healing allies and harming enemies with a word, or binding foes together to share their agony.

abilities.name: warlock_fatal_bonds
abilities.description_zh: 将数个可见的敌方单位连接在一起，其中一人所受伤害的一定百分比会被其他所有人感受到。
abilities.description_en: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
notes_zh: 共享伤害的类型与原伤害相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: warlock_shadow_word
abilities.description_zh: 术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被治疗。目标单位也会被治疗或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
abilities.description_en: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升作用范围。现在暗言术会施加给%cast_aoe%范围内%additional_targets%个额外单位，以英雄优先。额外单位的治疗和伤害量减少%secondary_reduction%%%。

abilities.name: warlock_upheaval
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多%abilitychanneltime%秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Enemies are slowed for %duration% second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
notes_zh: 减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。
notes_en: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.

shard_loc.en: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every %imps_interval% seconds that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.
shard_loc.zh: 持续施法时每%imps_interval%秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

abilities.name: warlock_eldritch_summoning
abilities.description_zh: 只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续%minor_imp_duration%秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
abilities.description_en: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for %minor_imp_duration% seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.

shard_loc.en: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.
shard_loc.zh: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

abilities.name: warlock_rain_of_chaos
abilities.description_zh: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，眩晕敌人%stun_duration%秒。地狱火持续%golem_duration%秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的减速抗性，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
abilities.description_en: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for %stun_duration% seconds. The Golem lives %golem_duration% seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
notes_zh: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.

scepter_loc.en: Calls %number_of_golems_scepter% Golems.
scepter_loc.zh: 召唤%number_of_golems_scepter%个地狱火。

facet_text_en: Chaotic Offering Golems deal more burn damage based on Warlock's health and mana regeneration.
facet_text_zh: 混乱之祭地狱火会根据术士的生命和魔法恢复造成更高的永久献祭伤害。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_warlock_10
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_aspd_per_second} Upheaval Attack Speed per second on Allies
talents_raw.desc_loc: Maximum of +70 Attack Speed

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_warlock_1
talents_raw.name_loc: {s:bonus_bonus_damage_resist}% Damage Resistance for Chaotic Offering Golems

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 兽王在战场上行走从来都是准备万全。他可以召唤喷毒的野猪和刺探敌情的战鹰协助狩猎，挥舞双斧劈开丛林中的树木，他震耳欲聋的咆哮将为盟友开出一条灭敌之路。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Summoning a poison-spitting boar and a scouting hawk to aid his hunt, Beastmaster never stalks the battlefield unprepared. Chopping through the forest with his axes, his stunning roar opens the way for his allies to devastate enemies.

abilities.name: beastmaster_wild_axes
abilities.description_zh: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
notes_zh: 此技能将摧毁树木。
notes_en: This ability destroys trees.

shard_loc.en: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.
shard_loc.zh: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

abilities.name: beastmaster_summon_razorback
abilities.description_zh: 兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.

abilities.name: beastmaster_summon_raptor
abilities.description_zh: 兽王召唤%hawk_count%只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以%hawk_base_attack_interval%秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并缠绕。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster summons %hawk_count% hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every %hawk_base_attack_interval%s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.

shard_loc.en: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.
shard_loc.zh: 战鹰的持续时间提升%bonus_duration%秒，并且额外召唤一只战鹰。

abilities.name: beastmaster_inner_beast
abilities.description_zh: 唤起兽王和他控制单位的内心狂怒，被动提高他们的攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
notes_zh: 破坏会使被动攻击速度加成失效。
notes_en: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.
facet_text_en: Attack Speed bonus is increased by the number of units affected by Inner Beast.
Can be activated to increase Beastmaster's attack speed and allow him to apply the Wild Axes damage amplification debuff on his attack target.
facet_text_zh: 攻击速度加成根据野性之心作用下的单位数量还会有所增加。
可以主动开启，提升兽王的攻击速度，并且他会对他的攻击目标施加野性之斧的伤害加深负面效果。

abilities.name: beastmaster_drums_of_slom
abilities.description_zh: 兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，%max_stacks%次攻击后降低至最短%min_drum_hit_interval%秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。使用原始咆哮时自动增加%primal_roar_stacks%层敲鼓叠加效果。
abilities.description_en: Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of %min_drum_hit_interval%s between hits after %max_stacks% attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.Using Primal Roar counts as %primal_roar_stacks% attacks.

abilities.name: beastmaster_primal_roar
abilities.description_zh: 兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并眩晕，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得%movement_speed%%%移动速度提升，持续%movement_speed_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain %movement_speed%%% movement speed for %movement_speed_duration% seconds.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_9
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_damage_amp}% Wild Axes Damage Amp Per Stack

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_5
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_ms} Movespeed to Beastmaster and his summons
talents_raw.desc_loc: The Movespeed Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_2
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_boar_bonus_damage} Damage to Beastmaster and his summons

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_6
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_hp} Health to Beastmaster and his summons
talents_raw.desc_loc: The Max Health Aura is global, persists through death, and affects Beastmaster and all his summons.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_beastmaster_wild_axe_cooldown
talents_raw.desc_loc: Axes still must return to Beastmaster before they can be cast again.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 痛苦女王的出手占尽先机，成群的敌人将在震耳欲聋的尖叫声中遭到毁灭。就算在猛攻中生还，敌人在逃生过程中还将被投掷的匕首减速，最终交出他的小命。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Queen of Pain strikes without warning, destroying gathered foes with deafening screams. Should an enemy survive her onslaught, she slows their escape with a throw of her dagger before finishing them off.

abilities.name: queenofpain_shadow_strike
abilities.description_zh: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续%duration%秒。每%damage_interval%秒会再造成一次伤害。
abilities.description_en: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位在持续时间内将逐秒缓慢地恢复至初始移动速度。
受到暗影突袭作用的单位在生命值低于最大值25%时可以被队友反补。
notes_en: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗影突袭变为%aoe_radius%范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。

abilities.name: queenofpain_blink
abilities.description_zh: 短距离传送，能让痛苦女王自由出入战场。
abilities.description_en: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
notes_zh: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
notes_en: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.

shard_loc.en: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals %shard_damage% damage in a %shard_aoe% AoE and silences the target for %shard_duration% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 在痛苦女王的闪烁起点和落地点各释放一次音爆。在%shard_aoe%范围内造成%shard_damage%点伤害，并沉默%shard_duration%秒。

abilities.name: queenofpain_scream_of_pain
abilities.description_zh: 痛苦女王发出刺耳的尖叫，对周围敌人造成伤害。造成伤害的%damage_reflected_to_self%%%会反弹回她身上。
abilities.description_en: The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.%damage_reflected_to_self%%% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
notes_zh: 痛苦尖叫能作用隐身单位。
痛苦尖叫无法被躲避。
对幻象造成的伤害不会反弹。反弹的伤害为减免前的，而且不致死。
反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: queenofpain_succubus
abilities.description_zh: 所有来源的技能吸血也对纯粹伤害生效。痛苦女王获得技能吸血，与敌人的距离越近效果越强。敌人距离她不到%close_radius%距离时达到最强效果，距离她超过%max_radius%距离时为最弱效果。
abilities.description_en: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.
facet_text_en: Spell Lifesteal also applies to Pure & Magical reflected damage.
facet_text_zh: 技能吸血也对反弹的纯粹和魔法伤害有效。

abilities.name: queenofpain_sonic_wave
abilities.description_zh: 痛苦女王在她面前制造出强大的声波，对其轨迹上的所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将他们击退。
abilities.description_en: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
notes_zh: 超声冲击波最远能伤害1150距离外的单位。
notes_en: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_queen_of_pain_1
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_attack_speed} Attack Speed against Shadow Striked units

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 剧毒术士给敌人带来的是慢性死亡。他可以持续散布喷毒的守卫来防御领土，如果敌人靠近，他还能释放一个巨型毒云，让他们快速衰亡。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Venomancer brings slow death to his enemies. Sprouting an endless army of toxin-spitting watchers to defend his territory, should foes draw near he can release a massive cloud of lingering poison to weaken enemies.

abilities.name: venomancer_venomous_gale
abilities.description_zh: 沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
abilities.description_en: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
notes_zh: 瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每%tick_interval%秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为%movement_slow%%%，减速效果将逐渐降低。
notes_en: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every %tick_interval% seconds.
Slow starts at %movement_slow%%%, and decreases as time passes.

shard_loc.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed by %shard_travel_tooltip%%%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, %num_created_wards_tooltip% Plague Wards are created around them.
shard_loc.zh: 施法距离和弹道速度提升%shard_travel_tooltip%%%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造%num_created_wards_tooltip%个瘟疫守卫。

abilities.name: venomancer_snakebite
abilities.description_zh: 剧毒术士召唤阿克特克的幼体，把它的毒牙刺入一个敌人，造成魔法伤害，并施加造成每秒伤害的剧毒。目标在感染时发动攻击，他就会再次受到初始伤害。
abilities.description_en: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

abilities.name: venomancer_plague_ward
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。
abilities.description_en: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.

abilities.name: venomancer_poison_sting
abilities.description_zh: 剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
notes_zh: 毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。
notes_en: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.

shard_loc.en: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.
shard_loc.zh: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

abilities.name: venomancer_noxious_plague
abilities.description_zh: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
abilities.description_en: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
notes_zh: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。
notes_en: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.

scepter_loc.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown% seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。
