heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 时间就是虚空假面的一切。时间经他加速可以缩短两地之间的行程，由他篡改可以消弭伤害，他还可以强行停下一片区域内的时间，毁灭他的敌人。只要给他充足的时间，他就能迎来自己的辉煌时代。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Time is everything to Faceless Void. He speeds time to dash between locations, manipulates it to dodge attacks, stops it in a large area to devastate his foes, and given enough of it to gather resources, he can make himself unbelievably powerful.

abilities.name: faceless_void_time_walk
abilities.description_zh: 冲到目标位置，并取消最近%backtrack_duration%秒内受到的任何伤害。
abilities.description_en: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。
notes_en: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.

scepter_loc.en: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.
scepter_loc.zh: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。

abilities.name: faceless_void_time_dilation
abilities.description_zh: 虚空假面将附近所有敌人困在一个时间膨胀场中，技能的冷却都会减慢。施加时每个受困的敌人都会获得一层时间膨胀的叠加效果，每有一个技能处于冷却就再获得一层。每层叠加效果造成每秒伤害，并降低移动速度和攻击速度降低。持续时间在时间结界作用下会暂停。
abilities.description_en: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
notes_zh: 不会影响物品的冷却时间。
效果期间叠加层数还会改变。施放技能后如果技能进入冷却就会提供一层叠加效果。如果技能冷却在时间膨胀期间完成，效果会被移除。
notes_en: Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.

shard_loc.en: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.
shard_loc.zh: 提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。

abilities.name: faceless_void_time_lock
abilities.description_zh: 攻击有一定概率将一个敌方目标锁定在时间中，再次发动攻击。
abilities.description_en: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
notes_zh: 不与碎颅锤叠加。
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

abilities.name: faceless_void_time_walk_reverse
abilities.description_zh: 时间漫游落地后1.5秒内可使用。施放时，自身将逆转时间漫游，回到上一个施放地点。不会影响生命值或触发神杖效果。
abilities.description_en: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

abilities.name: faceless_void_distortion_field
abilities.description_zh: 虚空假面附近%friendly_hero_distance%范围内以他或友方英雄为目标的敌方攻击弹道在进入目标%slow_distance_max%范围后会被减速%attack_projectile_slow%%%。
abilities.description_en: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a %friendly_hero_distance% radius of him get slowed by %attack_projectile_slow%%%, when they get  within %slow_distance_max% distance of their target.

abilities.name: faceless_void_chronosphere
abilities.description_zh: 在时空中创造一个泡状遮罩，将所有位于其中的单位定住，并使虚空假面在其内部来去自如。只有虚空假面和他控制的单位不受影响。在其中的隐形敌人会显形。
abilities.description_en: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
notes_zh: 能够定住所有单位和建筑，不论敌我。除了虚空假面控制的单位。
虚空假面不受任何时间结界的影响。
notes_en: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_faceless_void_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: Grants a {s:dodge_chance_pct}% chance to avoid damage entirely. Disabled by break.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last %backtrack_duration% seconds.

Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 无所畏惧地向敌人大步走去，冥魂大帝击晕敌人，用他的大刀阔剑让他们心悦诚服。就算敌人稍占上风，他的终极技能可以使他再度崛起，保证他还有机会挥起宝剑。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Striding fearlessly toward his enemies, Wraith King stuns his foes and slashes them into submission. Should his enemies gain the upper hand, his self-resurrecting ultimate ensures he'll have another chance to swing his sword.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_hellfire_blast
abilities.description_zh: 冥魂大帝向一个敌方单位发射冥魂火球，造成即时伤害和眩晕，并持续对目标造成伤害和减速。
abilities.description_en: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_bone_guard
abilities.description_zh: 击杀2个非英雄单位可获得1点能量，击杀1名英雄可获得2点能量。可以主动使用，消耗所有能量点数召唤可以复活一次的骷髅兵。骷髅兵享受吸血灵魂的吸血效果。
abilities.description_en: Gains a Charge for every 2 creeps killed and 2 charges per hero killed. Activate to spend all charges, summoning skeletons that respawn once when killed. Skeletons benefit from Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
对敌人施放冥火爆击会导致骷髅兵攻击该敌人。
notes_en: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Casting Wraithfire Blast on an enemy causes the skeletons to attack that enemy.

abilities.name: skeleton_king_mortal_strike
abilities.description_zh: 冥魂大帝被动地在攻击时造成额外伤害，本技能具有冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.

shard_loc.en: Mortal Strike hits curse their target, causing them to take %curse_damage_pct%%% of the initial attack damage again as Pure damage after a %curse_delay% second delay. Vampiric Spirit's lifesteal applies to the curse damage.
shard_loc.zh: 本命一击会诅咒目标，使其在%curse_delay%秒延迟后再次受到%curse_damage_pct%%%原攻击伤害的纯粹伤害。吸血灵魂的吸血效果对诅咒伤害有效。

abilities.name: skeleton_king_vampiric_spirit
abilities.description_zh: 冥魂大帝获得吸血效果。被击杀时冥魂大帝变为移动无视地形的冥魂，拥有额外攻击和移动速度，持续较短时间，自身死亡延后。冥魂大帝变为冥魂后无法重生。
abilities.description_en: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
notes_zh: 对于死亡被延缓的友军，其成为冥魂前所受的最后一击来源即为击杀者。
触发绝冥再生时没有效果。
破坏只会使被动吸血失效。
复活时间会根据冥魂持续时间而减少。
notes_en: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
Does not affect Reincarnate deaths.
Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.

scepter_loc.en: Turns Vampiric Spirit into an aura, allowing allied heroes to turn into wraiths when slain. Extends wraith duration.
scepter_loc.zh: 吸血灵魂变为光环，使友方英雄被击杀时也能变为冥魂。延长冥魂的持续时间。

abilities.name: skeleton_king_reincarnation
abilities.description_zh: 冥魂大帝倒下后，他飞散的冥魂会重组，使他复活。死亡时附近%slow_radius%范围内的敌人会被减速，会产生骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。可以对自身施放，使冥魂大帝立刻阵亡。
abilities.description_en: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
notes_zh: 如果魔法不足冥魂大帝将不会重生。
如果冥魂大帝拥有不朽之守护，同时绝冥再生不处于冷却状态，死亡后将首先触发绝冥再生。
重生后生命值和魔法值全满。
notes_en: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
If Wraith King has an Aegis and Reincarnation off cooldown, Reincarnation will trigger first.
Revives with full HP and Mana.

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 减少冷却时间。

facet_text_en: When reincarnating, %shard_skeleton_count% skeletons are spawned and attack each nearby enemy hero.
When reincarnating, nearby enemy heroes have their curse cooldowns reset.
facet_text_zh: 重生过程中会产生%shard_skeleton_count%个骷髅兵攻击附近每个敌方英雄。
重生过程中附近每个敌方英雄的诅咒冷却时间都会重置。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_wraith_king_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: Instead of being slowed, all enemy units within 900 range have the current level of Wraithfire Blast cast on them when Reincarnation triggers.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 死亡先知只要释放出她的怨灵大军，敌人和他们的建筑都将不堪一击。她的虫群可以产生一波又一波的伤害，她的猛攻近乎无人能挡，在直捣敌方基地的团队中她独挑大梁。
heroes.hero_summary_en: When she unleashes her army of ghosts, Death Prophet excels at demolishing enemies and their defenses alike. Leading her team's forces toward the enemy base with wave after damaging wave from her swarm, her onslaught can seem unstoppable.

abilities.name: death_prophet_carrion_swarm
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
abilities.description_en: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: death_prophet_silence
abilities.description_zh: 放出一个弹道，阻止目标区域内的敌人施放魔法。
abilities.description_en: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
notes_zh: 不能阻止使用物品。
notes_en: Doesn't prevent usage of items.
facet_text_en: Silenced enemies are also slowed.
facet_text_zh: 被沉默的敌人也会被减速。

abilities.name: death_prophet_spirit_siphon
abilities.description_zh: 创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。每秒吸取生命值。
abilities.description_en: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
notes_zh: 多个连接不能同时作用于一个目标。
notes_en: Cannot cast multiple on same target.

shard_loc.en: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.
shard_loc.zh: 吸魂巫术的能量点数提升%shard_bonus_charges%点，敌人连续%shard_consecutive_siphon_duration%秒受到吸魂巫术作用后会被恐惧%shard_fear_duration%秒。

abilities.name: death_prophet_witchcraft
abilities.description_zh: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。
abilities.description_en: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

abilities.name: death_prophet_exorcism
abilities.description_zh: 释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的治疗。对建筑造成50%%伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。
notes_en: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.

scepter_loc.en: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.
scepter_loc.zh: 敌人受到死亡先知的技能作用，或被死亡先知攻击时，会有一只恶灵飞出攻击敌人，造成高于平常的伤害，再返回使自身回复生命。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_death_prophet_exorcism_duration_on_kill
talents_raw.name_loc: Deaths During Exorcism Extend Duration By +{s:bonus_duration_increase_per_kill}s

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 幻影刺客的猎物现身之际，就是她出手之时。她快速地接近目标，轻松地躲过攻击，残忍地收割敌人的性命。没有一丝预兆，她的任何攻击都有可能置人于死地。
heroes.hero_summary_en: The moment she finds her prey, Phantom Assassin strikes. Instantly closing in on a target, she effortlessly dodges attacks as she relentlessly cuts away at her foe. Without warning, any one of her attacks could prove suddenly and brutally fatal.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
abilities.description_zh: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为%base_damage%+幻影刺客攻击伤害的%attack_factor_tooltip%%%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
abilities.description_en: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
notes_zh: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。
notes_en: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_phantom_strike
abilities.description_zh: 传送到一个单位身旁，敌我皆可，如果目标是敌方单位将进行攻击并获得攻速加成。
abilities.description_en: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_blur
abilities.description_zh: 幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
notes_zh: 通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。
notes_en: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.

shard_loc.en: Decreases Cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance %cooldown_refund_pct%%% of their max cooldown values.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快%cooldown_refund_pct%%%最高冷却时间。

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_fan_of_knives
abilities.description_zh: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加破坏效果。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_immaterial
abilities.description_zh:
幻影刺客专注一心，闪避敌人攻击的技艺得到提升。

与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。
abilities.description_en:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

abilities.name: phantom_assassin_coup_de_grace
abilities.description_zh: 幻影刺客的战斗技能得到精进，每次攻击时有几率获得致命专注。攻击时若带有致命专注，幻影刺客会消耗该效果，并且必定产生一次致命一击。窒碍短匕拥有额外几率获得致命专注。
abilities.description_en: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.
facet_text_en: Coup de Grace procs every %attacks_to_proc% attacks on the same hero or %attacks_to_proc_creeps% attacks on non hero units. Stifling Dagger counts as %two_tooltip% attacks.
facet_text_zh: 每攻击同个英雄%attacks_to_proc%次触发恩赐解脱，或者攻击同个非英雄单位%attacks_to_proc_creeps%次触发。窒碍短匕计为%two_tooltip%次攻击。

facets_loc: -{s:bonus_attacks_to_proc} Attacks to Trigger Coup de Grace

talents_raw.desc_loc: Launches two extra Stifling Daggers towards random visible enemies within the cast range.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 狡猾的欺诈师帕格纳在轰击敌人防御工事的同时能使他们的力量背叛他们。当他的幽冥守卫冲击周围胆敢施法的敌人时，他汲取敌人的生命，为下次突袭做好准备。
heroes.hero_summary_en: A crafty trickster, Pugna turns the enemy's power against itself as he blasts their defenses. While his nether ward strikes nearby foes that dare to cast a spell, he drains life from enemies to ensure he will be ready for the next assault.

abilities.name: pugna_nether_blast
abilities.description_zh: 一个爆炸性脉冲，对敌方单位造成伤害。对建筑物造成%structure_damage_mod%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area.  Deals %structure_damage_mod%%% damage to structures.
notes_zh: 伤害生效延迟为%delay%秒。
notes_en: Damage is delayed by %delay% seconds.

abilities.name: pugna_decrepify
abilities.description_zh: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入虚无状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了治疗效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。
abilities.description_en: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
notes_zh: 只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。
notes_en: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.

abilities.name: pugna_nether_ward
abilities.description_zh: 帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光。幽冥守卫造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。
abilities.description_en: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
notes_zh: 技能施放后幽冥守卫先造成伤害，技能才会生效，所以如果施法者因此阵亡，施放的技能将没有效果。
幽冥守卫可以受到衰老的作用。
幻象和非英雄单位对幽冥守卫造成25%的伤害。
notes_en: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.

shard_loc.en: Increases cast range to %AbilityCastRange%.
shard_loc.zh: 施法距离提升至%AbilityCastRange%。

facet_text_en: Nether Ward restores mana and health to Pugna based on how much damage is dealt.
facet_text_zh: 幽冥守卫会根据造成的伤害使帕格纳回复魔法和生命。

abilities.name: pugna_oblivion_savant
abilities.description_zh:
帕格纳可以在持续施法期间施放技能和使用物品。

每摧毁一座防御塔，帕格纳都会获得%tower_scale%%%技能增强。
abilities.description_en:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives %tower_scale%%% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

abilities.name: pugna_life_drain
abilities.description_zh:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。
abilities.description_en:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown by %abilitycooldown%s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by %spell_amp_drain_rate%%% per second up to a maximum of %spell_amp_drain_max%%% and increases his own, up to a maximum of %max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is %spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%% instead. Debuff lasts %spell_amp_drain_duration% seconds.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%abilitycooldown%秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们%spell_amp_drain_rate%%%技能伤害输出，最高可达到%spell_amp_drain_max%%%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到%max_spell_amp_drain_pct%%%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为%spell_amp_drain_rate_ward%%%。负面效果持续%spell_amp_drain_duration%秒。

shard_loc.en: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within %abilitycastrange% units of the ward for %shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
shard_loc.zh: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近%abilitycastrange%范围内所有敌方英雄，造成%shard_damage_pct_from_ward%%%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 圣堂刺客在战场上散布缓速的陷阱，她隐去自己的身形，准备好伏击她的猎物。当她跃起突击时，尖利的灵能之刃将刺穿敌人，任何反击都将在折光的护盾下消弭于无形。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Peppering the battlefield with slowing traps, Templar Assassin hides invisibly, ready to ambush her prey. Once she springs her attack, she shreds enemies with piercing psionic blades, and deflects counterattacks with her refracting shield.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_refraction
abilities.description_zh: 圣堂刺客变得高度难以捉摸，获得一个小型护盾，同时获得攻击力加成。攻击力加成和护盾效果相互独立，并且都是有限次数的效果。如果护盾被摧毁，只要还有能量点数就会再产生一个新的。如果单次伤害超过了剩余的护盾，该次的全部伤害都会被吸收。
abilities.description_en: Templar Assassin becomes highly elusive, gaining a small barrier and bonus to her damage.  The damage and avoidance effects are separate, and have a limited number of instances. If a barrier is consumed, a new one is created as long as there are charges left. If an instance of damage would deal more damage than the remaining barrier, all of the damage is absorbed.
notes_zh: 生命移除类伤害将无视折光（也不会减少折光次数）。
notes_en: Damage as HP Removal bypasses Refraction (it won't reduce the charges).

shard_loc.en: Increases bonus damage. Refraction can be cast while disabled.
shard_loc.zh: 攻击力加成提升。被控制时可以施放折光。

abilities.name: templar_assassin_meld
abilities.description_zh: 圣堂刺客将自己隐藏起来，只要静止不动将一直处于隐身状态。只要在隐匿状态下攻击敌人打破隐身，拉娜娅的攻击将对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低其护甲，持续%debuff_duration%秒。额外伤害和隐匿的负面效果会施加给灵能之刃飞溅距离内所有敌人。
abilities.description_en: Templar Assassin conceals herself, becoming invisible as long as she remains still. If Meld's invisibility is broken by attacking an enemy, Lanaya's attack will deal bonus damage to the enemy and reduce their armor for %debuff_duration% seconds. Bonus damage and debuffs from Meld are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
notes_zh: 除了停留在原地或持续施放灵能投射，其他任何动作都会打破隐匿效果。
隐匿的护甲降低作用对防御塔无效。
notes_en: Meld is broken by any action other than staying in position or channeling Psionic Projection.
Meld's armor reduction does not work against towers.
facet_text_en: Meld bonus damage and armor reductions are applied to all enemies in the Psi Blades split range.
When in Meld, Templar increases her attack range by up to an additional %attack_range_increase_max% range over %attack_range_increase_time%s.
facet_text_zh: 隐匿的额外伤害和护甲降低效果会施加给灵能之刃飞溅距离内所有敌人。
隐匿状态下圣堂刺客会在%attack_range_increase_time%秒内逐渐提升她的攻击距离，最高为额外%attack_range_increase_max%距离。

abilities.name: templar_assassin_psi_blades
abilities.description_zh: 圣堂刺客锋利的灵能之刃可以穿透敌人，对其正后方的敌方单位造成伤害，并且攻击距离得到提升。每对一个单位造成伤害后，飞溅伤害都会减少一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Templar Assassin's psi blades slice through the attacked unit, splitting and damaging enemy units directly behind it, while gaining bonus attack range. For each unit it damages, the split damage is reduced by a percentage.
notes_zh: 飞溅伤害可以伤害隐身单位。
重击等攻击特效只对主目标有效。
notes_en: Split damage hits invisible units.
Attack effects like Bash will only be applied to the main target.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_trap_teleport
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 圣堂刺客经过%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法后可以传送至任意灵能陷阱，到达时引爆灵能陷阱，陷阱总是最大效果，并且立刻造成%extra_damage%点额外伤害。灵能投射在持续施法时不会脱离隐匿效果。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Allows Templar Assassin to teleport to any Psionic Trap after channeling for %abilitychanneltime% seconds, detonating it upon arrival as if it was fully charged and instantly dealing %extra_damage% bonus damage. Channeling Psionic Projection does not break Meld.

abilities.name: templar_assassin_psionic_trap
abilities.description_zh: 圣堂刺客放下一个隐形的神秘陷阱监视敌人的动向。引爆后将减缓%trap_radius%范围内敌人的移动速度，陷阱放置时间越久，引爆后减速效果越强，最低为%movement_speed_min%%%，放置%trap_max_charge_duration%秒后引爆将达到最大减速效果，为%movement_speed_max%%%，并且还能造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Templar Assassin places mystical traps that invisibly monitor enemy movement. When sprung at her command, they exert a slowing influence of %movement_speed_min%%% in a %trap_radius% radius. Trap movement slow charges up to %movement_speed_max%%% after %trap_max_charge_duration% seconds. Deals damage after %trap_max_charge_duration%s.
notes_zh: 陷阱没有时间限制。
他们拥有隐形效果，渐隐时间为%trap_fade_time%秒，还拥有技能免疫状态。他们可以承受2次远程英雄的攻击，1次近战英雄的攻击，或4次非英雄单位的攻击。
陷阱的视野是250/250，不能阻止中立生物刷新。
notes_en: Traps last indefinitely.
They have invisibility that fades in over %trap_fade_time% seconds and spell immunity. They take 2 hits to kill by ranged heroes, 1 by melee heroes, and 4 by creeps.
Traps have 250/250 vision range and don't prevent neutral camps from spawning.

scepter_loc.en: When activated, traps now silence affected enemies.
scepter_loc.zh: 现在陷阱引爆后还会沉默受到作用的敌人。

abilities.name: templar_assassin_inner_peace
abilities.description_zh: 原地不动且未受到伤害超过%time_until_meditation%秒后，圣堂刺客开始冥想，获得生命恢复和魔法恢复加成，冥想%time_until_max_bonus%秒后达到最大加成。
abilities.description_en: When remaining stationary and not taking damage for %time_until_meditation%s, Templar Assassin begins meditating, gaining health and mana regeneration, reaching the maximum bonus after %time_until_max_bonus%s of meditating.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_templar_assassin_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: Applies a basic dispel to Templar Assassin.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 冥界亚龙不必近身就可以喷射致命的剧毒，无论是谁都抵受不了。他周身的多种毒素可以蚕食敌人的生命，使他们行动迟缓。冥界亚龙仅仅是在表演他的拿手绝活：不断地增加剂量。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Launching deadly poison from a distance, Viper poses a grave threat to whomever he targets. As his various toxins eat away at an enemy's health and slow their movement, Viper simply does what he does best: he keeps adding more poison.

abilities.name: viper_poison_attack
abilities.description_zh: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。
abilities.description_en: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.

shard_loc.en: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.
shard_loc.zh: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

abilities.name: viper_nethertoxin
abilities.description_zh: 蝮蛇向目标区域释放幽冥剧毒。范围内的单位持续受到伤害，在区域内停留的时间越长，受到的伤害也越高。同时他们的攻击速度会被降低。
abilities.description_en: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
notes_zh: 多个幽冥剧毒不会叠加。
notes_en: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.

abilities.name: viper_corrosive_skin
abilities.description_zh: 蝮蛇分泌出感染性的毒素，%max_range%范围内任何伤害它的敌人都将受到伤害，同时攻击速度也被降低。这种酸性分泌物还能提高蝮蛇的魔法抗性。
abilities.description_en: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a %max_range% radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
notes_zh: 与其他提升魔法抗性的物品和技能叠加。
破坏会使腐蚀皮肤不再施加效果。极恶俯冲还是会施加腐蚀皮肤。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

scepter_loc.en: Corrosive Skin applies %effect_multiplier%x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within %effect_multiplier_distance% distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to %nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%% increased effect after %nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙%effect_multiplier_distance%范围内的敌人施加%effect_multiplier%倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在%nethertoxin_bonus_pct_max_duration_tooltip%秒后，达到最高的%nethertoxin_bonus_pct%%%提升。

abilities.name: viper_nose_dive
abilities.description_zh: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且%corrosive_radius%范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续%effect_duration%秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。
abilities.description_en: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a %corrosive_radius% AoE for %effect_duration% seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

abilities.name: viper_predator
abilities.description_zh: 冥界亚龙的攻击会根据目标英雄缺失的生命百分比额外造成一次物理伤害。
abilities.description_en: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

abilities.name: viper_viper_strike
abilities.description_zh: 蝮蛇降低敌方目标单位的移动和攻击速度，同时破坏其被动技能并造成持续毒素伤害。移动和攻击速度会在毒素的持续时间内逐渐恢复。
abilities.description_en: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 露娜参战的速度往往飞快，她弹力十足的攻击可以将敌人粉碎。一旦陷入险境，她可以呼唤月相之力，洒下一道辉光或是一阵猛烈的月蚀，碾压顽抗的敌人。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Riding swiftly into battle, Luna tears into her enemies with attacks able to bounce between targets. When foes threaten, she calls down the power of the moon as a single searing beam or as a lunar barrage, crushing those who stand against her.

abilities.name: luna_lucent_beam
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂眩晕目标。
abilities.description_en: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.

shard_loc.en: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant %damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%% of the damage amount.
shard_loc.zh: 每次一名敌方英雄被月光击中时，露娜都会获得一个攻击力加成的状态效果。月蚀的月光提供%damage_buff_from_eclipse_pct%%%数值。

abilities.name: luna_lunar_orbit
abilities.description_zh: 产生%rotating_glaives%个月刃在露娜身旁%rotating_glaives_movement_radius%范围内旋转。任何碰到月刃的敌方单位都会受到露娜攻击伤害的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.

shard_loc.en: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains %bonus_movement_speed%%% bonus movement speed.
shard_loc.zh: 提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得%bonus_movement_speed%%%移动速度加成。

facet_text_en: Rotating glaives provide damage reduction while active.
facet_text_zh: 旋转的月刃在开启时提供承受伤害降低的效果。

abilities.name: luna_moon_glaive
abilities.description_zh: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳造成的伤害都会减少。
abilities.description_en: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
notes_zh: 月刃不会触发致命一击以外的任何攻击特效。
notes_en: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.

abilities.name: luna_lunar_blessing
abilities.description_zh: 提升露娜和附近%radius%范围内友方英雄的攻击力，露娜获得双倍的攻击力加成。夜晚期间月之祝福为全地图生效，并且露娜受到福佑后夜间视野提升。
abilities.description_en: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.

abilities.name: luna_eclipse
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一次月蚀，以她当前技能等级的月光随机打击附近敌人。月光只有伤害效果，不会造成眩晕，而且单一目标只能受到有限次数的打击。月蚀会暂时将白天变为黑夜。
abilities.description_en: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
notes_zh: 如果露娜没有升级月光，月蚀将无法造成伤害，但是变为黑夜效果有效。
露娜阵亡后月光马上中止。
不能伤害隐身单位。
每道月光之间都有%beam_interval%秒的间隔。神杖升级后间隔为%beam_interval_scepter%秒。
notes_en: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a %beam_interval% seconds gap between beams, %beam_interval_scepter% seconds with scepter.

scepter_loc.en: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.
scepter_loc.zh: 露娜可以对友方单位或自身施放月蚀，使月蚀的效果跟随目标，或者对一片区域施放。增加月光数量，减少月蚀持续时间，并且移除单体打击次数上限，月光的产生间隔缩短一半。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_luna_5
talents_raw.name_loc: Lucent Beam Hits An Additional Target
talents_raw.desc_loc: Random target within {s:bonus_lucent_beam_bounce_range} range of the primary target.

Creates %rotating_glaives% glaives that rotate %rotating_glaives_movement_radius% radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.

Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within %radius% range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 当龙骑士化身为可怕的古龙形态，他面前的敌人都会不禁感到害怕。身坚甲厚又能随机应变，眩晕他的敌人并使他们烈焰焚身，他让他的盟友获得凌驾对手的胜势。
heroes.hero_summary_en: When he takes on his terrifying dragon form, Dragon Knight strikes fear into any who face him. Strong and adaptable, he can stun his enemies and burn all in front of him, often providing his allies the momentum they need to carry them to victory.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_breathe_fire
abilities.description_zh: 向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
abilities.description_en: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.
facet_text_en: Damage type changed to Physical.
facet_text_zh: 伤害类型改为物理。

abilities.name: dragon_knight_dragon_tail
abilities.description_zh: 龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成眩晕和伤害。
abilities.description_en: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.
facet_text_en: Damage type changed to Physical.
facet_text_zh: 伤害类型改为物理。

abilities.name: dragon_knight_wyrms_wrath
abilities.description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。
abilities.description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

abilities.name: dragon_knight_fireball
abilities.description_zh: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。
abilities.description_en: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.
facet_text_en: Damage type changed to Physical.
facet_text_zh: 伤害类型改为物理。

abilities.name: dragon_knight_dragon_blood
abilities.description_zh: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的生命恢复和护甲。在古龙形态下生命恢复和护甲均提升%regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%%。
abilities.description_en: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  Regen and armor are increased by %regen_and_armor_multiplier_during_dragon_form%%% during Elder Dragon Form.
facet_text_en: Attacks deal additional magic damage to enemy units. Spells and items have increased AoE.
Attacks are filled with lethal poison that affects enemy units and structures, reducing armor and dealing physical damage over time.
Attacks are filled with frost that affects enemy units, slowing movement speed, attack speed, and reducing health restoration.
facet_text_zh: 攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害，并且技能和物品的作用范围提升。
攻击附带致命的毒素，可作用于敌方单位和建筑，降低护甲并持续造成物理伤害。
攻击带有冰霜，会作用于敌方单位，降低移动速度和攻击速度，同时降低生命回复。

abilities.name: dragon_knight_elder_dragon_form
abilities.description_zh: 龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
abilities.description_en: Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.

scepter_loc.en: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.
scepter_loc.zh: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 戴泽天生就是战场上伙伴的辅助，受伤的队友在他的保护下能将死亡撒遍敌军之内。他奇特的魔法可以编织附近的铠甲，敌人大幅衰弱之际友军将异常坚挺。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Born to support his cohorts in battle, Dazzle keeps wounded allies alive so they might later rain death upon the enemy. His strange magic weaves its way into nearby armor, weakening enemies and strengthening friends.

abilities.name: dazzle_poison_touch
abilities.description_zh: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
abilities.description_en: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
notes_zh: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。
notes_en: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.name: dazzle_shallow_grave
abilities.description_zh: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的治疗效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
abilities.description_en: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
notes_zh: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。
notes_en: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

abilities.name: dazzle_shadow_wave
abilities.description_zh: 放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，治疗的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到治疗效果。
abilities.description_en: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
notes_zh: 优先治疗友方英雄
如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。
notes_en: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

scepter_loc.en: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.
scepter_loc.zh: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且治疗附近友军，数值为%scepter_heal_pct%%%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

abilities.name: dazzle_innate_weave
abilities.description_zh: 戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
abilities.description_en: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.

shard_loc.en: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
shard_loc.zh: 对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗%ally_heal%点。

facet_text_en: Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.
Weave applies %enemy_multiplier%x stacks to enemies.
facet_text_zh: 编织会对友军施加%ally_multiplier%倍叠加层数。编织的每层叠加效果会使来自戴泽的<font color='#07d738'>治疗</font>效果增强%heal_amplification_pct%%%。
编织会对敌人施加%enemy_multiplier%倍叠加层数。

abilities.name: dazzle_nothl_projection
abilities.description_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：剧毒之触带有妖术效果；薄葬结束时会治疗；暗影波的冷却时间变短。效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
abilities.description_en: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
notes_zh: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过%leash_start%距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。
notes_en: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.

shard_loc.en: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
shard_loc.zh: 虚无投影可以在戴泽被控制时施放。他在虚无之境时治疗效果得到增强。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_dazzle_poison_touch_attack_range_bonus
talents_raw.desc_loc: +{s:bonus_attack_range_bonus} Attack Range when attacking an enemy affected by Poison Touch

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 发条技师射出钩爪使自己飞入敌人人群中，将目标隔离后用弹片冲击搅得他们晕头转向。他用实用的照明弹侦察战场，不费吹灰之力就能找到合适的目标。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Launching himself into enemies with his grappling hookshot, Clockwerk isolates targets and blasts them apart with disorienting shrapnel. As he scouts the battlefield with his handy flares, he never has trouble finding targets to send himself toward.

abilities.name: rattletrap_battery_assault
abilities.description_zh: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
notes_zh: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。
notes_en: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.

abilities.name: rattletrap_power_cogs
abilities.description_zh: 在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且%mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出%projectile_distance%距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
abilities.description_en: Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned. Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
notes_zh: 齿轮可以震退隐身单位。
notes_en: Cogs can shock invisible units.

abilities.name: rattletrap_rocket_flare
abilities.description_zh: 向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供%duration%秒击中区域的视野。
abilities.description_en: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: rattletrap_overclocking
abilities.description_zh: 使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。喷气背包：移动得更快。持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。
abilities.description_en: Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.Jetpack: Moves faster.Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

abilities.name: rattletrap_jetpack
abilities.description_zh: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。
abilities.description_en: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

abilities.name: rattletrap_hookshot
abilities.description_zh: 向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近%stun_radius%范围内所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a %stun_radius% radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
notes_zh: 发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。
notes_en: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.
facet_text_en: If there's another allied hero within %radius_ally% of Hookshot's hit target, Clockwerk and all allies in the area receive bonus armor, while refunding a portion of Hookshot's cooldown and manacost.
facet_text_zh: 如果发射钩爪击中的目标附近%radius_ally%范围内还有另一名友方英雄，那么发条技师和范围内所有友军都会获得护甲加成，并且部分退还冷却时间和魔法消耗。

abilities.name: rattletrap_armor_power
abilities.description_zh:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加%damage_per_armor%%%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。
abilities.description_en:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by %damage_per_armor%%% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
facet_text_en: Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +%armor_per_chainmail% armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.
facet_text_zh: 发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+%armor_per_chainmail%点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.

Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by %mana_burn_as_damage_pct%%% of the mana burned. Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to %projectile_distance% distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 拉席克强大的魔法可以摧枯拉朽般将敌人和他们的坚塔毁灭。灾难性的敕令让他在敌方领地中长驱直入，把握良机将大地撕裂的能力可以使敌人动弹不得，让无情的盟友将他们一一终结。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Leshrac's powerful spells lay waste to enemies and their defenses alike. Pushing deep into enemy territory with his devastating edict, careful timing of his ability to split the earth will stun foes, allowing his merciless allies to finish them off.

abilities.name: leshrac_split_earth
abilities.description_zh: 撕裂敌人脚下的大地。造成伤害和短暂的眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
notes_zh: 撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
技能经过%delay%秒延迟后生效。
notes_en: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.

shard_loc.en: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location %shard_max_count% additional times, with a %shard_secondary_delay% second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by %shard_radius_increase%. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.
shard_loc.zh: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复%shard_max_count%次，重复间隔为%shard_secondary_delay%秒。每次作用范围增加%shard_radius_increase%。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。

abilities.name: leshrac_diabolic_edict
abilities.description_zh: 使拉席克周围的区域充满魔法性爆炸，对敌方单位和建筑造成纯粹伤害。范围内的敌人越少，他们受到的伤害就越高。
abilities.description_en: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
notes_zh: 即使拉席克死亡，爆炸还是会在原地继续。
notes_en: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.
facet_text_en: Diabolic Edict hits enemies with an increased explosion rate but it no longer damages buildings.
facet_text_zh: 恶魔敕令以更高的爆炸速度击中敌人，但是不再对建筑造成伤害。

abilities.name: leshrac_lightning_storm
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一片闪电风暴攻击目标敌方单位，并跳跃到附近的敌方单位。被攻击的敌人将会被降低移动速度。
abilities.description_en: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.

abilities.name: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm
abilities.description_zh: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。
abilities.description_en: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

abilities.name: leshrac_defilement
abilities.description_zh: 拉席克的每点智力都会提供%aoe_per_int%作用范围加成。
abilities.description_en: Leshrac gains %aoe_per_int% Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.

abilities.name: leshrac_pulse_nova
abilities.description_zh: 拉席克在他周围创造破坏性的能量波，每秒对附近敌方单位造成伤害。每次脉冲都会消耗拉席克的魔法。
abilities.description_en: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_leshrac_7
talents_raw.name_loc: Diabolic Edict Hits An Additional Target

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_leshrac_pulse_nova_lightning
talents_raw.desc_loc: Lightning Storm hits a random enemy in Pulse Nova radius every {s:bonus_pulse_nova_lightning_interval}s with a single bolt. Prioritizes heroes.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 无论是赶赴战场援助友军，还是累积资源准备下次突袭，自然先知仿佛无处不在。他可以随意传送到任何地方，立刻创造一群狂暴的树木为他作战，他出手的角度总是出乎敌人意料。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Whether in the thick of battle or gathering resources for his next assault, Nature's Prophet seems to be everywhere. Teleporting at will to any location and instantly creating an army of violent trees to fight for him, he attacks where enemies least expect.

abilities.name: furion_sprout
abilities.description_zh: 使一圈树木在一个单位的周围发芽，将其困在其中并造成伤害，提供%vision_range%范围内的视野。
abilities.description_en: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a %vision_range% radius.
notes_zh: 发芽的施放目标可以是任何单位或者地面。
发芽产生的树木跟英雄技能的相互作用与平常树木相同。
notes_en: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.
facet_text_en: After Sprout is cast, all trees in a %healing_radius% radius emit an aura that heals nearby allies. Allied Tangos provide double the heal duration when consuming a tree created by Sprout.
facet_text_zh: 施放发芽后附近%healing_radius%范围内的树木会散发出治疗附近友军的光环。友军的树之祭祀吞食发芽产生的树木会提供双倍治疗时间。

abilities.name: furion_teleportation
abilities.description_zh: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。
abilities.description_en: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
notes_zh: 魔耗和冷却时间都是在技能施放结束后结算。自然先知在施放技能时被打断将不会耗费魔法或使技能进入冷却。
施法开始后，目标地点将产生视觉特效，对队友和敌人均可见。
notes_en: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

abilities.name: furion_force_of_nature
abilities.description_zh: 将一片树木转化成由自然先知操控的树人。
abilities.description_en: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
notes_zh: 自然的呼唤产生的树人不会超过目标区域内树木的数量。
notes_en: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.
facet_text_en: Summons a reduced number of stronger Treants with reinforced damage.
facet_text_zh: 召唤的树人数量减少，但是威力变大，而且拥有坚锐技能。

abilities.name: furion_curse_of_the_forest
abilities.description_zh: 对%range%范围内所有敌方英雄施加诅咒，使他们在迷雾中显形，根据%radius%范围内树木的数量对他们造成减速和持续伤害。在此情况下树人也被视为树木。
abilities.description_en: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within %range% range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within %radius% radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

abilities.name: furion_spirit_of_the_forest
abilities.description_zh: 附近的每棵树都会让自然先知获得%damage_per_tree_pct%%%攻击力加成。每个树人也会让自然先知获得若干倍数的加成，不论相距多远。树人也拥有这个技能。
abilities.description_en: Nature's Prophet gains %damage_per_tree_pct%%% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
notes_zh: 树人会从周围的树木和其他树人获得加成效果。
树精卫士不提供任何加成。
notes_en: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.
facet_text_en: Treant multiplier increased.
facet_text_zh: 树人的倍数增加。

abilities.name: furion_wrath_of_nature
abilities.description_zh: 伤害性的能量在全地图跳跃，打击视野中的敌人，会先从距目标点最近的敌人开始打击。每击中一个敌人伤害都会增加，击中%max_targets%个目标后达到最高伤害。
abilities.description_en: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after %max_targets% are hit.
notes_zh: 自然的愤怒只能伤害视野内的单位。
可以通过点击小地图施放；初始目标将选择施放地点最近的有效单位。
notes_en: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.

scepter_loc.en: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from %scepter_min_entangle_duration%s up to %scepter_max_entangle_duration%s seconds at max bounce.
scepter_loc.zh: 缠绕所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从%scepter_min_entangle_duration%秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为%scepter_max_entangle_duration%秒。

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 只要噬魂鬼接近了他的猎物，他连一线生机都不会给予。他可以在友方英雄和小兵体内潜伏，接近敌人时他从宿主体内爆发而出，用利爪将大惊失色的敌人撕碎。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Should Lifestealer get close to his prey, there is little that can save them. Travelling within a creep or an allied hero, once he nears a foe he explodes from his host body, surprising enemies and tearing into them with his claws.

abilities.name: life_stealer_rage
abilities.description_zh:
进入狂暴状态，变成减益免疫，提升魔法抗性和移动速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: life_stealer_open_wounds
abilities.description_zh: 噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害回复一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
abilities.description_en: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
notes_zh: 撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。
notes_en: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.
facet_text_en: Open Wounds' cooldown is refreshed if a unit dies while afflicted by Open Wounds.
facet_text_zh: 如果有单位在撕裂伤口效果下阵亡，撕裂伤口的冷却时间将会重置。

abilities.name: life_stealer_feast
abilities.description_zh: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得治疗。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。
abilities.description_en: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
notes_zh: 对友军和敌人有效。对肉山无效。
回复量与造成伤害相互独立。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
facet_text_en: Feast's max HP per hero kill is increased.
facet_text_zh: 盛宴的击杀英雄获得生命上限已经提升。

abilities.name: life_stealer_ghoul_frenzy
abilities.description_zh: 被动提升噬魂鬼的攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.

abilities.name: life_stealer_infest
abilities.description_zh:
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 足智多谋的黑暗贤者擅长操控敌人的方位。他可以创造真空，把敌人卷入盟友的攻击中，再将他们扯入复制之墙中，让敌人身受自身之力的反噬。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Versatile and strategic, Dark Seer excels at manipulating the positions of his enemies. Vacuuming foes into the attacks of his allies, he can turn enemy strength against itself by pulling foes through his replicating wall.

abilities.name: dark_seer_vacuum
abilities.description_zh: 黑暗贤者在目标区域制造一个真空环境，将周围的敌方单位吸入，具有打断效果并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
notes_zh: 此技能可以打断持续施法。
牵引过程为%duration%秒，伤害在牵引后产生。
真空中央附近的树木将会被摧毁。
notes_en: This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over %duration% seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.

abilities.name: dark_seer_ion_shell
abilities.description_zh: 将目标用一个尖刺之盾包裹起来，对周围的敌人造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
notes_zh: 每%tick_interval%秒造成一次若干伤害。
离子外壳对其作用单位没有伤害。
如果对已经套上离子外壳的单位再次施放，新的离子外壳会取代旧的。
notes_en: Deals small amounts of damage in %tick_interval% second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.

abilities.name: dark_seer_surge
abilities.description_zh: 为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得相位移动状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
abilities.description_en: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
notes_zh: 奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。
notes_en: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.

shard_loc.en: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.
shard_loc.zh: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为%trail_radius%，持续%trail_duration%秒，对附近的敌人造成%trail_move_slow%%%减速，并且每秒造成%trail_damage%点伤害，伤害间隔为%trail_damage_interval%秒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。

abilities.name: dark_seer_normal_punch
abilities.description_zh: 被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去%recent_duration%秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和眩晕。移动%max_distance%距离以上将造成最大威力。
abilities.description_en: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past %recent_duration% seconds. Max power is reached after %max_distance% distance moved.

abilities.name: dark_seer_aggrandize
abilities.description_zh:
黑暗贤者从每点智力获得%int_to_atkspd%攻击速度。

黑暗贤者升级时会恢复最大生命值和魔法值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en:
Dark Seer gains %int_to_atkspd% Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

abilities.name: dark_seer_wall_of_replica
abilities.description_zh: 制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
abilities.description_en: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
notes_zh: 幻象不会产生幻象。
每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。
notes_en: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 克林克兹无形地穿梭在战场上，没人能逃过他的伏击。他的步伐和箭矢迅疾异常，只要召唤出一队炽烈同胞助阵，灼热的箭雨过后就是敌人的死亡。
heroes.hero_summary_en: When Clinkz stalks invisibly through the battlefield, none are safe from ambush. Swift of foot and arrow, he rains fiery death upon his foes, calling upon an army of blazing compatriots to bolster his assault.

abilities.name: clinkz_strafe
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹获得攻击速度和攻击距离加成。克林克兹%strafe_skeleton_radius%范围内现有的骷髅弓手也会获得攻击距离加成和%archer_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度加成。施放扫射不会脱离骨隐步的隐身状态。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a %strafe_skeleton_radius% radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and %archer_attack_speed_pct%%% of the attack speed bonus.  Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.
facet_text_en: Clinkz and each Skeleton Archer apply a stacking debuff, one stack per attacking Skeleton Archer, causing them to miss %bonus_blind_pct%%% of their attacks per stack for %debuff_duration%s. Applies to buildings as well.
facet_text_zh: 克林克兹和每个骷髅弓手都会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，每个攻击的骷髅弓手会施加一层叠加效果，每层会使目标的%bonus_blind_pct%%%攻击落空，持续%debuff_duration%秒。也会对建筑施加。

abilities.name: clinkz_searing_arrows
abilities.description_zh: 让克林克兹的箭矢带有火焰，造成更多伤害。骷髅弓手在攻击克林克兹的攻击目标时会发射灼热之箭，造成%skeleton_damage_pct%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en: Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for %skeleton_damage_pct%%% damage.
notes_zh: 灼热之箭能对建筑造成伤害。
伤害直接作为物理伤害加到克林克兹的攻击伤害中。
notes_en: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.

abilities.name: clinkz_death_pact
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
notes_zh: 如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。
notes_en: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
facet_text_en: Death Pact teleports Clinkz towards his victim. Reduces Death Pact cooldown. If Alt-Cast behavior is activated, or Clinkz is Rooted or Leashed, he will not teleport to the target location.
facet_text_zh: 死亡契约会把克林克兹传送至目标。降低死亡契约的充能时间。如果设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），或者克林克兹被缠绕或束缚，那他就不会传送至目标地点。

abilities.name: clinkz_burning_barrage
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
notes_zh: 攻击距离加成会提升炽烈火雨的长度。
notes_en: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.

abilities.name: clinkz_burning_army
abilities.description_zh: 在目标地点召唤一列烈焰骷髅弓手。
abilities.description_en: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

abilities.name: clinkz_wind_walk
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低%skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal %skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
notes_zh: 渐隐时间为%fade_time%秒。
notes_en: Has a fadetime of %fade_time% seconds.

abilities.name: clinkz_infernal_shred
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹和他的骷髅弓手会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使他们的攻击可以穿透最高目标%max_armor_piercing_pct%%%总物理护甲（不会降低他们的护甲）。克林克兹每次攻击施加%hero_stacks%%%，骷髅弓手施加%skeleton_stacks%%%。持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to %max_armor_piercing_pct%%% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor).  Clinkz applies %hero_stacks%%% per attack, and skeletons apply %skeleton_stacks%%%. Lasts %duration% seconds.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_clinkz_3
talents_raw.desc_loc: A Searing Arrows attack will send another arrow into a random enemy within Clinkz's attack range.

Any current Skeleton Archers within a %strafe_skeleton_radius% radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and %archer_attack_speed_pct%%% of the attack speed bonus.  Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 作为战场前线的卫士，全能骑士总是渴望加入团队的战斗。不论是使用伤敌的魔法治疗队友，还是手握强大的战锤敲打敌人，他总是能帮助盟友免受伤害。
heroes.hero_summary_en: A guardian at the front lines of battle, Omniknight is always eager to join his team in battle. Whether healing an ally with a spell that also harms nearby foes, or battering an enemy with his mighty hammer, he protects his allies from harm.

abilities.name: omniknight_purification
abilities.description_zh: 立即治疗一个友方单位，并对周围的敌军造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.

shard_loc.en: After a %recast_delay%s delay, the target is Purified again with %recast_effectiveness_pct%%% effectiveness.
shard_loc.zh: %recast_delay%秒延迟后目标会再次受到%recast_effectiveness_pct%%%威力的洗礼。

abilities.name: omniknight_martyr
abilities.description_zh: 提供减益免疫状态和%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性，以及额外生命恢复。
abilities.description_en: Grants Debuff Immunity with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.

abilities.name: omniknight_hammer_of_purity
abilities.description_zh: 全能骑士将神圣之力注入他的战锤，使他的攻击距离提升，会根据基础攻击力的一定百分比造成纯粹伤害，并且使目标短时间内被减速。全能骑士会在%heal_duration%秒内回复%heal_pct%%%造成的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration. Omniknight heals for %heal_pct%%% of the damage dealt over %heal_duration%s.

abilities.name: omniknight_degen_aura
abilities.description_zh: 削弱过于靠近的敌方单位的移动能力，降低其移动速度。
abilities.description_en: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
notes_zh: 对减益免疫单位无效。
notes_en: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.
facet_text_en: Omniknight's damage to a target is increased by %bonus_damage_per_stack%%% for every %stack_interval%s they spend affected by the aura.
facet_text_zh: 目标受到光环作用的时间每达到%stack_interval%秒，全能骑士对该目标的伤害都会增加%bonus_damage_per_stack%%%。

abilities.name: omniknight_guardian_angel
abilities.description_zh: 全能骑士召唤出守护天使，使全能骑士附近的所有友方单位对物理伤害免疫。
abilities.description_en: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.

scepter_loc.en: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.
scepter_loc.zh: 守护天使的作用范围为全地图，影响建筑并增强生命回复。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 近斗使人无可奈何，远战又招招致命，魅惑魔女只要出手就能刺穿敌人，她的攻击融入了魔力后敌人逃得越远，所受伤害也越高。不论是在敌人身上施加强大的减速效果，还是魅惑丛林中的生物来助战，她总是不乏制胜的手段。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Harmful up close and lethal at a distance, Enchantress skewers foes with attacks imbued to become more damaging the further they fly. Whether inflicting powerful slows on her enemies or charming forest creatures to fight her battles, she is never short of tools to win a fight.

abilities.name: enchantress_impetus
abilities.description_zh: 激活后每次攻击都有附魔效果，根据与目标的距离造成额外伤害。目标越远，伤害越高。对幻象造成双倍伤害。
abilities.description_en: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
notes_zh: 造成伤害上限的距离是%distance_cap%。
计算与目标之间的距离在攻击弹道击中目标时。
notes_en: The damage is capped at %distance_cap% distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.

abilities.name: enchantress_enchant
abilities.description_zh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 可以转化幻象。
notes_en: Illusions can be converted.

scepter_loc.en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。

facet_text_en: Cast Range of Enchant is increased. If the enemy is a hero, Enchantress and units she controls have increased attack range against the target.
facet_text_zh: 魅惑的施法距离增加。如果目标是英雄，魅惑魔女和她控制的单位对目标的攻击距离增加。

abilities.name: enchantress_natures_attendants
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一群小精灵治疗魅惑魔女以及身边的友方单位。
abilities.description_en: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
notes_zh: 不会选择满血单位进行治疗。
notes_en: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.
facet_text_en: Whenever Enchantress takes more than %overprotective_damage_threshold% damage from enemy heroes, %overprotective_wisp_count% wisp appears for %overprotective_wisp_duration%s to heal her. A maximum of %overprotective_max_wisps% overprotective wisps can exist at the same time.
facet_text_zh: 只要魅惑魔女受到敌方英雄的伤害超过%overprotective_damage_threshold%点，%overprotective_wisp_count%个小精灵就会出现，%overprotective_wisp_duration%秒内进行治疗。同一时间最多只能存在%overprotective_max_wisps%个过度保护的小精灵。

abilities.name: enchantress_bunny_hop
abilities.description_zh: 向后跳跃，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，并向魅惑魔女的攻击距离+%bonus_attack_range%范围内最远的%attack_targets%个敌方单位发动一次附有推进的攻击。
abilities.description_en: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the %attack_targets% furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + %bonus_attack_range%.

abilities.name: enchantress_little_friends
abilities.description_zh: 魅惑魔女缠绕一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: enchantress_untouchable
abilities.description_zh: 魅惑魔女让她的敌人神魂颠倒，受到他们攻击时会降低其攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
notes_zh: 所有直接攻击魅惑魔女的敌方单位都会被减速。
减速效果在攻击单位产生攻击动作时出现，而不是伤害生效时。
notes_en: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.

abilities.name: enchantress_rabblerouser
abilities.description_zh: 魅惑魔女使所有中立生物和魅惑魔女控制下的单位对敌方英雄造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
notes_zh: 不会影响劝化的中立生物、痛苦魔方和肉山。
notes_en: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_enchantress_enchant_armor
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_armor} Armor for Enchantress and her units

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_enchantress_enchant_attackspeed
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_attackspeed} Attack Speed for Enchantress and her units

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_enchantress_enchant_health_damage
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_health} Health / +{s:bonus_bonus_damage} Damage  for Enchantress and her units

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 随着生命的不断流失，哈斯卡的杀敌能力大幅上升。他的终极技能可以瞬间移除自己和敌人的部分生命，而在濒死时他炽热的长矛已经掷得毁天灭地。
heroes.hero_summary_en: As his health lowers, Huskar's ability to slay enemies grows considerably. Able to instantly remove a portion of both his and an enemy's health with his ultimate, when near death he is able to throw his burning spears with devastating speed.

abilities.name: huskar_inner_fire
abilities.description_zh: 在炽烈的狂暴下将附近所有敌人击退至固定距离外，造成伤害和沉默。
abilities.description_en: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.

abilities.name: huskar_burning_spear
abilities.description_zh: 哈斯卡将其长矛点燃，在普通攻击的同时对敌方单位造成持续伤害。多次攻击会造成持续伤害叠加。每次攻击都将牺牲哈斯卡部分生命值。
abilities.description_en: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
notes_zh: 沸血之矛在多次施放到目标身上效果可以叠加。没有叠加上限。
哈斯卡不能使用此技能自杀。
炙矛可热不会对肉山造成额外的最大生命值烧灼伤害。
notes_en: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.

scepter_loc.en: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.
scepter_loc.zh: 沸血之矛会对哈斯卡攻击距离内随机敌人额外发射%multishot_targets%支长矛。

facet_text_en: Burning Spears also burns enemies for a percentage of their max health. Costs Max Health instead of Current Health.
facet_text_zh: 沸血之矛还会燃烧敌人一定百分比的最大生命值。会消耗最大生命值，而不是当前生命值。

abilities.name: huskar_berserkers_blood
abilities.description_zh: 哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
notes_zh: 加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，%hp_threshold_max%%%生命时达到最大加成。
notes_en: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than %hp_threshold_max%%% HP.

shard_loc.en: Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh:
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散

facet_text_en:
Berserker's Blood can be activated for a health cost. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
facet_text_zh:
狂战士之血可以消耗一定生命来主动开启。驱散哈斯卡，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散

abilities.name: huskar_blood_magic
abilities.description_zh: 哈斯卡没有魔法值。物品的魔法消耗会转换为生命消耗。哈斯卡的生命消耗为魔法伤害，可以被魔法抗性减少。
abilities.description_en: Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

abilities.name: huskar_life_break
abilities.description_zh:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。
notes_en: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.

scepter_loc.en: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。

facet_text_en: Life Break also slows enemies in a radius around the target.
Life Break also heals friendly units in a radius around the target.
facet_text_zh: 牺牲还会使目标附近的敌人减速。
牺牲还会治疗目标附近的友方单位。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 太阳一旦下山，暗夜魔王的狩猎就会开始。他冲过暗影斑驳的丛林，在缓速的虚空中捕获猎物，将他们撕成碎片。如果日出威胁到了他的笼罩，他还能使天空暗淡，延长他的袭击。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Once the sun goes down, Night Stalker's hunt begins. Charging through the shadowy forests, he snares prey in a slowing void as he tears them to shreds. Should sunrise threaten to end his terror, he can darken the skies to extend his onslaught.

abilities.name: night_stalker_void
abilities.description_zh: 制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂眩晕，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
abilities.description_en: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
notes_zh: 虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。
notes_en: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.

shard_loc.en: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.
shard_loc.zh: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。

facet_text_en: Enemies affected by Void do not share vision with their allies. Affected enemies take damage per second when they are not visible to their allies.
Increases the max level of Void. Level %max_level% Void at night becomes ground targeted, increases movement and attack slow, and applies to a %cast_radius_tooltip% AoE.
facet_text_zh: 虚空作用下的敌人不会与友军共享视野。当不在友军视野中，他们会受到每秒伤害。
提升虚空的最高等级。%max_level%级虚空在夜间变为以范围为目标的技能，移动速度和攻击速度降低效果提升，并且施加%cast_radius_tooltip%范围效果。

special_values.name: invisible_damage_pers
special_values.heading_loc: DAMAGE PER SECOND WHEN NOT VISIBLE:

abilities.name: night_stalker_crippling_fear
abilities.description_zh: 暗夜魔王恐吓附近所有敌人，使他们在他身边时被沉默，并受到伤害。效果在夜晚持续更久。
abilities.description_en: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.

abilities.name: night_stalker_midnight_feast
abilities.description_zh: 暗夜魔王攻击敌方单位时治疗自身。在夜晚可以主动施放，秒杀一个非远古非英雄单位，并回复暗夜魔王的最大生命值和最大魔法值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
notes_zh: 攻击获得的生命值受到生命回复的影响，攻击非英雄目标时会减少。
notes_en: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.

abilities.name: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night
abilities.description_zh: 暗夜魔王在夜晚如鱼得水，攻击和移动都变得迅速。
abilities.description_en: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.

scepter_loc.en: Increases bonus movement speed by %bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%% and attack speed by %bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.
scepter_loc.zh: 移动速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_movement_speed_pct_night%%%，攻击速度加成提升%bonus_bonus_attack_speed_night%。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。

shard_loc.en: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.
shard_loc.zh: 可以主动对一个普通单位施放暗夜猎影，将其秒杀并恢复暗夜魔王最大生命和魔法的一定百分比。在白天无法对远古生物施放。

facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Hunter in the Night to %max_level_tooltip%. Night Stalker starts with a bonus level of Hunter in the Night.
facet_text_zh: 暗夜猎影的最高等级提升至%max_level_tooltip%级。暗夜魔王初始就额外拥有一级暗夜猎影。

abilities.name: night_stalker_darkness
abilities.description_zh: 暗夜魔王遮住太阳，让夜晚立刻降临，使他的力量可以得到最大程度的发挥。在此期间暗夜魔王获得飞行能力和攻击力加成。拥有顺畅视野。
abilities.description_en: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.
