heroes.hero_summary_zh: 育母蜘蛛在蛛网中滑行，培育出一支蜘蛛大军直捣敌人的基地。猎物一旦靠近，她将与自己的孩子一同袭击，释放内心无法满足的狩猎天性，咬得敌人麻痹不动。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Gliding along her webs, Broodmother births an army of spiders to lead her team's forces toward the enemy base. As prey wanders near, she joins her children and attacks, slowing foes with incapacitating bites as she indulges her insatiable hunger.

abilities.name: broodmother_insatiable_hunger
abilities.description_zh: 对活物体液的强烈饥渴提高了育母蜘蛛的攻击力，并使她和她的小蜘蛛的攻击附带吸血效果。
abilities.description_en: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.

shard_loc.en: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by %shard_damage_per_tick%%% every %shard_damage_tick_interval%s.
shard_loc.zh: 开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每%shard_damage_tick_interval%秒提升%shard_damage_per_tick%%%。

facet_text_en: Insatiable Hunger also applies to nearby Spiderlings.
facet_text_zh: 极度饥渴还会施加给附近的小蜘蛛。

abilities.name: broodmother_spin_web
abilities.description_zh: 编织出一张蜘蛛网，育母蜘蛛在蛛网里被动提升移动速度和转身速率，并且获得无视地形移动的能力。织网现在可向其他蛛网触及的区域全地图施放。蛛网永久存在，不过可以手动摧毁。当其数量超过上限，最早的蛛网将会消失。
abilities.description_en: Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
notes_zh: 也会作用于小蜘蛛。
notes_en: Also affects Spiderlings.
facet_text_en: Reduces health restoration of enemies on webs that are in the same web network as Broodmother.
facet_text_zh: 减少育母蜘蛛所在蛛网上敌人的生命回复。

abilities.name: broodmother_incapacitating_bite
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛用毒液削弱敌方单位，使她的攻击带有减速效果，中毒单位的攻击有一定概率落空，并且被攻击时承受额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
notes_zh: 攻击落空几率与闪避和上下坡丢失叠加。
notes_en: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.

abilities.name: broodmother_sticky_snare
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多%count%个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。
abilities.description_en: Broodmother may create up to %count% invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.

abilities.name: broodmother_spiders_milk
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和%kill_heal_aoe%范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续%kill_heal_duration%秒的状态效果，每%tick_rate%秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少%kill_creeps_penalty%%%。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a %kill_heal_aoe% radius receive a buff for %kill_heal_duration%s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every %tick_rate% seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by %kill_creeps_penalty%%%.

abilities.name: broodmother_spawn_spiderlings
abilities.description_zh: 育母蜘蛛将她的卵注入敌人体内，造成伤害和减速，持续%slow_duration%秒。如果目标在感染期间被击杀，卵会孵化成小蜘蛛。
abilities.description_en: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for %slow_duration% seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
notes_zh: 如果目标在受到此技能后%buff_duration%秒内被杀死，小蜘蛛就会孵化。
被小蜘蛛杀死的单位会生出额外的小蜘蛛。
notes_en: If the target is killed within %buff_duration% seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_broodmother_web_speed
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bonus_movespeed}% Spin Web Move Speed and Ignore Speed Limit

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 赏金猎人总是鬼鬼祟祟地跟在敌人后头，掌握他们的动向。一旦他的目标在战斗中阵亡，他和盟友将获得可观的收入。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Sneaking invisibly at the heels of his enemies, Bounty Hunter is always keeping track of his foes. Whenever one of his targets falls in battle, he and his allies stand to make quite a profit.

abilities.name: bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss
abilities.description_zh: 向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围%bounce_aoe%范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
abilities.description_en: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。

abilities.name: bounty_hunter_jinada
abilities.description_zh: 赏金猎人准备好他的下次攻击，造成额外伤害并窃取若干不可靠金钱。
abilities.description_en: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.

abilities.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk
abilities.description_zh: 赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂眩晕目标。
abilities.description_en: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
notes_zh: 开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。
notes_en: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.

abilities.name: bounty_hunter_wind_walk_ally
abilities.description_zh: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是%fade_time%秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。
abilities.description_en: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is %fade_time%s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

abilities.name: bounty_hunter_big_game_hunter
abilities.description_zh: 如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升%kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%%。敌方英雄的财产总和在他们团队中排名为前三就被视为重大目标。
abilities.description_en: Bounty Hunter receives %kill_assist_gold_bonus_percent%%% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

abilities.name: bounty_hunter_track
abilities.description_zh: 追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。如果目标在被追踪期间死亡，赏金猎人和附近友方英雄都将获得若干金钱奖励。施放追踪术不会脱离隐身。
abilities.description_en: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
notes_zh: 只要目标在追踪术期间以任何方式死亡，赏金猎人都能获得金钱奖励。
追踪术效果仅对友方单位可见。
鼠标移至目标技能栏上方的负面效果图标可以看到目标携带的金钱数额。
金钱奖励为不可靠金钱。
notes_en: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.
Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 编织者可以非常轻松地躲开敌人，再找到合适的位置做出反击。他在敌方的视野中进进出出，还可以退回至之前的位置和生命状态，避开死亡的命运。这些躲避型技能可以确保他永远都是敌人心头的麻烦事。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Weaver has no trouble evading enemies to position himself for another strike. Slipping in and out of sight, he avoids death by rewinding himself to an earlier position and health state. His arsenal of elusive skills ensures he is always a critical nuisance to his foes.

abilities.name: weaver_the_swarm
abilities.description_zh: 编织者放出%count%只编织者幼虫，每只幼虫都会紧紧缠住它遇到的敌人，攻击敌人并削弱他们的护甲，直到幼虫被杀死。
abilities.description_en: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
notes_zh: 甲虫抓住目标后将一直留在目标身上，除非甲虫被击杀或持续时间结束。
甲虫免疫技能，需要一个单位的%destroy_attacks%次攻击才能被击杀。英雄造成双倍伤害。
幼虫提供视野。
notes_en: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in %destroy_attacks% attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
Beetles provide vision.
facet_text_en: Weaver gains experience when The Swarm beetles attack heroes.
facet_text_zh: 虫群的甲虫攻击英雄时编织者会获得经验。

abilities.name: weaver_shukuchi
abilities.description_zh: 编织者进入隐身身，达到移动速度上限，在穿过敌方单位时还将造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
notes_zh: 每次施放的技能只能对相同单位造成一次伤害。
notes_en: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.

shard_loc.en: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last %geminate_attack_mark_duration% seconds. %shukuchi_attack_delay%s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within %shukuchi_attack_mark_radius% range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack
shard_loc.zh: 缩地在造成伤害的敌人身上留下一个标记，持续%geminate_attack_mark_duration%秒。编织者脱离缩地状态%shukuchi_attack_delay%秒后，附近%shukuchi_attack_mark_radius%范围内拥有印记的敌人都会被连击的第二次攻击击中。

facet_text_en: Shukuchi movespeed increased and slows enemies when passing through them.
facet_text_zh: 缩地的移动速度增加，穿越敌人时会造成减速。

abilities.name: weaver_geminate_attack
abilities.description_zh: 允许编织者立刻发动两次攻击。
abilities.description_en: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
notes_zh: 第二次攻击将在编织者第一次攻击的%delay%秒后发出，并且没有距离限制。
额外伤害仅对连击的攻击有效，初始攻击没有额外伤害。
notes_en: Additional attacks leave Weaver %delay% seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.

shard_loc.en: Geminate Attack will also hit units within %shard_beetle_search_range% range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.
shard_loc.zh: 连击还会击中虫群附着目标%shard_beetle_search_range%范围内的单位。

abilities.name: weaver_time_lapse
abilities.description_zh:
编织者回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 能够移除编织者身上大部分的负面状态。
时光倒流可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。
notes_en: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.

scepter_loc.en: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with %abilitycastrange% cast range.
scepter_loc.zh: 时光倒流可以对%abilitycastrange%施法距离内的友方英雄施放。

abilities.name: weaver_threads_of_fate
abilities.description_zh: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们%thread_setup_distance%范围内停留达到%thread_setup_time%秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within %thread_setup_distance% range of them for %thread_setup_time%s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Weaver launches a swarm of %count% young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.

Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 杰奇洛是他们自己最好的朋友。不满足于只用烈火惩治敌人，双生龙还将他们冻在原地，接受烈焰焚身。当敌人浑身着火时，他们转过身去吐出液态的火焰，对敌方建筑造成巨大的伤害。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Jakiro is their own best friend. Not content to merely punish enemies with fire, the twins freeze them in place to force them to stand there and burn. With foes aflame, they turn to inflicting massive damage on enemy structures with their liquid fire.

abilities.name: jakiro_dual_breath
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛对面前的敌人先后喷出寒冰和火焰。寒冰吐息减速敌人，火焰吐息对敌人造成持续伤害。
abilities.description_en: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
notes_zh: 最远能伤害1025距离外的单位。
两次吐息有%fire_delay%秒的间隔。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a %fire_delay% second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: jakiro_ice_path
abilities.description_zh: 在杰奇洛前方制造一条冰封路径，对触及到的敌人造成伤害并眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
notes_zh: 路径完全成形需要%path_delay%秒。
冰封路径消失后眩晕效果也会消失。
notes_en: It takes %path_delay% seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.
facet_text_en: Jakiro can choose to destroy the Ice Path at any time, stunning and damaging enemies again.
Ice Path lasts longer and detonates upon expiration, dealing damage and stunning enemies a second time. Ice Path can be manually detonated early.
facet_text_zh: 杰奇洛可以选择随时摧毁冰封路径，再次对敌人造成<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>和伤害。
冰封路径的持续时间变长，并且结束时会引爆，再次对敌人造成伤害和眩晕。冰封路径可以手动提前引爆。

abilities.name: jakiro_liquid_fire
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛的火焰燃烧效果范围内的敌人，并降低他们的攻击速度。和液态冰共用冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
notes_zh: 对单位和建筑都有效。
notes_en: Works on both units and buildings.

shard_loc.en: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
shard_loc.zh: 杰奇洛的液态火没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态冰共用冷却时间。

abilities.name: jakiro_liquid_ice
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续%duration%秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

shard_loc.en: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
shard_loc.zh: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

abilities.name: jakiro_double_trouble
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛攻击时两个头都会发动攻击，不过每个头造成的伤害减少。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
notes_zh: 第二次攻击无视伤害格挡。
notes_en: The second attack ignores Damage Block.
facet_text_en: Jakiro deals more damage with his double attacks.
facet_text_zh: 杰奇洛的双重攻击造成更高伤害。

abilities.name: jakiro_macropyre
abilities.description_zh: 杰奇洛释放出烈焰风暴，烈焰风暴作用范围很宽，并持续数秒。烈焰风暴每秒都会对作用范围内的敌人造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
notes_zh: 被烈焰焚身击中后离开区域还将额外受到%linger_duration%秒伤害效果。
notes_en: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for %linger_duration% additional seconds.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by %ice_edge_movement_slow%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升烈焰焚身的持续时间，并且变为纯粹伤害。杰奇洛会在烈焰焚身边缘放出两道冰墙，对试图穿过的所有敌人减速%ice_edge_movement_slow%%%。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_jakiro
talents_raw.desc_loc: Increases both stun and path duration.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_jakiro_3
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_pct_health_damage}% Liquid Frost and Fire Max Health Damage
talents_raw.desc_loc: Deals +{s:bonus_pct_health_damage}% of the target's max health as damage. This damage does not apply to Buildings.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 只要翱翔于天空，蝙蝠骑士可以从四面八方发动攻势。他手握拉索把敌人抓住，从树梢高飞而过，将猎物从一道火焰路径上拖到无情的盟友面前。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Once he takes to the skies, Batrider can strike from any direction. Snatching a foe with his lasso, he soars above the treetops, pulling his prey through a trail of flame as he drags them before his merciless allies.

abilities.name: batrider_sticky_napalm
abilities.description_zh: 用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加%max_stacks%次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。
abilities.description_en: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to %max_stacks% stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
notes_zh: 所有来自蝙蝠骑士的伤害均会加深，辉耀，淬毒之珠，影之灵龛和魂之灵瓮除外。
粘性燃油无需转身即可施放。
粘性燃油对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。
notes_en: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to creeps.

shard_loc.en: Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.
shard_loc.zh: 粘性燃油不再具有叠加上限。粘性燃油会对建筑造成伤害。

facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Sticky Napalm. Level %max_level_tooltip% Sticky Napalm causes every attack to apply %napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip% stack of Sticky Napalm.
facet_text_zh: 提升粘性燃油的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级粘性燃油会使每次攻击施加%napalm_stacks_on_attack_tooltip%层粘性燃油。

abilities.name: batrider_flamebreak
abilities.description_zh: 投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。
abilities.description_en: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.

abilities.name: batrider_firefly
abilities.description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士飞向天空，从空中留下一道燃烧的尾迹。飞行时，燃烧尾迹会破坏树木，对经过的敌人造成伤害。在火焰飞行持续时间的最后会达到最高移动速度加成。
abilities.description_en: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
notes_zh: 火焰飞行期间蝙蝠骑士可以飞越任何单位，树木和不可通行的地形。
如果蝙蝠骑士在持续时间结束时正好在不可通行的地形上方，那么他将会卡住。
蝙蝠骑士死亡后火焰效果将继续存在。
notes_en: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.
facet_text_en: Firefly also lights Batrider on fire. He gains increasingly more Move Speed and burns away a portion of his max health each second. Maximum bonuses are reached at the end of Firefly's duration. Self-burn damage is constant and does not increase over time.
facet_text_zh: 火焰飞行还会使蝙蝠骑士着火。他每秒会被烧灼一定百分比的最大生命值，但是移动速度会逐渐大幅提升。对自身的烧灼伤害恒定，不会逐渐增加。

abilities.name: batrider_smoldering_resin
abilities.description_zh: 蝙蝠骑士的攻击会施加一个负面效果，每%tick_rate%秒造成%tick_attack_damage_pct%%%攻击伤害，持续%total_ticks%秒。
abilities.description_en: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals %tick_attack_damage_pct%%% of the attack damage every %tick_rate%s for %total_ticks%s.

abilities.name: batrider_flaming_lasso
abilities.description_zh: 用枷锁捆住一个敌人，在蝙蝠骑士的后面拖行。被拖行的单位不能移动、攻击或使用技能。传送或闪烁会打破枷锁。
abilities.description_en: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
notes_zh: 杀死目标或蝙蝠骑士都能在技能结束前打破枷锁。
如果蝙蝠骑士在0.05秒内移动距离超过425码枷锁将会断裂。
蝙蝠骑士在使用燃烧枷锁时不能攻击。
notes_en: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.

scepter_loc.en: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within %grab_radius_scepter% units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.
scepter_loc.zh: 燃烧枷锁除了抓取目标外，还能抓取目标附近%grab_radius_scepter%范围内最近的友方英雄。第二目标将与第一目标相连。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_batrider_6
talents_raw.name_loc: Attacks apply 1 Stack of Sticky Napalm

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 每逢战斗就去丛林中劝化生物，陈率领着他的权宜之军援助战场上的队伍。让盟友远离危险的同时控制野兽袭击敌人。万念俱灰之际，无处不在的圣光还将带来一线生机。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Converting the creatures of the forest to his cause, Chen leads his makeshift armies to aid his team in battle. He assaults enemies with beasts while sending friends to safety. Then, when things seem darkest, he heals his allies wherever they may be.

abilities.name: chen_penitence
abilities.description_zh: 对敌方单位造成伤害，并使其移动变慢，友军攻击他时攻速提升。
abilities.description_en: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.

abilities.name: chen_holy_persuasion
abilities.description_zh: 陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。被劝化目标的最大生命值会被设为%health_min%。被劝化的单位将提升移动速度和伤害输出。陈自己的单位如果在%unsummon_time%秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。
abilities.description_en: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to %health_min%. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last %unsummon_time% seconds to unsummon it.
notes_zh: 如果达到劝化生物的数量上限后再劝化生物，最早劝化的单位将立即死亡。
拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后可以对远古中立生物施放本技能。
升级此技能后在升级前劝化的单位并不会增加生命值。
劝化时单位的魔法恢复至满魔。
notes_en: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.

shard_loc.en: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.
shard_loc.zh: 神圣劝化可以对远古中立生物施放。根据上帝之手等级可以控制最多1/2/3个远古生物。使中立生物的部分技能额外升1级。

abilities.name: chen_divine_favor
abilities.description_zh:
被动提供光环，提供生命恢复加成。可以主动对友军施放，提供护甲加成，以及治疗和生命恢复增强。

对陈施放后，陈控制的所有单位都会获得增益效果。
abilities.description_en:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.

abilities.name: chen_zealot
abilities.description_zh: 陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈身边复活。狂热者技能可以主动使用，在%teleport_delay%秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy.  The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage.  The Zealot respawns next to Chen.Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a %teleport_delay% second delay.  If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.

abilities.name: chen_hand_of_god
abilities.description_zh: 治疗地图上的所有友军英雄以及陈控制的所有单位。一开始先施加高额治疗，在之后%hot_duration%秒内持续进行小额治疗。
abilities.description_en: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for %hot_duration% seconds afterwards.
notes_zh: 可以治疗无敌和被隐藏/放逐友军。
notes_en: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.

scepter_loc.en: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to %AbilityCooldown%s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to %AbilityChannelTime% seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with %debuff_immune_resist%%% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by %nearby_hot_boost%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 上帝之手的冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多%AbilityChannelTime%秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为减益免疫状态，拥有%debuff_immune_resist%%%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升%nearby_hot_boost%%%。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_chen_12
talents_raw.name_loc: Hand of God applies a Strong Dispel

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_chen_2
talents_raw.name_loc: Hand of God Fully Heals Chen and His Creeps
talents_raw.desc_loc: Initial Heal fully heals. Heal over time is still applied.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 与幽鬼为敌就休想摆脱她的鬼影。她的存在可以笼罩整片战场，轻松毁灭落单的猎物。一旦让她完成力量的积聚，谁也逃不过她可怕的惩罚。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Spectre haunts her enemies wherever they may be. Able to destroy lone prey with ease, she spreads her presence throughout the battlefield to choose her target. Once she has gathered her strength, none can escape her terrible wrath.

abilities.name: spectre_spectral_dagger
abilities.description_zh: 幽鬼掷出一把匕首，留下一条暗影之径，对路径上的敌人造成伤害并减缓其移动速度。被匕首击中的单位移动时也会留下暗影之径。幽鬼在暗影之径上移速提升，并且可以无视地形移动。
abilities.description_en: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.
notes_zh: 在离开暗影之径后%dagger_grace_period%秒内碰撞体积依然为0，作为缓冲时间。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。
notes_en: There is a %dagger_grace_period% second grace period after leaving the path where no collision is preserved.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: spectre_shadow_step
abilities.description_zh: 对目标制造一个无法控制的幻象，对其进行攻击。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Sends an uncontrollable illusion at a target that follows and attacks the target.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

abilities.name: spectre_dispersion
abilities.description_zh: 幽灵会分散对她造成的部分伤害，将其反弹给附近的所有敌人。敌人离她越远，受到的伤害越低。
abilities.description_en: Spectre disperses part of the damage dealt to her, reflecting it to all nearby enemies. The effect lessens with distance.
notes_zh: 幽鬼本身不承受被折射的伤害。
幻象并不继承此技能。
伤害在减免前折射，并且折射的伤害与原伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: The reflected damage is not dealt to Spectre.
Illusions don't get this ability.
Damage is reflected before reductions, and is returned as the same damage type.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

shard_loc.en: Dispersion can be activated to increase the amount absorbed and reflected by Dispersion by %activation_bonus_pct%%% of its base values for %activation_duration%s. Cooldown %activation_cooldown%. Manacost %activation_manacost%.
shard_loc.zh: 折射可以主动施放，吸收和反弹的伤害比例提升%activation_bonus_pct%%%，持续%activation_duration%秒。冷却时间为%activation_cooldown%秒。魔法消耗为%activation_manacost%点。

abilities.name: spectre_desolate
abilities.description_zh: 当敌人附近%radius%范围内没有他们的友军时，幽鬼和她的幻象的攻击对他们造成额外纯粹伤害。
abilities.description_en: Spectre and her illusions deal bonus Pure damage if attacking an enemy that does not have any allied units within a %radius% radius around them.
notes_zh: 伤害在幽鬼攻击前产生。
幽鬼的幻象继承荒芜。
notes_en: Damage is dealt before Spectre's attack.
Spectre's illusions also have Desolate.
facet_text_en: Spectre deals %bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%x damage with Desolate. Spectre's illusions no longer have Desolate.
facet_text_zh: 幽鬼自身的荒芜造成%bonus_damage_multiplier_tooltip%倍伤害，但是幽鬼的幻象不再触发荒芜。

abilities.name: spectre_haunt
abilities.description_zh: 创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.  They ignore terrain.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

scepter_loc.en: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.
scepter_loc.zh: 幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Spectre flings a dagger to draw a Shadow Path, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed of any enemies along the trail. Units hit by the dagger also trail a Shadow Path. While treading the path, Spectre moves faster and phases through otherwise impassable terrain.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 末日使者总有手段终结敌人。他吞噬生物并获得他们生前的各种技能，他的终极技能让敌人对自己的技能和物品望之兴叹，随之被魔火烧成灰烬。
heroes.hero_summary_en: One way or another, Doom shuts down his enemies. Devouring creeps to claim the various skills they had in life, he can place a lingering silence upon a foe's spells and items with his ultimate as he torches his foes.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_devour
abilities.description_zh: 消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
abilities.description_en: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
notes_zh: 末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。
notes_en: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.

shard_loc.en: Devour has %AbilityCharges% charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have %bonus_aoe_pct%%% increased AoE and %bonus_spell_amp_pct%%% increased spell amplification.
shard_loc.zh: 吞噬拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有%bonus_aoe_pct%%%额外作用范围和%bonus_spell_amp_pct%%%额外技能增强。

abilities.name: doom_bringer_scorched_earth
abilities.description_zh: 用火焰覆盖周围的土地，对敌人造成伤害，同时末日使者的移动速度和生命恢复得到提升。
abilities.description_en: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
notes_zh: 焦土会跟随末日使者，以他所在位置为中心。
notes_en: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_infernal_blade
abilities.description_zh: 末日挥舞他的炽烈之剑，将敌人点燃。造成%ministun_duration%秒眩晕，并施加一个燃烧效果，持续%burn_duration%秒，每秒造成伤害，数值为基础伤害+目标最大生命值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for %ministun_duration% seconds and applies a %burn_duration% second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
notes_zh: 可以打断持续施法类技能。
notes_en: Interrupts channeling abilities.

abilities.name: doom_bringer_doom
abilities.description_zh:
对敌人施加末日诅咒，对其进行驱散，并且使其无法施放技能或获得任何治疗效果，同时造成持续伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

scepter_loc.en: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a %scepter_aura_radius% radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.
scepter_loc.zh: 末日对敌人施加破坏效果。末日作用下目标%scepter_aura_radius%范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。

facet_text_en: Every %upgrade_interval% minutes, Doom's duration is increased by %upgrade_amount%s.
facet_text_zh: 末日的持续时间每%upgrade_interval%分钟都会提升%upgrade_amount%秒。

abilities.name: doom_bringer_lvl_pain
abilities.description_zh: 末日使者的攻击会诅咒敌方英雄。%damage_debuff_duration%秒后，被诅咒的英雄会爆发出一根火柱，对自身和%spread_radius%范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量为诅咒期间内承受来自末日使者的%bonus_damage_pct_base%%%伤害。如果被诅咒的英雄等级为%level_multiplier%的倍数，诅咒的伤害和作用范围会提升%bonus_at_level_pct%%%。
abilities.description_en: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After %damage_debuff_duration%s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a %spread_radius% AoE for %bonus_damage_pct_base%%% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is %bonus_at_level_pct%%% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of %level_multiplier%.
notes_zh: 末日使者达到满级后也会生效。
notes_en: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_burn_damage_pct}% Infernal Blade Max HP As Damage

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 远古冰魄可以在整片战场的任意位置降下毁灭性的冰暴，衰弱的敌人一旦中招，无论身处何地都将粉身碎骨。减速敌人的同时他还能提升盟友在战场上的出手效果，对于他的敌人而言，他始终是一个威胁。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Able to launch a powerful blast of damaging ice across the battlefield, Ancient Apparition threatens to shatter weakened enemies wherever they are. Slowing enemies as he enhances his allies' effectiveness in battle, he is a constant threat to his foes.

abilities.name: ancient_apparition_cold_feet
abilities.description_zh: 对一个敌人施加诅咒，造成持续伤害。如果目标没有在%AbilityDuration%秒内远离初始地点走出足够距离，那么将被眩晕并冻在原地。
abilities.description_en: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after %AbilityDuration% seconds.
notes_zh: 每0.5秒造成一次伤害。
notes_en: Deals damage every half second.
facet_text_en: Cold Feet becomes an AoE point targeted ability, with the radius depending on the current level of Ice Blast.
facet_text_zh: 寒霜之足变为范围型技能，作用范围取决于冰晶爆轰的当前等级。

abilities.name: ancient_apparition_ice_vortex
abilities.description_zh: 创造一个寒冰能量的漩涡，对范围内敌人造成伤害和减速，并增加他们受到的魔法伤害。
abilities.description_en: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
notes_zh: 提供放置地点的小片视野。
notes_en: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

abilities.name: ancient_apparition_chilling_touch
abilities.description_zh: 使自己的普通攻击附带距离提升，高额魔法伤害和减速效果。
abilities.description_en: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.

scepter_loc.en: Removes cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 移除了冷却时间。

abilities.name: ancient_apparition_bone_chill
abilities.description_zh: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌人造成魔法伤害，敌人就会减速一段时间。如果目标是英雄，力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。
abilities.description_en: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.

scepter_loc.en: Increases Base Strength Reduction by %tooltip_scepter_bonus%.
scepter_loc.zh: 基础力量降低提升%tooltip_scepter_bonus%。

abilities.name: ancient_apparition_ice_blast
abilities.description_zh: 向地图的任意位置发出爆炸冰球，在冰球飞行时再次施放此技能将使其停下，使所在区域产生毁灭性的冰爆。冰球飞行的距离越长，冰爆影响的范围也将越大。冰爆范围内的所有敌方单位将马上受到大量伤害，而处于冰球飞行路径上的敌方英雄将与冰爆范围内的敌方英雄一同受到寒霜诅咒的作用，持续受到小幅伤害，同时无法恢复生命值。在此期间如果生命值低于一定百分比，该英雄将立刻死亡。
abilities.description_en: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
notes_zh: 施放后本技能替换为释放，将使指向球停在目标区域。
作用范围的大小是%radius_min% + %radius_grow%*指向球的飞行时间，上限为%radius_max%。
击杀目标的英雄由触发即死的伤害来源决定。
斩杀效果对幻象无效。
寒霜诅咒的负面状态无法被驱散，包括身处泉水附近，但魂断、时光倒流和超新星除外。
notes_en: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is %radius_min% + %radius_grow%*TimeTraveled, capped at %radius_max%.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.

shard_loc.en: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for %cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%% of the duration.
shard_loc.zh: 冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足眩晕时间的%cold_feet_stun_duration_pct%%%。

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 熊战士每次挥爪都会让他的目标愈发脆弱。他可以短时间内加快出击的速度，放缓附近猎物的脚步，将敌人们快速撕碎。
heroes.hero_summary_en: With each swipe of his claws, Ursa increases his target's vulnerability to his next attack. Capable of briefly increasing how swiftly he can strike, and able to slow down nearby prey, he quickly tears apart his enemies.

abilities.name: ursa_earthshock
abilities.description_zh: 熊战士向前跳跃%hop_distance%距离并猛击地面带来强烈的冲击，对附近范围内的所有敌方单位造成伤害并减速%abilityduration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Ursa leaps forward %hop_distance% units and slams the earth, causing a powerful shock to damage and slow all enemy units in a nearby area for %abilityduration% seconds.

shard_loc.en: Earthshock applies %fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit% Fury Swipes to enemies hit.
shard_loc.zh: 震撼大地对击中的敌人施加%fury_swipe_stacks_on_hit%层怒意狂击。

abilities.name: ursa_overpower
abilities.description_zh: 乌尔萨在战斗中运用他的技艺，提升了接下来几次攻击的攻击速度，同时还获得了减速抗性。
abilities.description_en: Using his skill in combat, Ursa gains increased attack speed and slow resistance for a number of subsequent attacks.
notes_zh: 攻击丢失还是会消耗超强力量的攻击次数。
notes_en: Missing an attack still consumes a charge of Overpower.

abilities.name: ursa_fury_swipes
abilities.description_zh: 熊战士的利爪深深地撕裂敌人的伤口，对同一敌人连续攻击将造成更多伤害。如果同一个目标在%bonus_reset_time%秒内不受攻击，将失去额外伤害加成。
abilities.description_en: Ursa's claws dig deeper wounds in the enemy, causing consecutive attacks to the same enemy to deal more damage.  If the same target is not attacked after %bonus_reset_time% seconds, the bonus damage is lost.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。
notes_en: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

abilities.name: ursa_maul
abilities.description_zh: 熊战士获得攻击力加成，数值为当前生命值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Ursa gains bonus damage equal to a percentage of his Current HP.

abilities.name: ursa_enrage
abilities.description_zh:
乌尔萨进入狂怒状态，承受的伤害降低并获得状态抗性。施放时将移除所受的负面效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
Ursa goes into a frenzy, providing damage reduction and status resistance. Removes any existing debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

scepter_loc.en: Reduces cooldown and allows Ursa to use Enrage while disabled.
scepter_loc.zh: 减少冷却时间，而且熊战士可以在被控制的状态下使用激怒。

facet_text_en: When damaged during Enrage, Ursa gains bonus attack damage.
facet_text_zh: 激怒期间受到伤害时，熊战士获得攻击力加成。

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 兼具极高的机动性和攻击性，裂魂人可以跨越整个地图发动冲刺，使敌人陷入战斗。手中沉重的灯笼痛击着敌人，每次敲出的重击让他们意识模糊。他的敌人可以逃，但是他们无处可藏。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Highly mobile and always aggressive, Spirit Breaker charges across the map to bring the fight to his enemies. With each bash of his heavy lantern, he knocks his foes senseless. His enemies may run, but with the help of a few wards, they cannot hide.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_charge_of_darkness
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人盯紧一个敌方单位，开始无视一切物体的冲刺，起始为%min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%%额外移速，%windup_time%秒后达到最大速度。途中经过的所有敌方单位和目标单位都将受到巨力重击。如果目标单位在到达前阵亡，裂魂人将他的目标改为原路径上最近的一个敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker fixes his sight on an enemy unit and starts charging through all objects, starting at %min_movespeed_bonus_pct%%% of the bonus speed and reaching his max speed after %windup_time%s.All enemy units passed through and the targeted unit will be hit by a Greater Bash.  If the targeted unit dies, Spirit Breaker will change his target to the nearest enemy unit to that location.
notes_zh: 裂魂人在冲刺过程中能穿过树木，悬崖和任何单位。
冲刺指示特效仅对队友可见。
裂魂人将获得并共享目标的视野。
notes_en: Spirit Breaker passes through trees, cliffs, and units.
The charge indicator is visible only to allies.
Spirit Breaker gains shared vision of the target.

shard_loc.en: Increases Charge of Darkness Bonus Speed by %bonus_movement_speed%.
shard_loc.zh: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成提升%bonus_movement_speed%。

facet_text_en: Charge of Darkness bonus movement speed lingers after charge ends.
facet_text_zh: 暗影冲刺的移动速度加成会在冲刺结束后逐渐消失。

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_bulldoze
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人获得移动速度和状态抗性加成，在敌人之间横冲直撞。可以在冲刺期间使用。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_greater_bash
abilities.description_zh: 攻击时有一定概率眩晕并击退敌方单位。重击的伤害值为移动速度的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
notes_zh: 不与碎颅锤叠加。
破坏会使攻击触发巨力重击失效。暗影冲刺或幽冥一击还是会施加巨力重击。
notes_en: Does not stack with Skull Basher.
Break disables the passive percent Chance to Bash. Does not disable Greater Bash application from Charge of Darkness or Nether Strike.

scepter_loc.en: Increases knockback. If a knocked-back enemy collides with another enemy, the second enemy is bashed (creeps only receive %cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%% damage), and the original target takes %cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%% of Greater Bash's damage again.
scepter_loc.zh: 击退效果提升。如果击退的敌人又撞到了一个敌人，这个敌人也会被重击（非英雄单位只受到%cascading_bashes_creep_penalty%%%伤害），并且原目标再次受到%cascading_bashes_damage_multiplier%%%的巨力重击伤害。

facet_text_en: Greater Bash chance is increased if you've bashed more than one hero within the last %bonus_chance_duration%s. Each additional hero past the first increases Greater Bash chance by %bonus_chance_pct%%%.
facet_text_zh: 过去%bonus_chance_duration%秒内对不止一名英雄触发了巨力重击就会使重击的概率提升。第一个英雄之后每个英雄都会使巨力重击的概率提升%bonus_chance_pct%%%。

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_planar_pocket
abilities.description_zh: 巴拉森获得魔法抗性，并扭曲选定英雄附近的现实，使敌方英雄施放的任意指向性技能转向裂魂人。可以对友方和敌方英雄施放，但是只有裂魂人的敌人施放的技能才会转向。
abilities.description_en: Barathrum gains magic resistance and distorts reality around the selected hero, making any unit-targeted spells cast by enemy heroes get redirected towards Spirit Breaker. Can be cast on both allied and enemy heroes, but only spells cast by enemies of Spirit Breaker will be redirected.
notes_zh: 如果裂魂人和目标之间的距离超过%break_distance%，位面空洞效果会停止。
notes_en: Planar Pocket's effect stops if Barathrum moves %break_distance% units away from the target.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_bull_rush
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人只要眩晕敌人就会获得移动速度加成。来自多个眩晕的效果会叠加，并且拥有独立的持续时间。暗影冲刺期间持续时间会暂停。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.
notes_zh: 神行太保的加成状态使裂魂人能够突破移动速度上限。
notes_en: Empowering Haste buff allows Spirit Breaker to go over the max movement speed limit.

abilities.name: spirit_breaker_nether_strike
abilities.description_zh: 裂魂人遁入幽冥领域，从不幸的目标身旁再次出现，发动当前等级的巨力重击并造成额外伤害。击退距离为平常的两倍。
abilities.description_en: Spirit Breaker slips into the nether realm, reappearing next to his hapless victim. Upon reappearing, a Greater Bash of the current level occurs and deals bonus damage. Knocks back for double the normal distance.
notes_zh: 裂魂人将在目标身后出现并发动巨力重击。
notes_en: Spirit Breaker appears behind the target to deliver the bash.

scepter_loc.en: Greatly increases knockback.
scepter_loc.zh: 大幅提升击退效果。

facet_text_en: Enemy targets hit by Nether Strike will be moved further by allied knockback effects.
facet_text_zh: 被幽冥一击击中的敌方目标受到友方的击退效果的移动距离更远。

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Spirit Breaker gains movement speed and status resistance to ram through enemies. Can be used while charging.
Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
Gives a chance to stun and knockback an enemy unit on an attack. Deals a percentage of movement speed as damage.
Spirit Breaker gains bonus Movement Speed for a duration whenever he stuns an enemy. Effects from multiple stuns stack and have independent durations. Duration pauses during Charge of Darkness.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 矮人直升机直冲云霄，所有火力都已准备好随时开战。可以轰击周围所有敌人的机关炮弹，让他们应接不暇的火箭弹幕，只要让他积累了足够的力量，他就能轻而易举地毁灭敌人。
heroes.hero_summary_en: With his arsenal of firepower at the ready, Gyrocopter soars into battle. Blasting all nearby enemies with shots from his cannon or hammering them with a barrage of rockets, if he is able to gather his full strength, he demolishes foes with ease.

abilities.name: gyrocopter_rocket_barrage
abilities.description_zh: 向矮人直升机附近一定范围内的敌方单位齐射导弹。持续%barrage_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts %barrage_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 火箭弹幕不能伤害矮人直升机视野之外的单位。
追踪导弹发射的火箭弹幕不会触发加力燃烧器。
notes_en: Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.
facet_text_en: Every successful hit of a Rocket Barrage rocket on an enemy hero increases Gyrocopter's movement speed.
facet_text_zh: 火箭弹幕每次成功击中敌方英雄都会提升矮人直升机的移动速度。

abilities.name: gyrocopter_homing_missile
abilities.description_zh: 发射一枚会自动定位目标单位的追踪导弹。导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及眩晕。敌方单位可在导弹接近前将其击落。
abilities.description_en: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
notes_zh: 防御塔对导弹造成半额伤害。
准星效果仅对队友可见。
导弹会跟随并击中隐身单位。
notes_en: Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.

shard_loc.en: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a %shard_radius% area of effect after %shard_delay% second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.
shard_loc.zh: 追踪导弹现在从施放%shard_delay%秒后开始不断发射%shard_radius%作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。

abilities.name: gyrocopter_flak_cannon
abilities.description_zh: 矮人直升机的攻击会击中目标周围一定范围内的所有敌人，持续一定次数的攻击。只有主要目标会受到致命一击等攻击特效。持续%abilityduration%秒或攻击次数耗尽。
abilities.description_en: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds or until the attacks are used.
notes_zh: 对主目标的攻击距离没有改变。
notes_en: Attack range for the primary attack is unchanged.

abilities.name: gyrocopter_afterburner
abilities.description_zh: 矮人直升机通过攻击或技能对敌人造成伤害后，在短时间内获得移动速度提升。
abilities.description_en: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

abilities.name: gyrocopter_side_gunner_spawn_ability
abilities.description_zh: 矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每%sidegunner_fire_rate%秒对矮人直升机附近%AbilityCastRange%范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。
abilities.description_en: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a %AbilityCastRange% unit radius every %sidegunner_fire_rate%s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
notes_zh: 即使矮人直升机被控制，侧翼机枪也能攻击。
notes_en: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.

abilities.name: gyrocopter_call_down
abilities.description_zh: 召唤%total_strikes%波防空导弹，对目标区域内的敌方单位造成减速和伤害。每次打击与上一次间隔%strike_separation%距离。
abilities.description_en: Call down %total_strikes% aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is %strike_separation% distance from the previous one.
notes_zh: 视觉指示范围仅对队友可见。
notes_en: The visual indicator is visible to allies only.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts %barrage_duration% seconds.

Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 炼金术士在一击一杀中都能合成额外的资源，收集摧毁敌人的器具不在话下。腐蚀酸液和大量不稳定的化学药剂会让敌人措手不及。为了保证自己贪婪的劣迹不受打扰，他将力战到底。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Synthesizing extra resources from each and every kill, Alchemist has no trouble gathering the tools needed to destroy his foes. Ambushing enemies with corrosive acid and a host of unstable chemicals, he battles to ensure his greedy escapades can remain uninterrupted.

abilities.name: alchemist_acid_spray
abilities.description_zh: 向目标区域喷洒高压酸雾。穿过受污染地带的敌人每秒会受到物理伤害，同时护甲被削弱。
abilities.description_en: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.

abilities.name: alchemist_unstable_concoction
abilities.description_zh: 炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并眩晕。调制的时间越久，伤害越大，眩晕时间也越长。炼金术士在调制期间获得移动速度加成。调制%brew_time%秒后达到最大伤害量和最长眩晕时间。然而，若%brew_explosion%秒后未扔出药剂，则会在炼金术士自己手中爆炸。
abilities.description_en: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After %brew_time% seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after %brew_explosion% seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
notes_zh: 摇制开始后，本技能替换为投掷不稳定化合物。炼金术士在摇制期间可以像平常一样移动和攻击。
炼金术士的头顶会有倒计时，提示剩余的摇制时间。倒计时对敌人可见。
可以用此技能将自己反补。
不稳定化合物无法被躲避，并且不稳定化合物被掷出后会停止调制。
不稳定化合物的爆炸会对英雄和非英雄单位造成伤害。
notes_en: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.
facet_text_en: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.
facet_text_zh: 炼金术士处于化学狂暴作用时，冷却时间减少%chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

abilities.name: alchemist_corrosive_weaponry
abilities.description_zh:
炼金术士使他的武器浸满强酸，对击中的敌人施加可叠加的减速和基础攻击力降低效果。

每次攻击施加%stacks_per_attack%层叠加效果。不稳定化合物每调制1秒施加%one_tooltip%层叠加效果。
abilities.description_en:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply %stacks_per_attack% stacks. Unstable Concoction applies %one_tooltip% stack per second of brew time.

special_values.name: attack_dmg_per_stack
special_values.heading_loc: BASE ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION PER STACK:

abilities.name: alchemist_berserk_potion
abilities.description_zh: 炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en: Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
facet_text_en: While Alchemist is affected by Chemical Rage, cooldown is reduced by %chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%.
facet_text_zh: 炼金术士处于化学狂暴作用时，冷却时间减少%chemical_rage_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

abilities.name: alchemist_goblins_greed
abilities.description_zh: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来%duration%秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。
abilities.description_en: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next %duration% seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.

scepter_loc.en: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus %scepter_bonus_damage% damage and %bonus_gold_per_scepter% additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.
scepter_loc.zh: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得%scepter_bonus_damage%点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加%bonus_gold_per_scepter%。

facet_text_en: Alchemist gains %gpm_increase_per_stack% GPM for each Aghanim's Scepter he has granted to allies.
facet_text_zh: 炼金术士每对友军送出一把阿哈利姆神杖就获得%gpm_increase_per_stack%每分钟金钱。

abilities.name: alchemist_chemical_rage
abilities.description_zh:
炼金术士诱发他的食人魔同伴进入化学狂暴，降低攻击间隔，提高移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 拥有%transformation_time%秒的变身时间，可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道以及眩晕技能。
notes_en: Has a %transformation_time% second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_slow_per_stack}% Corrosive Weaponry Slow / Damage Reduction Per Stack

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 祈求者可以随意施展脑海中复杂的法术，充分做到随机应变。三种魔法元素的任意组合都可以产生十大魔法之一，意味着他向来都是有条不紊地毁灭敌人或者逃离追杀。
heroes.hero_summary_en: With an intricate arsenal of spells at his disposal, Invoker can adapt to any battle situation. Each configuration of his three spell components yields of one of ten spells, meaning he's never without a way to destroy or escape his enemies.

abilities.name: invoker_quas
abilities.description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控冰元素。每个活跃的冰元素会让祈求者获得生命恢复加成。每级冰被动提供额外力量。
abilities.description_en: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个元素。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
notes_en: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

scepter_loc.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
scepter_loc.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。

facet_text_en: <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#7998b5'>Quas</font> gains an additional level.
facet_text_zh: <font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#7998b5'>冰</font>会自动额外获得一级。

abilities.name: invoker_wex
abilities.description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控雷元素。每个活跃的雷元素会让祈求者获得移动和攻击速度加成。每级雷被动提供额外敏捷。
abilities.description_en: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
notes_en: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

scepter_loc.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
scepter_loc.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。

facet_text_en: <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#d671a9'>Wex</font> gains an additional level.
facet_text_zh: <font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#d671a9'>雷</font>会自动额外获得一级。

abilities.name: invoker_exort
abilities.description_zh: 允许祈求者掌控火元素。每个活跃的火元素会让祈求者获得攻击力加成。每级火被动提供额外智力。
abilities.description_en: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.
notes_zh: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
notes_en: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

scepter_loc.en: Grants %scepter_bonus_levels% current and max level.
scepter_loc.zh: 提供%scepter_bonus_levels%级当前和最高等级。

facet_text_en: <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional max level. When Invoker reaches level 6, <font color='#cabe68'>Exort</font> gains an additional level.
facet_text_zh: <font color='#cabe68'>火</font>的最高等级额外增加一级。祈求者到达6级时，<font color='#cabe68'>火</font>会自动额外获得一级。

abilities.name: invoker_invoke
abilities.description_zh: 将当前掌握的元素精华融合，创造出新的法术供祈求者施放。每个元素球的等级都会减少%cooldown_reduction_per_orb%秒元素祈唤的冷却时间。祈求者达到%first_ability_level%、%second_ability_level%和%third_ability_level%时会分别额外获得一点技能点。祈求者高深的魔法学识让他可以从多个阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果中进行选择。物品必须先激活才能生效，而且选择后无法更改。点击帮助按钮可查看所有可用法术。
abilities.description_en: Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by %cooldown_reduction_per_orb% seconds for each orb level.  Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels %first_ability_level%, %second_ability_level%, and %third_ability_level%.Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options.  The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen. Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
notes_zh: 生成的技能与三个球的排列顺序无关。
只是交换现有技能的位置并不会消耗魔法，也不会触发元素祈唤的冷却。
元素祈唤不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
notes_en: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

abilities.name: invoker_cold_snap
abilities.description_zh: 祈求者将敌人的热量抽空，将其降到绝对零度，持续时间取决于冰元素等级。敌人将受到伤害并被短暂冻结，后续攻击会使敌人再次冻结并造成额外伤害。被冻结的频率固定，但是冻结的冷却时间将会随着冰元素等级提高而缩短。
abilities.description_en: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.
notes_zh: 只有%damage_trigger%点以上的实际伤害才能触发急速冷却。
notes_en: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than %damage_trigger% after reductions.

abilities.name: invoker_ghost_walk
abilities.description_zh: 祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己隐形并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与雷元素等级成反比。
abilities.description_en: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.
notes_zh: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。
notes_en: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.

shard_loc.en: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.
shard_loc.zh: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。

abilities.name: invoker_tornado
abilities.description_zh:
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助地漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。最大距离取决于雷元素等级。滞空时间取决于冰元素等级。落地伤害取决于雷元素的等级。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。
notes_en: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

scepter_loc.en: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a %twister_radius% radius every %twister_tick_rate% seconds. (half damage to creeps.)
scepter_loc.zh: 强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于冰的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每%twister_tick_rate%秒在%twister_radius%范围内基于雷的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）

abilities.name: invoker_emp
abilities.description_zh: 祈求者在指定位置召唤出一道强力的自爆电磁脉冲，%delay%秒后将自动爆炸。爆炸将覆盖一定区域，并根据雷元素的等级损毁敌方的魔法值。对敌方英雄造成损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。祈求者将获得%self_mana_restore_pct%%%损毁的魔法。
abilities.description_en: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after %delay% seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains %self_mana_restore_pct%%% of the mana drained.
notes_zh: 对被吹起的单位（强袭飓风或Eul的神圣法杖）无效。
notes_en: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).

shard_loc.en: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %drag_speed% units per second.
shard_loc.zh: 提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒%drag_speed%距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。

abilities.name: invoker_alacrity
abilities.description_zh: 祈求者给友方单位灌注强大的能量，提高其攻击速度和攻击力。攻击速度提升程度取决于雷元素等级，攻击力提升取决于火元素等级。
abilities.description_en: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

abilities.name: invoker_chaos_meteor
abilities.description_zh: 祈求者从太空中召唤一枚燃烧的流星打击指定位置。流星着陆后会向前滚动一段距离，每隔一段时间撞击一次作用范围内的敌人，造成基于火元素等级的撞击伤害，滚动距离取决于雷元素的等级。每被撞击一次都将持续受到烧灼伤害，烧灼伤害取决于火元素的等级。
abilities.description_en: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.
notes_zh: 每个敌方单位受到撞击伤害的间隔为%damage_interval%秒，后续较低的烧灼伤害持续%burn_duration%秒。
陨石移动的速度为%travel_speed%。
notes_en: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every %damage_interval% seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over %burn_duration% seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of %travel_speed%.

abilities.name: invoker_sun_strike
abilities.description_zh: 向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。伤害取决于火元素等级，区域内敌人将平摊所有伤害。
abilities.description_en: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
notes_zh: 施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。
notes_en: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.

scepter_loc.en: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a %cataclysm_cooldown% second cooldown. Creates %cataclysm_count% visible %cataclysm_damage_pct%%% damage Sun Strikes within %cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range% range of each enemy hero.
scepter_loc.zh: 双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为%cataclysm_cooldown%秒。每个敌方英雄附近%cataclysm_min_range%-%cataclysm_max_range%范围内产生%cataclysm_count%个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有%cataclysm_damage_pct%%%伤害。

shard_loc.en: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
shard_loc.zh: 阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。

abilities.name: invoker_forge_spirit
abilities.description_zh: 祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。熔炉精灵的攻击力和护甲取决于火元素的等级，攻击距离、持续时间和生命值取决于冰元素的等级。元素的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。熔炉精灵的产生数量取决于冰元素和火元素中等级较低的元素。
abilities.description_en: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.
notes_zh: 施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。
notes_en: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

abilities.name: invoker_ice_wall
abilities.description_zh: 在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙，持续时间取决于冰元素的等级。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成减速和伤害，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，每秒伤害取决于火元素的等级。
abilities.description_en: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.

scepter_loc.en: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a %wall_width% width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than %root_delay% seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.
scepter_loc.zh: 寒冰之墙变成浮冰，以矢量为目标。经过短暂延迟后，浮冰出现再产生一道%wall_width%宽度的寒冰之墙。在浮冰内停留超过%root_delay%秒的敌方英雄会基于冰的等级被缠绕并受到魔法伤害。

abilities.name: invoker_deafening_blast
abilities.description_zh: 祈求者在自己前方释放出超强的声波，对所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量取决于火元素的等级。声波的绝对冲击能够将敌方单位击退，击退时间取决于冰元素的等级，同时让他们无法进行攻击，禁止攻击时间取决于雷元素的等级。
abilities.description_en: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_invoker_2
talents_raw.desc_loc: Releases {s:bonus_radial_count} additional Deafening Blasts around Invoker in a circular pattern.  An enemy can only be hit once per cast.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 沉默术士可以改变每次战斗的局势，有他在场，敌人无法自如地施放技能。他挥舞旋刃将敌人粉碎的同时还将夺取他们的智力，让他们永远难以翻身。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Silencer changes the dynamic of every battle when he shuts down the enemy's ability to cast their spells. As he cuts his foes to ribbons with his glaive, he steals their intelligence to add to his own, ensuring his foes are always at a disadvantage.

abilities.name: silencer_curse_of_the_silent
abilities.description_zh: 诅咒目标区域，造成伤害并使敌人持续受到伤害，并且移动速度被减缓。期间受到作用的英雄一旦施放魔法，持续时间就会延长。目标被沉默时不计入负面效果的持续时间。
abilities.description_en: Curses the target area, dealing damage and causing enemies to take damage over time and slowing their movement speed.Anytime affected enemies cast a spell, the duration is increased. The duration is paused as long as the target is silenced.
notes_zh: 非英雄单位也会受到作用。
notes_en: Affects creeps.

abilities.name: silencer_glaives_of_wisdom
abilities.description_zh: 沉默术士用他的智慧强化刀刃，每次攻击窃取目标的智力，并造成基于他智力值的额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Silencer enchants his glaives with his wisdom, stealing his target's Intelligence with each hit and dealing additional damage based on his Intelligence.

shard_loc.en: Causes Glaives of Wisdom to bounce %bounce_count% time to a random enemy within %bounce_range% range and increases intelligence steal.
shard_loc.zh: 使智慧之刃向%bounce_range% 范围内的随机敌人弹射%bounce_count%次，并提升智力窃取。

facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Glaives of Wisdom. Level %max_level_tooltip% Glaives of Wisdom bounce %bounce_count_tooltip% time to a random target within %bounce_range_tooltip% range. The bounce costs mana upon hit and prioritizes heroes.
facet_text_zh: 提升智慧之刃的最高等级。%max_level_tooltip%级智慧之刃会向%bounce_range_tooltip%范围内的一个随机目标弹射%bounce_count_tooltip%次。弹射击中时会消耗魔法，以英雄优先。

abilities.name: silencer_last_word
abilities.description_zh: 向目标施加魔咒，提供目标的视野，并且只要目标施放技能或魔咒消失，目标就会受到伤害并被沉默。根据沉默术士和目标的智力差还将造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Enchants a target, providing vision of them and causing them to be damaged and silenced if they cast a spell or if the enchantment timer expires. Deals extra damage based on the difference in intelligence between Silencer and the target.
notes_zh: 持续施法类技能在英雄结束施法后触发此技能的效果。
notes_en: Channeling abilities will trigger this effect once the caster finishes its channel.

abilities.name: silencer_brain_drain
abilities.description_zh: 沉默术士对被沉默的目标造成更多伤害，受到来自他们的伤害减少。只要敌方英雄在沉默术士附近%permanent_int_steal_range%范围内阵亡或者死亡时带有沉默术士的负面效果，沉默术士都会永久窃取其%permanent_int_steal_amount%点智力。如果敌方英雄阵亡时被沉默，将额外窃取%silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount%点智力。
abilities.description_en: Silencer takes less damage from and deals more damage to silenced targets.If an enemy Hero dies within %permanent_int_steal_range% range of Silencer or was debuffed by Silencer at the time of death, Silencer permanently steals %permanent_int_steal_amount% Intelligence from them.  If the victim was silenced, steal an extra %silenced_bonus_int_steal_amount% Intelligence.

shard_loc.en: Increases the Intelligence stolen per kill.
shard_loc.zh: 提升每次击杀窃取的智力值。

abilities.name: silencer_global_silence
abilities.description_zh: 沉默术士停止一切声音，阻止地图上所有敌方英雄和单位施法。
abilities.description_en: Silencer stops all sound, preventing enemy heroes and units on the map from casting spells.
notes_zh: 沉默效果对隐身和减益免疫单位有效，但是期间获得减益免疫状态将移除该效果。
来自阿哈利姆神杖升级全领域静默的多个奥术诅咒不会叠加。
notes_en: This skill works on invisible and Debuff Immune units, but gaining debuff immunity will remove its effect.
Multiple Arcane Curses from Aghanim's Scepter Global Silence do not stack.

scepter_loc.en: Global Silence applies Arcane Curse to heroes for the duration of Global Silence.
scepter_loc.zh: 全领域静默在全领域静默的持续时间内对英雄施加奥术诅咒。

facet_text_en: The first time Global Silence ends on a unit it is applied again.
facet_text_zh: 全领域静默在一个单位身上第一次结束后还会再次施加。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_silencer_brain_drain_damage
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_damage_pct}% Suffer In Silence Silenced Target Damage

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_silencer_5
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_int_steal_duration}s Glaives of Wisdom Int Steal Duration

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 殁境神蚀者禁锢敌人后窃取其神智，将生人的智力转化为毁灭的力量。他运用奥术能量发动猛攻，他的终极冲击能粉碎敌人的心智，即使侥幸逃生也将被消去魔法。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Stealing from the minds of those he imprisons, Outworld Destroyer turns raw intelligence into destructive power. Weakening enemies with a barrage of arcane energy, he shatters their sanity with his ultimate blast, often erasing mana from those that survive.

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_arcane_orb
abilities.description_zh: 殁境神蚀者的攻击附带基于剩余魔法值的额外纯粹伤害。
abilities.description_en: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
notes_zh: 根据使用此技能后的魔法值计算附加伤害。
notes_en: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.

scepter_loc.en: Arcane Orb bounces to an additional target for %bounce_damage_reduction%%% less damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 奥术天球额外弹跳至一个目标，造成的伤害降低%bounce_damage_reduction%%%。

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_astral_imprisonment
abilities.description_zh: 窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
notes_zh: 被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。
notes_en: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.

shard_loc.en: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at %allied_movement_speed_pct%%% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).
shard_loc.zh: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以%allied_movement_speed_pct%%%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。

facet_text_en: Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.
facet_text_zh: 受到作用的英雄会获得一个魔力邪印的负面效果，持续%debuff_duration%秒，每次施放技能都会治疗殁境神蚀者。

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_objurgation
abilities.description_zh: 提升殁境神蚀者的最大魔法值。施放后，殁境神蚀者获得全伤害护盾，数值为固定值 + 最大魔法值的一定百分比。
abilities.description_en: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.

scepter_loc.en: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below %automatic_trigger_threshold%%% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every %automatic_trigger_cd% seconds.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升最大魔法值转为护盾的比例。阻止让殁境神蚀者的血量低于%automatic_trigger_threshold%%%的伤害。阻止生效时，殁境神蚀者获得一次强驱散，和不可驱散的责难效果。这个效果每%automatic_trigger_cd%秒只能触发一次。

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_equilibrium
abilities.description_zh: 被动拥有一定几率在施放技能时回复最大魔法值的一定百分比。通过攻击特效的技能回复的魔法会减少。
abilities.description_en: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.
facet_text_en: When Essence Flux restores mana, it also temporarily increases maximum mana.
facet_text_zh: 精华变迁回复魔法时，还会暂时增加最大魔法值。

abilities.name: obsidian_destroyer_sanity_eclipse
abilities.description_zh: 释放出一道神智冲击波，伤害数值基于自身与目标的最大魔法值之差。神智之蚀可以作用于星体禁锢中的单位。
abilities.description_en: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.
facet_text_en: Affected Heroes gain a Mana Allergy Debuff for %debuff_duration% seconds, healing Outworld Destroyer every time they cast a spell.
facet_text_zh: 受到作用的英雄会获得一个魔力邪印的负面效果，持续%debuff_duration%秒，每次施放技能都会治疗殁境神蚀者。

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mana_as_ms}% of Current Mana as Movement Speed

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 或人或狼，狼人锋利的双爪和有力的下颚都是敌人的噩梦。他可以召唤隐形的战狼在前方侦察，或突袭敌人，他变身成狼后会获得极致的速度和力量，追杀敌人或在重重包围下逃出生天。
heroes.hero_summary_en: As a man or as a wolf, Lycan devastates enemies with sharp claws and deadly jaws. Summoning stealthy wolves to scout ahead or assault a foe, his wolf transformation grants him the speed and strength to run down his enemies, or escape an ambush.

abilities.name: lycan_summon_wolves
abilities.description_zh: 召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
abilities.description_en: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes_zh: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。
notes_en: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.

shard_loc.en: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
shard_loc.zh: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。

facet_text_en: Summoned Wolves are invulnerable and uncontrollable spirits that do not attack, but provide health and damage bonuses to Lycan.

Max Level increased to %max_level%. Level 5 wolves gain Hamstring, which empowers their attacks to root enemies and cause them to take more physical damage on attacks. Level 6 wolves have Hightail, an active ability that gives wolves phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
facet_text_zh: 召唤的狼为不可控的无敌幽灵，不会攻击，但会为狼人提供生命和攻击力加成。
最高等级可升至%max_level%级。5级精灵狼获得断筋，使他们的攻击可以缠绕敌人，并且使敌人被攻击时承受更多物理伤害。6级精灵狼拥有健步如飞，主动开启后精灵狼获得相位移动状态、闪避、移动速度和攻击速度。

abilities.name: lycan_howl
abilities.description_zh: 使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围%radius%范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。
abilities.description_en: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within %radius% range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.
facet_text_en: Max level decreased to %max_level%.
facet_text_zh: 最高等级减少至%max_level%级。

abilities.name: lycan_feral_impulse
abilities.description_zh: 提升狼人和所有他控制的单位的生命恢复和攻击力。
abilities.description_en: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.
facet_text_en: Max level decreased to %max_level%.
facet_text_zh: 最高等级减少至%max_level%级。

abilities.name: lycan_wolf_bite
abilities.description_zh: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得%lifesteal_percent%%%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过%lifesteal_range%就能共用吸血效果。
abilities.description_en: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain %lifesteal_percent%%% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within %lifesteal_range% range of each other.
notes_zh: 饿狼撕咬的冷却时间与变身的当前等级相同。
notes_en: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.

abilities.name: lycan_apex_predator
abilities.description_zh: 狼人和他控制的单位对中立生物造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

abilities.name: lycan_shapeshift
abilities.description_zh: 狼人展现出他的凶狼形态，获得致命一击的能力，并且提升夜间视野。在变身期间，狼人达到超高移动速度，并且不能被减速。移动速度和致命一击也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。
abilities.description_en: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
notes_zh: 狼人的移动速度不会受到妖术的影响。
notes_en: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.
facet_text_en: Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control. Enemy heroes killed by Lycan or his units extends Shapeshift duration by %kill_duration_extension%s.
facet_text_zh: 移动速度和致命一击加成效果也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。狼人或他的单位击杀敌方英雄后会使变身的持续时间延长%kill_duration_extension%秒。
