heroes.hero_summary_zh: 酒仙在任何局势中的战斗力都不可小觑，他只要分裂成三个身怀绝技的元素战士往往就可以力挽狂澜。而在平时，他那减速的猛击和强大的棍技将使敌人陷入醉酒般的混乱中。
heroes.hero_summary_en: A fearsome fighter in any situation, Brewmaster can turn the tide of battle by splitting into three elemental spirits, each with their own unique abilities. When not divided, he brings drunken chaos to his foes with slowing claps and powerful swings of his staff.

abilities.name: brewmaster_thunder_clap
abilities.description_zh: 猛击地面，造成伤害并降低附近敌方单位的移动速度和攻击速度。
abilities.description_en: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

abilities.name: brewmaster_cinder_brew
abilities.description_zh: 向敌人扔出一个酒桶，对沿途的敌人造成伤害，并在目标地点溅出酒液。路径上和溅酒点的敌人会浸满余烬佳酿，并且被减速。受到魔法或纯粹伤害后还将被点燃。点燃时持续时间增加%extra_duration%秒，并且受到持续伤害。
abilities.description_en: Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed.  If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.
facet_text_en: Cinder Brew is now a rolling barrel of ale that drenches enemies in its path and explodes at the end.
facet_text_zh: 余烬佳酿现在是装满酒的滚动酒桶，会使路径上的敌人浸满酒，并且在终点爆炸。

abilities.name: brewmaster_drunken_brawler
abilities.description_zh: 酒仙可以根据操控的元素来切换拳法。每当酒仙施放技能，他都会进入浸酒状态，拳法的威力提升%brewed_up_bonus%%%，持续%brewed_up_duration%秒。如果他在浸酒状态下又施放了技能，持续时间会延长%brewed_up_duration_extend%秒。浸酒状态结束后，他会进入大醉状态，%hangover_time%秒内无法再次进入浸酒状态。大地拳法 - 获得护甲和魔法抗性加成。狂风拳法 - 获得闪避和移动速度加成。烈火拳法 - 获得攻击速度加成，并且拥有几率造成致命一击伤害。
abilities.description_en: Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%%% for %brewed_up_duration%s.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
notes_zh: 与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。
notes_en: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

abilities.name: brewmaster_liquid_courage
abilities.description_zh: 当酒仙的生命值低于%min_health_threshold%%%，他就会获得状态抗性加成，而且他的移动速度每%speed_toggle_time%秒都会在加速和减速之间改变。血量越低，效果越强，从0开始到%max_health_threshold%%%生命值时达到最大数值。
abilities.description_en: When Brewmaster drops below %min_health_threshold%%% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every %speed_toggle_time%s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at %max_health_threshold%%% Health.

shard_loc.en: Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting %max_hp_regen%%% Max HP Regen per second.Lasts %drink_duration% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 向队友丢出一杯烈酒，或自己一饮而尽，获得壮胆酒的最大效果，并且还会获得每秒%max_hp_regen%%%最大生命值的回复。持续%drink_duration%秒。

abilities.name: brewmaster_primal_split
abilities.description_zh: 酒仙分裂成元素，产生3个各有所长的战士，生存能力极强，每个都拥有独特技能。只要其中任何一个在召唤时间结束后存活下来，酒仙就能重生。每个战士都会获得对应的醉拳拳法。
abilities.description_en: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
notes_zh: 大地战士将继承酒仙的所有光环，以及真视宝石的真视效果。
烈火战士拥有相位移动的能力。
技能结束后，酒仙会根据大地→狂风→烈火的顺序选择未阵亡的元素重生。
notes_en: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.

scepter_loc.en: Primal Split gains %scepter_bonus_levels% max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.
scepter_loc.zh: 元素分离获得%scepter_bonus_levels%级最高和当前等级，强化元素战士和他们的技能。元素分离可以提前结束，而且元素分离开始时元素战士是浸酒状态。

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_brewed_up_duration}/{s:bonus_brewed_up_duration_extend}s Drunken Brawler Brew Up / Extend Duration

After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.

When Brewmaster drops below %min_health_threshold%%% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every %speed_toggle_time%s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at %max_health_threshold%%% Health.

Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 暗影恶魔可以放出魔性毒云伤害敌人，或侦察战场，胆敢接近他的敌人寥寥无几。将敌人放逐，给友军聚集的时间将其击杀，他还能召唤出敌人的幻象反攻敌人，在他身上施加恶魔的诅咒。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Spewing clouds of demonic poison to damage enemies or scout the battlefield, few dare to approach Shadow Demon. Banishing an enemy as his allies gather for the kill, he can inflict demonic curses as he summons traitorous illusions to turn enemy strength against itself.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_disruption
abilities.description_zh: 将目标单位从战场上放逐一段时间。回归时会产生该单位的2个具有额外基础攻击力的幻象，受暗影恶魔控制。
abilities.description_en: Banishes the targeted unit from the battlefield for a short duration.  Upon returning, two illusions of the banished unit with bonus base damage are created under Shadow Demon's control.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_disseminate
abilities.description_zh: 只要目标受到伤害，目标附近%radius%范围内所有敌人，若目标为敌人那也包括目标自身，他们都将受到该伤害的一定百分比。可以对敌方或友方目标施放。敌人被崩裂禁锢隐藏时效果暂停。
abilities.description_en: Whenever the target takes damage, all enemies, including the target itself if it is an enemy, within %radius% range of the target also receive a portion of that damage. Can target enemy and allied units. Effect is paused if the target is hidden by Disruption.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
facet_text_en: If the target is an enemy, they lose %health_lost%%% of their health, regaining half of it after the effect is lifted. If the target is an ally, increases their health by that amount instead.
facet_text_zh: 如果目标是敌人，他们会损失%health_lost%%%生命值，效果结束后会回复一半的生命。如果目标是友军，会增加相应数值的生命。

abilities.name: shadow_demon_shadow_poison
abilities.description_zh: 在一条直线上造成伤害，并以毒咒折磨敌方单位。根据目标身上的叠加层数，毒咒造成1/2/4/8/16倍的叠加伤害，至多%max_multiply_stacks%层。更多层的叠加每层造成%bonus_stack_damage%点伤害。这部分延缓的伤害在暗影毒的持续时间结束后生效，或者使用附属技能立刻造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Deals damage in a line, and afflicts enemy units with a poison effect. The poison deals 1/2/4/8/16 times the stack damage based on the number of stacks on the target, up to %max_multiply_stacks% stacks. Additional stacks cause %bonus_stack_damage% damage each.  This deferred damage is dealt when Shadow Poison's duration is expired, or the Release sub-ability is used.
notes_zh: 暗影剧毒可以作用处于崩裂禁锢的单位。
notes_en: Shadow Poison can affect units under Disruption.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_demonic_cleanse
abilities.description_zh: 净愈目标友方单位，在持续时间内移除负面效果。在持续时间结束时该单位受到治疗效果。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净愈的效果。驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en: Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 净愈的持续时间内将持续移除目标的负面状态。
notes_en: Negative buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Cleanse.

abilities.name: shadow_demon_demonic_purge
abilities.description_zh:
净化目标敌方单位，移除增益魔法效果，并使目标在持续时间内减速。伤害在持续时间结束时计算，在此之前目标单位的移动速度缓慢地恢复。崩裂禁锢中的单位依然可以受到邪恶净化的影响。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Purges the target enemy unit, removing positive buffs, and slowing the target for the duration.  The unit slowly regains its speed until the end of the duration, upon which damage is dealt.  Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Purge.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 减速效果起始时为%max_slow%%%，然后持续减少至%min_slow%%%。
邪恶净化的持续时间内将持续移除目标的有益状态。
notes_en: The slow starts at %max_slow%%% and decreases over time to %min_slow%%%.
Positive buffs are continously removed from the target for the duration of the Purge.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Demonic Purge to break and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 邪恶净化具有破坏效果，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

abilities.name: shadow_demon_menace
abilities.description_zh: 暗影恶魔的攻击会对敌人施加一个可叠加的负面状态，使他们受到的伤害增加，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Shadow Demon's Attacks apply a stacking debuff to the enemy for %duration% seconds that increases their damage taken.
notes_zh: 破坏会使技能无法施加新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的状态失效。
notes_en: Break disables the application of new stacks.
Break does not disable the effects of existing stacks.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_shadow_demon_purge_poison
talents_raw.desc_loc: 1 Shadow Poison Stack is applied per second

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 独行德鲁伊与强大的熊灵并肩作战，敌军和他们的防御工事都会被熊掌碾压。必要时他施展变身之术在近战和远程攻击之间切换，只要他和他的伙伴获得了足够的力量，任何人都休想抵挡他们。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Battling alongside his powerful spirit bear, Lone Druid demolishes enemy forces and structures. Switching as needed between ranged and melee attacks with his transformation, should he have enough time to arm and strengthen both himself and his companion, there is little that can stop them.

abilities.name: lone_druid_entangle
abilities.description_zh: 敌方英雄获得%hits_required%层叠加效果后独行德鲁伊可以缠绕敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。施放时，对区域内每个敌方英雄施加%hits_incremented_on_active%层叠加效果，对敌方非英雄单位施加%hits_required%层。独行德鲁伊的攻击还会被强化%lone_druid_buff_duration%秒，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加%lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip%层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。升级这个技能也会升级熊灵的缠绕之爪技能。
abilities.description_en: Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain %hits_required% stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.When cast, applies %hits_incremented_on_active% stacks to each enemy hero in the area and %hits_required% stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for %lone_druid_buff_duration%s, making him apply %lone_druid_counters_applied_tooltip% stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
notes_zh: 被缠绕的单位将无法使用闪烁类技能，如果进入隐身状态也会显形。
独行德鲁伊的强化增益和敌人叠加计数减益无法被驱散。
缠绕的减益效果可以被驱散。
独行德鲁伊或者熊灵的攻击不会使非英雄单位获得叠加效果，只会在施放缠绕之根时使他们被缠绕。
对肉山的作用机制和英雄相同。
notes_en: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.

scepter_loc.en: Entangle applies %hits_required% stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.
scepter_loc.zh: 缠绕之根会对区域内敌方英雄施加%hits_required%层叠加效果，并且作用范围提升。触发缠绕的敌人不再受到保护，可以继续获得新的叠加层数。

abilities.name: lone_druid_spirit_link
abilities.description_zh: 连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
abilities.description_en: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
notes_zh: 破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。
notes_en: Break disables the shared lifesteal.

scepter_loc.en: Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for %duration%s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by %active_bonus%%%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around. The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.
scepter_loc.zh: 独行德鲁伊切断与熊灵的链接，并与目标友方英雄建立链接，与他们共享灵魂链接的加成效果，持续%duration%秒。护甲共享和攻击速度加成的效果均提升%active_bonus%%%。友军造成的伤害会治疗独行德鲁伊，反之亦然。熊灵在变形期间会被恐惧，除非熊灵也拥有阿哈利姆神杖。

facet_text_en: Shared Armor increased. Damage dealt by either the Spirit Bear or Lone Druid will heal the other.
Only damage dealt by Spirit Bear heals Lone Druid.
facet_text_zh: 共享护甲提升。熊灵和独行德鲁伊造成的伤害可以分别治疗对方。
只有熊灵造成的伤害可以治疗独行德鲁伊。

abilities.name: lone_druid_savage_roar
abilities.description_zh: 独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人恐惧，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加%bonus_speed%%%。
abilities.description_en: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by %bonus_speed%%%.
notes_zh: 被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与熊灵共享冷却时间。
notes_en: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.

shard_loc.en: Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh: 施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。施法效果会在独行德鲁伊和熊灵之间复制，不论双方是否可以施法。驱散类型：弱驱散

abilities.name: lone_druid_spirit_bear
abilities.description_zh:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过%bear_attack_leash_range%，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的%backlash_damage%%%作为反冲伤害。
熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。
abilities.description_en:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.If the bear moves %bear_attack_leash_range% distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers %backlash_damage%%% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
notes_zh: 熊灵受到的大多数技能效果与英雄相同。
熊灵的基础属性为0，基础护甲为0并拥有%base_magic_resistance%%%基础魔法抗性。熊灵装备的物品或享受的加成效果具有的属性对熊灵的加成效果与全才英雄类似。
熊灵无法获得经验。熊灵会跟随独行德鲁伊一起升级。
熊灵拥有自己的阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果。
熊灵会获得独行德鲁伊身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。
notes_en: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.
facet_text_en: Increases the distance from Lone Druid at which the Spirit Bear can attack.
facet_text_zh: 提升了独行德鲁伊和熊灵相距较远时允许熊灵攻击的距离。

abilities.name: lone_druid_true_form
abilities.description_zh: 独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击的能力，但是获得额外护甲，额外生命值和额外攻击力。
abilities.description_en: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.
facet_text_en: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining increased bonus armor, more health, and improved versions of Entangling Claws and Demolish.
Lone Druid morphs his Spirit Bear into an enraged form that gains bonus armor, attack speed, demolish damage, and a %entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%% cooldown on Entangling Claws.
facet_text_zh: 独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击能力，但获得了额外护甲和生命值并获得更厉害的缠绕之爪和粉碎击。
独行德鲁伊把自己的熊灵变为狂怒形态，获得额外护甲、攻击速度和粉碎击伤害，并且缠绕之爪的冷却时间减少至%entangling_claws_cooldown_reduction_pct%%%。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_lone_druid_1
talents_raw.desc_loc: Also applies to Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws Root

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 混沌骑士独自成军。他可以召唤一队骑兵复制体粉碎敌人的防御工事，如果有敌人现身，他将现实撕裂，把他和他的幻象大军拉到目标身前，然后残酷的战棍会如同暴雨般落在目标的头上。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Chaos Knight is an army unto himself. Able to summon a cavalry of clones to demolish enemy defenses, should an enemy present itself, he can rift reality to pull him and his phantasms close enough to rain brutal cudgel blows upon their head.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_chaos_bolt
abilities.description_zh: 对目标单位投掷一支神秘的能量箭。造成随机时间的眩晕和随机的伤害。
abilities.description_en: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
notes_zh: 眩晕持续时间和伤害值为负相关。
附近的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
notes_en: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.

shard_loc.en: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals %illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%% less damage.
shard_loc.zh: 混乱之箭会制造一个混沌之军的幻象来攻击目标。这个幻象造成的伤害减少%illusion_damage_reduction_pct%%%。

abilities.name: chaos_knight_reality_rift
abilities.description_zh: 将混沌骑士及混沌骑士的幻象和目标单位传送到混沌骑士与目标连线上的一点。降低敌方单位的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.
notes_zh: 目标单位将会强制面向混沌骑士，而且混沌骑士和幻象默认对目标发动攻击。
notes_en: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.

shard_loc.en: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.
shard_loc.zh: 实相裂隙可以对自身或幻象1200范围内的任意敌方英雄施放。自身英雄和所有幻象会集合，并传送至敌方目标处。

facet_text_en: Reality Rift has equal chances of applying Break, Disarm, or Silence for %additional_debuff_duration_percent%%% of the base debuff duration in addition to its normal effects.
facet_text_zh: 实相裂隙除了平常效果外，还有均等几率施加破坏、缴械或沉默，持续时间为基础负面效果时间的%additional_debuff_duration_percent%%%。

abilities.name: chaos_knight_chaos_strike
abilities.description_zh: 混沌骑士和他的幻象在攻击时有几率造成威力不一的致命一击，并且触发时具有吸血效果。对非英雄单位的吸血效果减少。
abilities.description_en: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_fundamental_forging
abilities.description_zh: 混沌骑士的中立物品额外获得一个随机附魔。
abilities.description_en: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
notes_zh: 随机附魔会从该级别的所有可选附魔中选取，包括一般不会对力量英雄开放的附魔，拥有负面效果的附魔除外。
随机附魔不会和选定附魔重复。
notes_en: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

abilities.name: chaos_knight_phantasm
abilities.description_zh:
从其他维度召唤若干个混沌骑士的幻象。幻象继承%outgoing_damage_tooltip%%%攻击力，但是承受%incoming_damage_tooltip%%%伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal %outgoing_damage_tooltip%%% damage, but take %incoming_damage_tooltip%%% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 能够移除混沌骑士的大部分负面状态。
混沌骑士在施放时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以躲避眩晕和伤害技能。
notes_en: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.

scepter_loc.en: Gains a passive component.  When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a %bonus_illusion_chance%%% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.
scepter_loc.zh: 增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有%bonus_illusion_chance%%%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for %duration%s.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 米波可以召唤多达四个永久复制体，使自己同时在多条战线上作战。他的分身四散在战场上，一旦找到敌人，他就会将其束缚，其余分身在爆炸性的传送中集合，然后将遇难者亲手埋葬。
heroes.hero_summary_en: By summoning up to five permanent copies of himself, Meepo can fight from every front at once. Spreading his clones throughout the battlefield, when an enemy is found, he binds his foe, gathers his selves with an explosive teleport, then buries what remains.

abilities.name: meepo_earthbind
abilities.description_zh: 向目标地点扔出一张网，缠绕区域内所有敌方单位。
abilities.description_en: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
notes_zh: 地之束缚可以使敌方单位在进入隐身后显形，但是不能作用于已经隐身的单位。
对减益免疫单位和肉山无效。
notes_en: Affects invisible units, revealing them.
Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

abilities.name: meepo_poof
abilities.description_zh: 通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
abilities.description_en: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
notes_zh: 可以点击小地图施放。
可以传送至米波的幻象。
notes_en: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.

abilities.name: meepo_ransack
abilities.description_zh: 每次攻击都会窃取敌人的生命值，并治疗所有其他米波相同数值生命。对非英雄单位的效果减少至60%。
abilities.description_en: Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.Reduced to 60% against creeps.
notes_zh: 治疗数值会被生命回复增强效果提升。
notes_en: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification

abilities.name: meepo_petrify
abilities.description_zh: 挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续%duration%秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的%hp_restore%%%。被缠绕时无法施放。驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en: Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for %duration%s. Restores %hp_restore%%% of his max health over that duration.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

abilities.name: meepo_megameepo
abilities.description_zh:
主米波将%radius%范围内其他米波放到自己的肩膀上。在这个形态下，他会获得其他米波%stats_pct%%%的属性，并且可以把他们扔向敌人，造成伤害和减速。

生效时地之束缚会产生额外的网，身上每只米波都会使忽悠造成额外%poof_damage_factor%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a %radius% radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains %stats_pct%%% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals %poof_damage_factor%%% more damage for each Meepo on top.

abilities.name: meepo_divided_we_stand
abilities.description_zh: 米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少%dps_penalty_pct%%%。任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。
abilities.description_en: Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them %dps_penalty_pct%%% less effective.If any Meepo dies, they all die.
facet_text_en: Can now be upgraded at level %required_level% and every %bonus_levels_between_upgrades% levels afterwards to a max level of %max_level%. Duplicate Meepos receive %main_meepo_stats_pct%%% of the main Meepo's bonus attributes.
All Meepos have a stackable aura that increases nearby Meepos' attack speed by %support_group_attack_speed_pct%%% and armor by %support_group_armor%. Radius: %support_radius%.
facet_text_zh: 现在可以在%required_level%级时学习，之后每%bonus_levels_between_upgrades%级可以再升级一次，最高为%max_level%级。米波克隆体获得米波本体%main_meepo_stats_pct%%%的额外属性。
所有米波都拥有可叠加的光环，提升附近米波%support_group_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度和%support_group_armor%点护甲。作用范围：%support_radius%。

abilities.name: meepo_geomancy
abilities.description_zh: 米波会根据所在地形给予自身和克隆体可叠加的加成效果。每个米波都会给予其他米波自身的加成。如果%tree_radius%范围内有树木，他会获得%tree_regen%点/秒生命恢复。如果他站在土地上，他会获得%dirt_move_speed%%%移动速度加成。如果他在水中，他的攻击会减缓目标%water_move_slow%%%移速，持续%water_slow_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain.  Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.If there is a tree within %tree_radius% range, he receives %tree_regen% HP regen.If he is standing on dirt, he receives %dirt_move_speed%%% bonus movement speed.If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by %water_move_slow%%% for %water_slow_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 土地包括所有水之外的地形。
notes_en: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

abilities.name: meepo_megameepo_fling
abilities.description_zh: 在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向%AbilityCastRange%范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。
abilities.description_en: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a %AbilityCastRange% range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
notes_zh: 不会触发法术反弹。
notes_en: Does not trigger spell reflect.

talents_raw.name_loc: Earthbind grants True Strike on Targets

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 树精卫士永远是友善的盟友，他可以让同伴和高塔萌发恢复性的护甲。他在树林中不会显露踪迹，还可以用疯狂生长的植物束缚敌人，同时将敌人的生命渡给附近的盟友。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Treant Protector is ever the benevolent ally, sprouting regenerating armor for his cohorts and their fortifications alike. Emerging unseen from among the trees, he binds foes with overgrowth as he leeches health from enemies and into nearby allies.

abilities.name: treant_natures_grasp
abilities.description_zh: 朝目标地点制造藤蔓。藤蔓对穿过的敌人造成减速和伤害。对非英雄单位造成的伤害减少%creep_penalty%%%。
abilities.description_en: Creates vines towards the target location. Vines slow down and deal damage to enemies that walk through. Does %creep_penalty%%% less damage to creeps.

abilities.name: treant_leech_seed
abilities.description_zh: 树精卫士的攻击会对敌方单位种下一颗吸取生命的种子。该单位会受到额外魔法伤害，被缠绕和缴械一小段时间，并放出%healing_pulse_count%次治疗脉冲，最多对附近%max_heal_units%名友军根据当次攻击造成的伤害进行治疗。
abilities.description_en: Treant's attack plants a life-sapping seed in an enemy unit. That unit takes additional magic damage, is rooted and disarmed for a short duration, and emits %healing_pulse_count% healing pulses to up to %max_heal_units% nearby allies of Treant Protector based on the damage dealt by the attack.
facet_text_en: Leech Seed can be ground targeted, planting a tree that heals allies and damages all enemies in the effect radius for the duration of the ability. Damage to creeps is reduced by %creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%. If the tree is cut down, it immediately re-grows again.
facet_text_zh: 寄生种子可以对地施放，种下一棵树，在技能的持续时间内治疗作用范围内的友军并对敌人造成伤害。对非英雄单位的伤害和治疗均减少%creep_damage_reduction_pct%%%。树被砍掉会立刻长回来。

abilities.name: treant_living_armor
abilities.description_zh: 将目标英雄或建筑笼罩在保护性外壳中，治疗目标并格挡来自玩家控制来源的伤害。每次本技能格挡伤害后，下次的伤害格挡量都会减少。如果伤害格挡量降至0，加成效果会提前移除。
abilities.description_en: Infuses the target hero or structure with a protective coating which heals the target and blocks damage from player-controlled sources. Each time this spell blocks damage, the block amount is decreased. If the damage block is decreased to 0, the buff is removed early.
notes_zh: 低于%damage_block_threshold%点的伤害会被无视。
notes_en: Instances of damage less than %damage_block_threshold% are ignored.

shard_loc.en: Increases the Damage Blocked by Living Armor. Treant now also passively benefits from Living Armor, with the damage block resetting after not taking damage for %passive_reset_cd% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 提升活体护甲的伤害格挡量。树精卫士现在还会被动获得活体护甲的加成效果，%passive_reset_cd%秒内未受到伤害后伤害格挡量会重置。

abilities.name: treant_eyes_in_the_forest
abilities.description_zh: 树精卫士对目标树木灌注魔力。注魔后树木将拥有周围的顺畅视野。树眼持续%duration%秒，为隐形状态，但是寄生的树木被摧毁或者树眼直接被攻击后都会被摧毁。
abilities.description_en: Treant Protector enchants a tree, which grants him unobstructed vision in that location. The eyes last for %duration% seconds and are invisible, but are destroyed if their host tree is destroyed or if they are attacked directly.
notes_zh: 丛林之眼的树木产生的疯狂生长效果也可以造成伤害。
如果敌人拥有真实视域，他们将会发现被灌注魔力的树木。
notes_en: Being entangled by Overgrowth through enchanted trees from Eyes in the Forest does damage.
If the enemy has True Sight, they will be able to see which trees are enchanted.

abilities.name: treant_natures_guise
abilities.description_zh: 只要靠近树木就会获得移动速度加成。树精卫士在%cooldown_time%秒内不受到伤害就会额外获得树木穿行。树木穿行时，自然蔽护可以主动使用，使树精卫士获得隐身状态，直到他主动攻击，或不再靠近树木。
abilities.description_en: Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.
notes_zh: 自然蔽护效果下树精卫士可以直接穿过树木。
自然卷握的藤蔓在这个技能下被视为树木。
树木穿行时，受到伤害并不会禁用主动效果或树木穿行。
notes_en: While affected by Nature's Guise, Treant can move unobstructed through other trees.
Vines from Nature's Grasp are considered trees for this ability.
While Tree Walking, taking damage does not disable the active ability or Tree Walking.

abilities.name: treant_overgrowth
abilities.description_zh: 在树精卫士周围召唤出疯狂生长的伤害性藤条和枝干，造成伤害并且阻止被缠绕的敌人移动、闪烁、进入隐身或攻击。
abilities.description_en: Summons an overgrowth of vines and branches around Treant that deal damage to afflicted enemies and prevent them from moving, blinking, going invisible, or attacking.
notes_zh: 效果无视减益免疫，但是在期间获得减益免疫状态将挣脱控制。
notes_en: Works on Debuff Immune units, but if units gain debuff immunity after the effect starts, they'll break free.

scepter_loc.en: Decreases Cooldown to %AbilityCooldown% seconds. When casting Overgrowth, Treant Protector draws power from the soil, greatly increasing his size for %bloom_duration% seconds. While enlarged, he gains phased movement with a fixed speed of %movement_speed%, %strength_bonus%%% bonus Strength, and a splashing attack that deals %splash_pct%%% of his attack damage in a %splash_radius% unit radius.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间降低至%AbilityCooldown%秒。施放疯狂生长时，树精卫士从土壤中汲取力量，他的身体急剧增大，持续%bloom_duration%秒。变大后他会获得相位移动状态，移动速度为固定%movement_speed%，%strength_bonus%%%力量加成，并且拥有在%splash_radius%范围内造成%splash_pct%%%攻击伤害的溅射攻击。

Grants bonus movement speed when near trees. Treant Protector additionally has Tree Walking if he has not taken damage for %cooldown_time% seconds. While Tree Walking, Nature's Guise can be activated to grant Treant invisibility until he attacks or is no longer near a tree.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 每次施法都有机会获得数倍的效果，食人魔魔法师只要稍微走点运就能将敌人烧成灰烬，或者提升队友的力量。当然，有时候运气还是很难把握的……
heroes.hero_summary_en: With a chance to multiply the outcome of each spell they cast, a bit of luck is all Ogre Magi needs to burn enemies to cinder, or boost the power of his allies. Of course, luck can be difficult to rely upon...

abilities.name: ogre_magi_fireblast
abilities.description_zh: 以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。
notes_en: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.

scepter_loc.en: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increasing cast speed by %bonus_cast_speed%%%.
scepter_loc.zh: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，施法速度提升%bonus_cast_speed%%%。

abilities.name: ogre_magi_ignite
abilities.description_zh: 使目标和另一个随机单位浸透在挥发性化学物质中，导致其瞬间被火焰吞噬。目标处在极度痛苦之中，受到伤害并且移动缓慢。
abilities.description_en: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes_zh: 多重施法将使此技能有几率对%ignite_multicast_aoe%范围内的随机敌方单位进行多次施放。
引燃现在击中已受到作用的单位后会增加持续时间。
notes_en: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a %ignite_multicast_aoe% area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_bloodlust
abilities.description_zh: 激起一个友方单位的狂暴，增加其移动和攻击速度。对食人魔魔法师自身施放时攻击速度加成更高。可以对防御塔施放。
abilities.description_en: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_bloodlust_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得嗜血术效果。
notes_en: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_bloodlust_aoe% area of effect to receive Bloodlust.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_unrefined_fireblast
abilities.description_zh: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成%base_damage% + %str_multiplier%倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标眩晕。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的%scepter_mana%%%。
abilities.description_en: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing %base_damage% + %str_multiplier%x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is %scepter_mana%%% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有%multicast_delay%秒的间隔。
notes_en: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a %multicast_delay% seconds interval.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_smash
abilities.description_zh: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来%attacks%次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。
abilities.description_en: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next %attacks% attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes_zh: 触发多重施法时，%multicast_fireshield_aoe%范围内的友方单位将随机获得烈火护盾效果。
notes_en: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an %multicast_fireshield_aoe% area of effect to receive Fire Shield.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_dumb_luck
abilities.description_zh: 食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。
abilities.description_en: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

abilities.name: ogre_magi_multicast
abilities.description_zh: 使食人魔魔法师在单次施法中有概率多次施放同一技能和物品。每%strength_for_one_pct%点力量提升%one_tooltip%%%多重施法几率。
abilities.description_en: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every %strength_for_one_pct% Strength adds %one_tooltip%%%.
notes_zh: 只有指向性技能和物品有几率触发多重施法。
指向性技能和物品额外对食人魔周围一定作用范围内敌人和中立生物生效。火焰爆轰和未精通的火焰爆轰将对同个目标生效多次。
notes_en: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.
facet_text_en: Each point of Ogre Magi's Strength adds %strength_mult%%% to Ogre Magi's Multicast chance.
facet_text_zh: 食人魔魔法师的每点力量值都会使多重施法的几率提升%strength_mult%%%。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ogre_magi_dumb_luck_mana
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mana_per_str}/{s:bonus_mana_regen_per_str} Dumb Luck Mana/Mana Regen Per Strength

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 蹒跚进入战场的不朽尸王将迫使敌人做出决定，到底是逃离他的愤怒，还是被愤怒撕裂。他可以吸取敌军的力量，召唤出一群拼命的亡灵。等到他最终变成魁梧的血肉傀儡，他的敌人早已被碾压殆尽。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Shambling into battle, Undying forces enemies to decide whether to flee his wrath or be torn apart by it. He drains strength from his foes, and summons a horde of clawing undead. When he finally becomes a hulking flesh golem, his enemies may already be overwhelmed.

abilities.name: undying_decay
abilities.description_zh: 不朽尸王偷取区域内所有敌方英雄的力量，造成基础伤害并将敌人的力量据为己有。对非英雄单位造成%creep_damage_multiplier%倍伤害。
abilities.description_en: Undying steals strength from all enemy heroes in an area, dealing base damage as he claims the enemy's strength for himself. Deals %creep_damage_multiplier%x damage to creeps.
notes_zh: 窃据的力量可以叠加，但是敌方英雄的力量至少为1点。
力量的窃取先于技能造成的伤害。
可以作用隐形单位。
notes_en: The strength stolen stacks, but can't cause a hero to have strength below 1.
The strength steal takes effect before the damage is dealt.
Affects invisible units.

scepter_loc.en: Increases strength steal.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升力量窃取。

abilities.name: undying_soul_rip
abilities.description_zh: 不朽尸王从附近的所有单位身上扯出生命力，并使用它治疗队友或伤害敌人。可以使用噬魂治疗墓碑。
abilities.description_en: Undying rips health away from all nearby units and uses it to heal an ally, or damage an enemy. Soul Rip can also be used to heal Tombstone.
notes_zh: 可以治疗墓碑，但是不能治疗或伤害其他建筑。
不会扯出隐身单位、无敌单位、战争迷雾内单位或减益免疫敌人的生命力。
可以扯出减益免疫友军，包括僵尸的生命力。
notes_en: Can heal Tombstone, but can't heal or damage other buildings.
Does not rip from invisible units, invulnerable units, units in the fog of war, or spell immune enemies.
Does rip from spell immune allies, including zombies.
facet_text_en: Casting Soul Rip on allies increases their Strength by a percentage of Undying's Strength.
facet_text_zh: 对友军施放噬魂会使他们的力量提升，数值为不朽尸王力量的一定百分比。

abilities.name: undying_tombstone
abilities.description_zh: 在目标位置召唤一座墓碑。墓碑会不断在其附近的每个敌方单位身边产生僵尸攻击他们。僵尸拥有死亡渴望技能，使他们的攻击带有减速效果，并且若目标的生命值低于一定百分比，僵尸的攻击和移动速度会提升。
abilities.description_en: Summons a tombstone at the target point.  Zombies will frequently spawn next to every enemy unit in the area around the Tombstone, and attack them.  Zombies have the Deathlust ability, which causes their attacks to slow the target, and if the target reaches below a certain amount of health, increases the attack and movement speed of the zombie.
notes_zh: 墓碑免疫技能，但是可以被噬魂治疗。
僵尸和墓碑均免疫技能。
如果初始目标死亡或丢失视野，僵尸将会死亡。
notes_en: Tombstone is Spell Immune, but can be healed by Soul Rip.
Zombies and Tombstone are Spell Immune.
If their initial target dies or goes out of vision, the Zombie will die.

shard_loc.en: Tombstone can be cast on an allied hero to bunker inside of the tombstone. Heroes that enter the Tombstone cannot leave for %tombstone_bunker_cd% seconds nor can they re-enter after leaving. If the tombstone is destroyed with a hero inside, that hero gets stunned for %tombstone_stun_penalty% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 墓碑可以对友方英雄施放，让他们躲进墓碑。进入墓碑的英雄%tombstone_bunker_cd%秒内无法离开，离开后同样的时间内无法再次进入。如果英雄在内时墓碑被摧毁，该英雄会被眩晕%tombstone_stun_penalty%秒。

abilities.name: undying_ceaseless_dirge
abilities.description_zh: 不朽尸王阵亡时会立刻在泉水复活。比赛开始时处于冷却状态。无法被刷新。
abilities.description_en: When Undying dies he will instantly respawn in the fountain. Begins the game on cooldown. Cannot be refreshed.

abilities.name: undying_flesh_golem
abilities.description_zh: 不朽尸王变身为一具令人毛骨悚然的血肉傀儡。在这个状态下，他获得一定百分比的力量加成，移动速度加成，并且攻击附带减速和伤害加深效果，还会产生墓碑的僵尸。
abilities.description_en: Undying transforms into a horrifying flesh golem.  While in this state, he gains a percentage increase to strength, bonus movement speed, and causes attacks to slow, apply damage amplification, and spawn Tombstone zombies.
facet_text_en: While transformed into a Flesh Golem, attacks spawn a zombie.
facet_text_zh: 变身为血肉傀儡后，每次攻击会产生一个僵尸。

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 拉比克总是在伺机窃取全新的法术，以彼之道还施彼身。他将敌人举向空中恣意丢弃，肆无忌惮地在毫无防备的敌人之中散布混乱。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Always seeking a new spell to steal, Rubick is ever eager to turn an enemy's most unique advantage against them. Snatching his enemies into the air to fling them where he will, he has no trouble sowing chaos among careless foes.

abilities.name: rubick_telekinesis
abilities.description_zh: 拉比克利用他的隔空取物能力，将敌人短暂抬到空中，然后猛投向地面。被投下的单位会砸晕落地点附近的敌人。
abilities.description_en: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 目标滞空时，拉比克可以使用次级技能将目标扔往目标方向。
单位落地后，自身不会受到范围眩晕效果。
notes_en: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.

shard_loc.en: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 可以对自身或友军施放隔空取物。投掷距离增加至%max_land_distance%，投掷延迟降低至%shard_teammate_throw_delay%秒。

abilities.name: rubick_fade_bolt
abilities.description_zh: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。
abilities.description_en: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.

abilities.name: rubick_arcane_supremacy
abilities.description_zh: 拉比克对奥术的熟稔使他拥有更远的施法距离，和额外技能增强。
abilities.description_en: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
facet_text_en: Casting a spell temporarily increases the area of effect for all subsequent spells.
facet_text_zh: 施放技能会暂时提升拉比克施放后续技能的作用范围。

abilities.name: rubick_spell_steal
abilities.description_zh: 拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
abilities.description_en: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
notes_zh: 无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。
notes_en: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.

scepter_loc.en: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
scepter_loc.zh: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。

shard_loc.en: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
shard_loc.zh: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。

facet_text_en: Stolen spells also have lower mana cost.
facet_text_zh: 窃取技能的魔法消耗也会降低。

abilities.name: rubick_curiosity
abilities.description_zh: 拉比克现在每级获得%curiosity_per_level%层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供%curiosity_attack_damage%点基础攻击力，%curiosity_modifier_amp%%%增益/减益持续时间，和%curiosity_aoe_bonus%作用范围加成。如果拉比克看到%charge_radius%范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得%curiosity_per_spell_cast%层奇心，持续%curiosity_duration%秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后%grace_period%秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得%curiosity_per_kill%层奇心。
abilities.description_en: Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus. If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds.  If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 干扰者尤其擅长搅乱敌人的计划。他可以召唤无法逾越的围栏困住目标，降下一阵使人沉默的风暴，如果敌人发动突袭，他还可以直接将对手往回传送。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Disruptor excels at shattering the plans of his enemies. Summoning impassable fences to trap targets as he calls down a silencing storm, should a foe attempt something unexpected he simply teleports them back to their earlier location.

abilities.name: disruptor_thunder_strike
abilities.description_zh: 用闪电反复打击目标单位。每次打击会伤害附近小范围内的敌方单位，并施加%slow_duration%秒的%slow_amount%%%攻击速度和移动速度降低效果。提供目标的视野。
abilities.description_en: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.

shard_loc.en: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.
shard_loc.zh: 提升风雷之击的施法距离和打击次数。还可以对地施放，使风雷之击先潜伏最多%shard_ground_delay%秒，并附着到第一个进入作用范围的敌人身上。

facet_text_en: Thunder Strike additionally hits all enemies within Kinetic Field. Thunder Strike Slow duration is increased to %slow_duration%s.
facet_text_zh: 风雷之击还会额外打击动能力场内所有敌人。风雷之击的减速时间提升至%slow_duration%秒。

abilities.name: disruptor_glimpse
abilities.description_zh: 将目标英雄传送回他%backtrack_time%秒前所在位置。瞬间消灭幻象单位。根据瞥视距离的一定百分比造成伤害，不能超过最大伤害。
abilities.description_en: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes_zh: 飞行时间由目标的飞行距离决定。
notes_en: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_field
abilities.description_zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一个敌人无法通过的环形动能屏障。
abilities.description_en: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
notes_zh: 力场不能困住减益免疫单位。
notes_en: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.

shard_loc.en: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.
shard_loc.zh: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_fence
abilities.description_zh: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。
abilities.description_en: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

abilities.name: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
abilities.description_zh: 每当干扰者受到%effect_radius%范围内来自任意来源的%damage_threshold%点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到%damage_per_int%倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多%effect_radius%距离。
abilities.description_en: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
notes_zh: %damage_reset_interval%秒后伤害计数会重置。
notes_en: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.

abilities.name: disruptor_static_storm
abilities.description_zh: 创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并沉默区域内的所有敌方单位。伤害刚开始时很低，但会在持续时间内逐渐增加。
abilities.description_en: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.

scepter_loc.en: Mutes items.
scepter_loc.zh: 锁闭物品。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_disruptor_consecutive_strike_damage
talents_raw.desc_loc: Every strike increases the damage of subsequent strikes until the debuff expires

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_disruptor_5
talents_raw.desc_loc: Also affects Kinetic Fence

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_disruptor_thunder_strike_strikes
talents_raw.desc_loc: Strikes are 50% faster

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 司夜刺客永远都在猎杀脆弱的目标。他无形地潜行在丛林中，寻找着他的猎物，他运用致命的利爪偷袭他们，刺人的尖刺让他们动弹不得，反弹的外壳还可以逆转一切反击。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Nyx Assassin is always hunting for fragile targets. Sneaking invisibly through the forest, when he spots his prey, he swipes them with his deadly claws and impales them on stunning spikes, then reverses any counterattack with his reflecting carapace.

abilities.name: nyx_assassin_impale
abilities.description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位受到伤害，然后被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%，最远作用距离为%length%。
穿刺不会被林肯法球格挡。
notes_en: The spikes move at %speed% units per second, over %length% range.
Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

abilities.name: nyx_assassin_jolt
abilities.description_zh: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。
abilities.description_en: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
facet_text_en: Mind Flare burns mana equal to a percentage of the target's max mana.
facet_text_zh: 神智爆裂会燃烧相当于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。

abilities.name: nyx_assassin_spiked_carapace
abilities.description_zh:
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。激活尖刺外壳不会打破复仇的隐身状态。

钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻眩晕周围的敌人。
abilities.description_en:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
notes_zh: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
尖刺外壳只有在受到玩家控制来源的伤害后会反弹。
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
notes_en: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: nyx_assassin_burrow
abilities.description_zh: 司夜刺客经过短时间的掘地后钻入地下。钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接眩晕附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。钻地后司夜刺客固定在原地，无法攻击，并且是隐身状态。同时司夜刺客受到的所有伤害都会降低。
abilities.description_en: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
notes_zh: 施放复仇将取消钻地状态。
notes_en: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.

abilities.name: nyx_assassin_neuro_sting
abilities.description_zh: 司夜刺客对敌人造成伤害还会燃烧造成伤害一定百分比的魔法。
abilities.description_en: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

abilities.name: nyx_assassin_vendetta
abilities.description_zh: 司夜刺客进入隐身状态并获得移动速度加成。如果司夜刺客以攻击打破隐身，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加破坏效果。司夜刺客当次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且攻击动作加快%attack_animation_bonus%%%。
abilities.description_en: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has %attack_range_bonus% additional attack range and a %attack_animation_bonus%%% faster attack animation for this attack.
notes_zh: 如果在隐身期间使用了技能，或者隐身时间结束，额外伤害的效果将会消失。
会在造成额外伤害前施加破坏效果。
notes_en: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.

shard_loc.en: Decreases cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s. For the first %free_pathing_duration%s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒。在复仇的最初%free_pathing_duration%秒内，司夜刺客为极速状态，并且移动无视地形。

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 娜迦海妖派出镜像的复制体攻击敌人，诱捕敌人将他们斩落，带领友军走向胜利。她还可以运用自己的嗓音，镇住周围的敌人，发动奇袭或组织快速的撤离。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Sending squads of mirrored clones against her foes, Naga Siren ensnares and slays enemies as she leads her forces to victory. With the sound of her voice, she disables nearby foes to spring an ambush or crafting a hasty escape.

abilities.name: naga_siren_mirror_image
abilities.description_zh:
制造多个受娜迦海妖控制的镜像。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 娜迦海妖在施法时有%invuln_duration%秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
施放后，将会移除娜迦海妖身上大部分效果。
施放时现有的镜像幻象将被摧毁。
notes_en: Naga Siren is invulnerable for %invuln_duration% seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

abilities.name: naga_siren_ensnare
abilities.description_zh: 打断目标的动作并将其困在原地，使其无法移动或闪烁。可以对海妖之歌作用下的单位施放。
abilities.description_en: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.

scepter_loc.en: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对减益免疫单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加破坏效果。

abilities.name: naga_siren_rip_tide
abilities.description_zh: 娜迦海妖和她的幻象每经过%hits%次攻击后就会对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的护甲，持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for %duration% seconds every %hits% attacks.
notes_zh: 使用激流不会打断持续施法。
notes_en: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.

abilities.name: naga_siren_eelskin
abilities.description_zh: 娜迦海妖拥有闪避加成，%radius%内每增加一个娜迦海妖都会提升。
abilities.description_en: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within %radius% radius.

abilities.name: naga_siren_song_of_the_siren
abilities.description_zh: 娜迦海妖周围的所有敌人受到魔法影响陷入停滞状态，既无法行动也不会受到攻击。再次使用海妖之歌可以提前停止效果。
abilities.description_en: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
notes_zh: 海妖之歌作用下的单位处于无敌状态，不会受到任何伤害。
海妖之歌的作用范围以娜迦海妖为中心，如果她远离了作用单位，他们将会醒来。
notes_en: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.

shard_loc.en: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.
shard_loc.zh: 海妖之歌范围内友军每秒会恢复一定百分比的生命和魔法。

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 对于任何团队而言光之守卫都是坚实的后盾。敌友的魔法均在他掌控之下，弱小的敌人将在光芒的冲击下轻易毁灭，而他进入灵魂形态后还能召集团队发动奇袭。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Keeper of the Light is a helpful addition to any team. Manipulating the mana of both his allies and enemies, he effortlessly destroys lesser foes with waves of illumination, then enters his spirit form to gather his team to press the assault.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_illuminate
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes_zh: 在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。
notes_en: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_blinding_light
abilities.description_zh: 一道致盲之光在目标区域闪现，把区域内的单位击退到区域边缘，并造成致盲，使他们的部分攻击不能命中。最短击退距离是在%knockback_duration%秒内击退%knockback_distance%距离。
abilities.description_en: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。
notes_en: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_chakra_magic
abilities.description_zh: 恢复目标单位的魔法值，并减少所有冷却中基础技能（非大招）的冷却时间。对自身使用时效果提升%self_bonus%%%。
abilities.description_en: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
notes_zh: 查克拉魔法无法减少终极技能的冷却时间。
notes_en: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_radiant_bind
abilities.description_zh: 削弱一个敌人的魔法抗性，并施加减速效果，目标移动的距离越长，减速效果越大。
abilities.description_en: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.

shard_loc.en: Grants %AbilityCharges% charges.
shard_loc.zh: 获得%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_will_o_wisp
abilities.description_zh: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes_zh: 幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。
notes_en: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_spirit_form
abilities.description_zh: 伊扎洛暂时使身体发光，获得施法距离加成，提升光明速度的移速加成，并且冲击波将由一个单独的灵魂施法，可以治疗友军。
abilities.description_en: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

shard_loc.en: Increases illuminate heal.
shard_loc.zh: 提升冲击波的治疗效果。

facet_text_en: Grants the Solar Bind ability while active.
Grants the Recall ability while active.
facet_text_zh: 灵魂形态生效时获得炎阳之缚技能。
使用后获得召回技能。

abilities.name: keeper_of_the_light_bright_speed
abilities.description_zh: 光之守卫每%intelligence_per_speed%点智力都会获得1移动速度。只要光之守卫移动%movement_per_vision%距离，他就会留下一道光，可以看到%vision_radius%范围，持续%vision_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

capability_review_signals.evidence_description_en: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.

CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.

A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.

A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is %knockback_distance% range over %knockback_duration% seconds.
Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is %self_bonus%%% more effective when used on himself.
Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.

Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every %intelligence_per_speed% Intelligence.Whenever Keeper of the Light moves %movement_per_vision% distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see %vision_radius% range for %vision_duration% seconds.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 艾欧生来就能让盟友力量倍增。身为强大的伙伴，精灵施展系链可以使盟友加速，敌人停滞。将战友连接并且在战场上任意传送，艾欧可以让危险的盟友更加致命。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Io has a talent for making allies more effective. A powerful companion, the wisp's tether speeds allies and stops enemies. Capable of linking to and teleporting across the battlefield with an ally, Io can make a dangerous ally even deadlier.

abilities.name: wisp_tether
abilities.description_zh: 将艾欧和一个友方单位连接在一起，提高双方的移动速度。当艾欧回复生命或魔法时，连在一起的友军将获得一部分回复效果。距离过远时连接将会断开，也可以主动断开连接。羁绊会减速触碰到的敌人。
abilities.description_en: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
notes_zh: 如果羁绊的目标距离艾欧700码以外，艾欧将链接目标并将自己向目标牵引（牵引后相距300码）。
被羁绊连接的单位回复速度相比更快，艾欧满血时也能回复。
艾欧的移动速度与羁绊目标一致。
notes_en: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.

shard_loc.en: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for %damage_to_heal%%% of the damage done.
shard_loc.zh: 羁绊会对触碰到的敌人造成伤害。艾欧会回复%damage_to_heal%%%造成伤害。

abilities.name: wisp_spirits
abilities.description_zh: 召唤五个围绕艾欧起舞的幽魂，对所有碰触到的单位造成伤害。如果碰到的是敌方英雄，幽魂会爆炸，对其附近的所有敌人造成伤害。普通单位碰到幽魂会受到轻微伤害，但是不会使其爆炸。持续时间结束后，幽魂将自动爆炸。
abilities.description_en: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
notes_zh: 召唤后艾欧可以拉近或拉远幽魂。
notes_en: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.

scepter_loc.en: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.
scepter_loc.zh: 每秒被动产生幽魂围绕艾欧，直至数量上限。幽魂撞到英雄会将其短暂减速。可以主动施放来引爆幽魂。

abilities.name: wisp_overcharge
abilities.description_zh: 艾欧获得攻击速度、技能增强和基于最大生命值的生命恢复。如果艾欧和一个友军连接，该单位也会获得过载提供的所有增益效果。
abilities.description_en: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.
facet_text_en: Overcharge grants attack speed and spell amplification to Io and any Tethered allies.
Overcharge grants armor and magic resistance to Io and any Tethered allies.
facet_text_zh: 过载会使艾欧和羁绊友军获得攻击速度和技能增强。
过载会使艾欧和羁绊友军获得护甲和魔法抗性。

abilities.name: wisp_spirits_in
abilities.description_zh: 让幽魂靠近你。可以切换开关状态。
abilities.description_en: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

abilities.name: wisp_spirits_out
abilities.description_zh: 让幽魂远离你。可以切换开关状态。
abilities.description_en: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

abilities.name: wisp_relocate
abilities.description_zh: 将艾欧和与其连接的友军传送到地图上任何位置。持续时间结束后艾欧和相连的友军会被传送回原位。双击将传送回己方的泉水。
abilities.description_en: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes_zh: 敌人在施法延迟期间会在大地图和小地图上目标区域都收到视觉特效提示。
如果艾欧在施法延迟期间被控制，降临将会取消。
如果羁绊连接了友方英雄，该英雄将和你一起被传送。你可以随时断开连接，防止英雄和你一同传送。
只有英雄、类英雄单位和幻象可以降临。
notes_en: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.

abilities.name: wisp_equilibrium
abilities.description_zh: 艾欧获得伤害输出增强，血量越高，数值越高。同时，艾欧还获得生命回复和治疗增强，血量越低，数值越高。
abilities.description_en: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_wisp_4
talents_raw.desc_loc: While tethered to a friendly Hero, each time that Hero attacks, Io will attack the same target automatically.

When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 当维萨吉的夺命佣兽在战场上四处侦察时，他将自己包藏在护甲中，寻找着战机。一旦周围出现战斗，他从附近战士所受的伤害中收集灵魂能量，再将其释放，完成毁灭性一击。
heroes.hero_summary_en: As his deadly familiars scout the field, Visage cloaks himself in armor and seeks the next battle. Once near a skirmish, he gathers soul energy from damage inflicted upon nearby fighters before releasing it in a devastating attack.

abilities.name: visage_grave_chill
abilities.description_zh: 维萨吉吸取目标单位的移动和攻击速度，自身和附近的佣兽获得等量加成。
abilities.description_en: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
notes_zh: 两个状态效果是分开驱散的。
速度加成和目标的速度减少相互独立。
维萨吉周围%radius%内的佣兽也将获得黄泉颤抖的加成效果。
notes_en: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

abilities.name: visage_soul_assumption
abilities.description_zh: 每次附近英雄（不论敌我）受到的伤害超过%damage_limit%点，维萨吉就能集聚灵魂精华的能量。将精华释放后，会对目标单位造成基础伤害，每一点集聚的能量还将造成额外伤害。
abilities.description_en: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than %damage_limit% damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
notes_zh: 能量点数只计算来自玩家或肉山的伤害，必须大于%damage_min%点小于%damage_max%点。自残型伤害和灵魂超度造成的伤害不计算在内。
notes_en: Charges are only gained for damage greater than %damage_min% and less than %damage_max% that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.
facet_text_en: Soul Assumption kills give %bonus_soul_charge_gold% gold per soul charge, up to %bonus_gold_max_tooltip% gold. Reduced gold from creeps. Enemy heroes killed within %gold_grace_period_hero%s of being affected by Soul Assumption also give gold.
facet_text_zh: 灵魂超度击杀时每点灵魂能量会提供%bonus_soul_charge_gold%金，最高为%bonus_gold_max_tooltip%金。击杀非英雄时获得的金钱有所减少。灵魂超度作用于敌方英雄后%gold_grace_period_hero%秒内英雄阵亡也会获得金钱。

abilities.name: visage_gravekeepers_cloak
abilities.description_zh: 维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。维萨吉的佣兽在%radius%范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
abilities.description_en: Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within %radius% range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
notes_zh: 每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围%radius%范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within %radius% range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

shard_loc.en: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds.  Restores up to %shard_hp_restoration_pct%%% of your health.
shard_loc.zh: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复%shard_hp_restoration_pct%%%生命值。

abilities.name: visage_silent_as_the_grave
abilities.description_zh: 维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在%bonus_duration%秒内拥有额外攻击力。
abilities.description_en: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for %bonus_duration%s.

scepter_loc.en: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.
scepter_loc.zh: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为隐身状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。

abilities.name: visage_summon_familiars
abilities.description_zh:
召唤%familiar_count%只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人眩晕。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
abilities.description_en:
Conjures %familiar_count% blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
notes_zh: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。
notes_en: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.
facet_text_en: The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.

Familiars will automatically attack the target Visage tried to attack last, and will return if that target is out of Visage's attack range, or Visage issues the cancel current action or hold position commands.

The ability can be toggled to the Auto-Cast state to command the Familiars to return to Visage and not leave his side until the state has been disabled.
The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after %recall_duration%s, during which they cannot attack or act.
facet_text_zh: 技能可以设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），在%recall_duration%秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，期间他们无法攻击或行动。

佣兽会攻击维萨吉最后尝试攻击的目标，如果目标超出了维萨吉的攻击距离，或者维萨吉下达了取消当前动作或固守原地的命令后，佣兽会返回。

技能可以设为自动施法，命令佣兽回到维萨吉身旁，在技能关闭前不会离开。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_visage_3
talents_raw.desc_loc: A second Soul Assumption is launched towards a random enemy unit within the cast range, prioritizing Heroes.

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_armor_reduction_per_hit} Armor Corruption to Visage and Familiars
talents_raw.desc_loc: This effect can stack among multiple sources and lasts {s:bonus_armor_reduction_duration}s.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 扑向重重险境，再悄悄地溜回来，这就是斯拉克的看家本领。他可不会放过困住落单敌人的机会，每一次出手都能让他们的实力减退，如果见势不妙他立马就能消失得无影无踪。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Pouncing into danger then slipping back out is what Slark does best. He rushes at the chance to pin or corner a lone foe, steals their essence with each cut from his dagger, and is always ready to vanish should the tables turn.

abilities.name: slark_dark_pact
abilities.description_zh:
短暂延迟后，斯拉克牺牲部分生命力，清除大部分负面状态并对自己和周围敌方单位造成伤害。斯拉克自身只受到造成伤害的%self_damage_pct%%%。

驱散类型：强驱散
abilities.description_en:
After a short delay, Slark sacrifices some of his life blood, purging most negative debuffs and dealing damage to enemy units around him and to himself.  Slark only takes %self_damage_pct%%% of the damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes_zh: 经过%delay%秒施法延迟后，每隔%pulse_interval%秒释放1道伤害波造成伤害，总共%total_pulses%道。
每道伤害波还会移除斯拉克身上的负面效果。
不能使用此技能自杀。
如果斯拉克死亡，伤害波将停止释放。
notes_en: %delay% seconds after cast, a series of %total_pulses% pulses separated by %pulse_interval% seconds deal the damage.
Each pulse also removes debuffs from Slark.
You can't kill yourself with this skill.
The pulses stop if Slark dies.

abilities.name: slark_pounce
abilities.description_zh: 斯拉克向前跳跃，束缚第一个碰到的英雄并施加能量转移的叠加效果。该单位只能在斯拉克着地点附近的有限范围内移动。
abilities.description_en: Slark leaps forward, leashing and applying Essence Shift stacks to the first hero he connects. That unit can only move a limited distance away from Slark's landing position.
notes_zh: 施放后斯拉克以%pounce_speed%的速度向前跳跃，抓住敌方英雄或跳跃%pounce_distance%距离后停下。
不能束缚减益免疫单位。
斯拉克落地点附近的树木将会被摧毁。
notes_en: On cast, Slark leaps forward at a speed of %pounce_speed%, stopping when he latches onto an enemy hero or has traveled %pounce_distance% distance.
Debuff Immune units cannot be leashed.
Trees will be destroyed around Slark's landing location.

scepter_loc.en: Provides charges and increases range.
scepter_loc.zh: 变为充能型技能，并且提升距离。

facet_text_en: Pounce applies stacks of Essence Shift when striking enemy heroes.
facet_text_zh: 突袭在击中敌方英雄时会施加能量转移的叠加次数。

abilities.name: slark_saltwater_shiv
abilities.description_zh: 斯拉克用他的海浪短刀划开目标，窃取目标一部分的移动速度、生命恢复和生命回复。这个效果独立叠加。
abilities.description_en: Slark slices the target with his salty shiv, stealing a portion of the target's movement speed, Health Regen and Health Restoration.These effects stack independently.

abilities.name: slark_depth_shroud
abilities.description_zh: 在目标地点创造一团云雾。作用范围内所有友军为隐藏状态，受到暗影之舞的作用。
abilities.description_en: Creates a cloud at the target location. All allies inside the radius are hidden and affected by Shadow Dance.

abilities.name: slark_essence_shift
abilities.description_zh: 斯拉克的攻击会偷走敌方英雄的生命能量，每次吸取他们的%stat_loss%点全属性并转化成自身额外%agi_gain%点敏捷值。只要敌方英雄带着该效果在斯拉克300范围内阵亡，他将永久窃取%stat_loss%点敏捷。
abilities.description_en: Slark steals the life essence of enemy heroes with his attacks, draining %stat_loss% of each of their attributes and converting them to bonus %agi_gain% Agility. If Slark kills an affected enemy hero, he permanently steals %stat_loss% Agility.
notes_zh: 属性值最少为1点。
斯拉克或受到作用的单位死亡后，阵亡单位因能量转移变化的属性值将回归正常。但是两方的属性值相互独立，并无关联。
斯拉克无需完成击杀就能永久窃取敏捷，只要敌方英雄身上拥有能量转移状态时在斯拉克的窃取范围内阵亡即可。
破坏会使技能无法获得临时的叠加效果。依然可以获得永久的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Attributes cannot be dropped below 1.
Essence Shifted stats are returned to normal on death. The stat return for Slark and for the affected hero are separate.
To permanently steal Agility, Slark doesn't need to land the killing blow, as long as the enemy hero is killed within Slark's Steal Radius while having the Essence Shift debuff.
Break disables the gaining of temporary stacks. Does not disable the gaining of permanent stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses of existing stacks.

abilities.name: slark_shadow_dance
abilities.description_zh: 当斯拉克不处于敌方视野内时，他会被动获得移动速度加成和生命恢复。如果受到来自中立单位的伤害，%neutral_disable%秒内会失去被动移速和生命恢复加成。主动开启后，斯拉克将自己藏进暗影之云，变成隐身状态，不会被反隐手段发现。攻击、施法、使用物品都不会使斯拉克显形，但是敌人可以看见暗影之云。
abilities.description_en: When not visible to the enemy team, Slark passively gains bonus movement speed and health regeneration.  If Slark is damaged by a neutral unit, the passive movement and health regeneration bonuses are lost for %neutral_disable% seconds.When activated, Slark hides himself in a cloud of shadows, becoming immune to detection. Attacking, casting spells, and using items will not reveal Slark, but enemies can see the cloud itself.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_slark_5
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_agi_gain} Agility gain/stolen per Essence Shift Stack
