heroes.hero_summary_zh: 原初力量的细小碎片，与遗迹们系出同源，天穹守望者泽特誓将见证天辉和夜魇大战的终结。操控乱流能量突袭落单的敌人，或者扭曲空间，制造力场保护盟友。召唤闪光幽魂来回萦绕，摧残踏足的敌人，然后创造泽特的复制体，控制所有的物品和技能，将众敌全数碾压。
heroes.hero_summary_en: A splintered fragment of the same primordial power as the Ancients themselves, Zet the Arc Warden has pledged to see the clash between Radiant and Dire finally end. Assault lone enemies with fluxing energy, or distort space to generate a protective field around allies. Summon a Spark Wraith to patrol an area for enemies to infuse with harmful magic, then create a double of Zet, items and all, to overwhelm your foes.

abilities.name: arc_warden_flux
abilities.description_zh: 将不稳定的涡流能量灌注到落单敌人体内，造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度。如目标周围有其他敌方单位 ，则不会造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.

scepter_loc.en: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.
scepter_loc.zh: 目标落单时乱流具有沉默效果，造成更高伤害，而且持续时间更长。

abilities.name: arc_warden_magnetic_field
abilities.description_zh: 天穹守望者制造一个充满磁能的圆形扭曲力场。磁场提供攻击速度加成，并且其中的友方单位可以闪避来自磁场外的攻击。磁场可以牵引神符，并且自动激活其中的神符。
abilities.description_en: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
facet_text_en: Magnetic Field pulls runes. Runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.
facet_text_zh: 磁场会牵引神符。磁场内的神符会自动激活。

abilities.name: arc_warden_spark_wraith
abilities.description_zh: 召唤一个缓慢实体化的闪光怨灵萦绕在目标区域，直到有敌人进入范围。一旦有敌方单位进入范围，怨灵将贴近敌人自我熔化，造成魔法伤害并使目标减速。
abilities.description_en: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
notes_zh: 闪光幽魂无法被躲避。
notes_en: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.

abilities.name: arc_warden_runic_infusion
abilities.description_zh: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。
abilities.description_en: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
facet_text_en: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.
facet_text_zh: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+%all_attribute_bonus_per_stack% 全属性。

abilities.name: arc_warden_tempest_double
abilities.description_zh: 天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。
abilities.description_en: Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
notes_zh: 复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。
notes_en: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.

shard_loc.en: The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.Does not trigger Runic Infusion.
shard_loc.zh: 风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。不会触发神符灌注。

facet_text_en:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Power Runes for %rune_duration%s when created.

Level 1 - Arcane Rune.

Level 2 - Arcane and Invisibility Runes.

Level 3 - Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes.
facet_text_zh:
风暴双雄产生时带有强化神符的加成效果，持续%rune_duration%秒。

1级 - 奥术神符。

2级 - 奥术和隐身神符。

3级 - 奥术、隐身和极速神符。

talents_raw.desc_loc: Applies retroactively

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 召唤成波深渊之焰，焚祭在恶意掌控中无力还手的敌人。战斗的屠戮是场盛宴，敌人的消亡将会带来力量，他们的攻势在你面前不值一提。在现实中撕出一道裂隙，将自己和友军全屏传送，胆敢蔑视孽主意志的人，维洛格罗斯将奉上血腥的报应。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Conjure waves of abyssal flame to immolate enemies held paralyzed in your spiteful grip. Feast upon the carnage of battle, gaining strength as foes perish around you, their attacks diminished by your very presence. Tear a rift in reality to teleport yourself and your teammates across the map, delivering bloody retribution to any who would defy the will of Vrogros the Underlord.

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_firestorm
abilities.description_zh: 召唤数波火焰风暴攻击目标区域内的所有单位，并额外持续造成烧灼伤害。
abilities.description_en: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.

shard_loc.en: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.
shard_loc.zh: 火焰风暴可以对友军施放。施放后火焰风暴会跟随该英雄。火焰风暴的波数增加，伤害触发间隔/持续时间更短。

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice
abilities.description_zh: 在目标区域制造致命的深渊；踏入深渊的敌方单位将受到伤害并且被缠绕。每个敌方单位每隔%pit_interval%秒才会再次受到作用。
abilities.description_en: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
abilities.description_zh: 周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
abilities.description_en: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。
notes_en: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.
facet_text_en: Underlord's attacks cleave while he has bonus damage from Atrophy Aura.
facet_text_zh: 孽主在拥有衰退光环的攻击力加成时攻击具有分裂效果。

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_raid_boss
abilities.description_zh: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得承受伤害降低和移动速度加成。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得%dark_portal_multiplier%倍加成。
abilities.description_en: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive %dark_portal_multiplier%x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

abilities.name: abyssal_underlord_dark_portal
abilities.description_zh: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法%warp_channel_duration%秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过%minimum_distance%。
abilities.description_en: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
notes_zh: 双击会在己方基地的泉水前打开另一个传送门。
notes_en: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain

scepter_loc.en: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.
scepter_loc.zh: 在传送门两端各召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。

facet_text_en: Underlord summons uncontrollable demonic Warriors and Archers after travelling through the Fiend's Gate that attack nearby enemies. These units deal %underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%% damage to buildings.
facet_text_zh: 孽主穿过恶魔之扉后会召唤不可控的恶魔战士和射手，攻击附近敌人。这些单位对建筑造成%underling_building_damage_reduction_tooltip%%%伤害。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_underlord_9
talents_raw.name_loc: {s:bonus_dps} DPS in {s:bonus_radius} Radius Around Fiend's Gate

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 为了随时痛快地打上一架，齐天大圣行走于树顶之上。只为从浓密的树叶中跃出，给敌人一场惊喜。唤来一帮猴子猴孙碾压对手，这个敏捷的魔术师陶醉在战场的混乱中，随时都会用他的金箍棒击碎所有逃跑的美梦。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Always in search of a good fight, Monkey King travels atop the trees aiming to spring from leafy cover and surprise his enemies. Calling upon an army of monkey soldiers to overwhelm opponents, this agile trickster revels in the chaos of battle, ready to slam his legendary staff down on any hopes of escape.

abilities.name: monkey_king_boundless_strike
abilities.description_zh: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，眩晕一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。
abilities.description_en: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.

shard_loc.en: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.
shard_loc.zh: 棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的%spring_channel_pct%%%。棒击大地设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。

abilities.name: monkey_king_tree_dance
abilities.description_zh: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
abilities.description_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
notes_zh: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。
notes_en: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.
facet_text_en: Increases the max level of Tree Dance. Level %max_level% Tree Dance reduces the cooldown to zero.
facet_text_zh: 提升丛林之舞的最高等级。%max_level%级丛林之舞会把冷却时间降低至0。

abilities.name: monkey_king_jingu_mastery
abilities.description_zh: 齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下%charges%次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。
abilities.description_en: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
notes_zh: 棒击大地击中敌人时也会计入攻击次数。
再次攻击敌人将刷新如意棒法的计数持续时间。
敌人身上的计数效果无法被驱散。
自身的如意棒法效果可以被驱散。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
notes_en: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: monkey_king_mischief
abilities.description_zh: 齐天大圣以周遭事物为启发进行伪装，改变自己的外形，从而欺骗对手。受到伤害，发动攻击或使用任意物品都会失去伪装效果。变化后%invul_duration%秒内免疫伤害。
abilities.description_en: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for %invul_duration% seconds upon transforming.

abilities.name: monkey_king_wukongs_command
abilities.description_zh: 齐天大圣变出圆形的猴子猴孙阵列，猴子猴孙从他的位置散开。若齐天大圣离开范围，猴子猴孙将会消失。猴子猴孙继承齐天大圣的攻击力，攻击频率为固定的%attack_speed%秒，并且只会以敌方英雄为目标。在技能持续时间内齐天大圣获得护甲加成。齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，短时间内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。
abilities.description_en: Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
notes_zh: 猴子猴孙不会获得如意棒法的加成效果。
猴子猴孙不会继承碎颅锤和深渊之刃的效果。
notes_en: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.

scepter_loc.en: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.
scepter_loc.zh: 每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。

facet_text_en: Monkey King's soldiers last longer and do not disperse unless he spends more than %leadership_time_buffer% seconds outside the area.
Grants the Changing of the Guard ability during Wukong's Command.
facet_text_zh: 齐天大圣的猴子猴孙持续时间更长，而且离开圆阵后不会马上消散，除非他在圆阵外停留的时间超过%leadership_time_buffer%秒。
在猴子猴孙期间获得技能“出神入化”。

abilities.name: monkey_king_transfiguration
abilities.description_zh: 齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，%transfiguration_duration%秒内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。变身后齐天大圣为无敌，但是无法攻击或施放技能。
abilities.description_en: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a %transfiguration_duration%s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 渴望随时冲入危险，石鳞剑士擅长干扰敌人的行动，将自己置身于混乱之中。巧妙地运剑刺入护甲的缝隙之中，再利用他厚实的鳞片摆脱攻击，这位优雅的剑客时刻准备着滚进战场。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Eager to dash into danger at a moment's notice, the Pangolier thrives on disrupting enemy movements and placing himself in the midst of chaos. Artfully guiding his blade between cracks in armor and shrugging off attacks with his protective scales, this graceful swordsman is always ready to roll into battle.

abilities.name: pangolier_swashbuckle
abilities.description_zh:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
abilities.description_en:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
notes_zh: 在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。
notes_en: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

abilities.name: pangolier_shield_crash
abilities.description_zh:
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的全伤害护盾。

地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。
abilities.description_en:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成%scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%%伤害。

facet_text_en: Pangolier can cast Shield Crash a second time mid-flight, dealing more damage and gaining more barrier. Longer flight time results in more damage and barrier increases.
facet_text_zh: 石鳞剑士可以在半空中再次施放甲盾冲击，造成更高的伤害，并获得更高数值的护盾。在空中的时间越久，伤害和护盾的数值越高。

abilities.name: pangolier_lucky_shot
abilities.description_zh: 石鳞剑士孤注一掷，让命运决定敌人的下场。石鳞剑士的攻击或技能拥有一定几率大幅降低攻击速度，同时削弱护甲。
abilities.description_en: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.

abilities.name: pangolier_rollup
abilities.description_zh: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

abilities.name: pangolier_gyroshell
abilities.description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。
notes_en: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.
facet_text_en: Rolling Thunder movement and turn speed increased, but duration is decreased.
facet_text_zh: 地雷滚滚的移动和转身速度提升，但是持续时间减少。

abilities.name: pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold
abilities.description_zh: 附近敌人攻击石鳞剑士时，他们触发物品和技能的随机类攻击特效的几率有所降低。
abilities.description_en: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes_zh: 对英雄技能和物品有效。
效果是特效发生的几率相对降低。
notes_en: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 在阴影中微微振翅，也许这就是敌人眼中的邪影芳灵，她躲避追击，操控狡猾的仙灵法术控制敌人的行动。召唤远比书上的魔法更为古老的力量，她将敌人束缚在原地，再将仙灵之境的所有怒火和恐怖全数释放。
heroes.hero_summary_en: A slight flutter from the shadows may be all an enemy sees of Dark Willow, as she eludes pursuit and controls her foe's movements with cunning fae tricks. Calling upon powers far more ancient than any scholarly magic, she binds enemies in place before unleashing the full wrath and terror of the fae realm upon them.

abilities.name: dark_willow_bramble_maze
abilities.description_zh: %initial_creation_delay%秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出%placement_range%范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有%placement_count%棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被缠绕，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续%placement_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。
notes_en: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

abilities.name: dark_willow_shadow_realm
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。
notes_en: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.

scepter_loc.en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
scepter_loc.zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

facet_text_en: While in Shadow Realm, Dark Willow emits a %aura_radius% radius aura that increases damage that she deals to enemies in its area of effect by up to %aura_damage_pct%%%. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm.
facet_text_zh: 处于暗影之境时，邪影芳灵会散发出一个%aura_radius%范围的光环，使她对范围内的敌人造成的伤害增加，最高为%aura_damage_pct%%%。根据她在暗影之境内停留的时间，造成的伤害会随之增加。

abilities.name: dark_willow_cursed_crown
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.

shard_loc.en: Cursed Crown creates %shard_bramble_amount% brambles in a %shard_spawn_radius% radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在%shard_spawn_radius%范围内产生%shard_bramble_amount%朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。

facet_text_en: While ticking, Cursed Crown accumulates %accumulated_damage_pct%%% of all damage dealt by Dark Willow and %accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%% of attack damage dealt by allied heroes. When the counter ends, the accumulated damage is dealt again as magical damage to the whole area. This triggers even upon dispel with Aghanim's Shard.
facet_text_zh: 倒计时期间诅咒王冠会累计邪影芳灵对目标造成所有伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct%%%，还有友方英雄对其造成攻击伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%%。倒计时结束时，累计的伤害会作为魔法伤害施加给整个区域。拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后，可以在技能被驱散时触发。

abilities.name: dark_willow_bedlam
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

abilities.name: dark_willow_pixie_dust
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵获得额外%hp_regen_amp%%%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至%hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%%。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

abilities.name: dark_willow_terrorize
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes_zh: 恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。
notes_en: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.

Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 擅长从远处操控战斗，天涯墨客洞察所有动向，评定所有路线，决定何时从如墨的黑暗中现身控制对手，挥毫将他们一同束缚。他喜爱释放幻影的奴隶侵扰对手，而自己就慎重考虑，怎样给众多敌人写下最后一笔。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Skilled at manipulating battle from the outskirts, Grimstroke studies every movement and assesses each line, deciding when to emerge from inky darkness to disable his victims and bind them together with a swipe of his brush. He delights in unleashing phantom thralls to vex opponents, as he carefully considers how to dispatch multiple enemies with one fateful stroke.

abilities.name: grimstroke_dark_artistry
abilities.description_zh: 天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
abilities.description_en: Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits. Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.
facet_text_en: Stroke of Fate additionally launches a reflected curved stroke from the right hand. Enemies can only be hit by one Stroke, but the bonus damage is cumulative.
facet_text_zh: 绝笔额外从另一只手发出对称的墨迹曲线。每个敌人只能受到一道墨迹的伤害，但是同时计入两道墨迹的额外伤害。

abilities.name: grimstroke_ink_creature
abilities.description_zh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
abilities.description_en:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
notes_zh: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。
notes_en: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

abilities.name: grimstroke_spirit_walk
abilities.description_zh: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。%buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.

shard_loc.en: Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
shard_loc.zh: 墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加%shard_bonus_damage_pct%%%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的%shard_heal_pct%%%。驱散类型：弱驱散

facet_text_en: Ink Swell can be manually detonated early.
facet_text_zh: 墨涌可以手动提前引爆。

abilities.name: grimstroke_dark_portrait
abilities.description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。
abilities.description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.

abilities.name: grimstroke_soul_chain
abilities.description_zh: 将一名敌方英雄与束缚作用范围内最接近的队友相连，阻止他们远离彼此。任何指向性技能击中任一英雄时，这两名敌方英雄都会受到作用。若连接在效果截止前断裂，初始目标将再次与其距离内最接近的队友相连。
abilities.description_en: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
notes_zh: 如果与另一个单位一起被束缚，作用下单位均被束缚，而且无法使用闪烁类技能。
被束缚的单位都将提供视野。
notes_en: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.

abilities.name: grimstroke_ink_trail
abilities.description_zh: 天涯墨客的攻击和技能会使受作用的敌方英雄在身后留下一道墨痕，对天涯墨客造成的伤害减少，持续%debuff_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for %debuff_duration%s.
notes_zh: 获得作用下英雄的视野。
天涯墨客的幻象（包括暗绘）也拥有墨痕。
notes_en: Provides vision over affected heroes.
Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.

talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_AbilityCastRange}% Stroke of Fate Speed and Travel Range

Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.

Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 战士的神明玛尔斯在冲突的中心傲然挺立，在致命的坚盾掩护之下他传奇的战矛刺穿敌人。在余烬军团的忠实成员环绕的竞技场中，他陶醉于对手的决战之中，而他们将确保无人可以临阵脱逃，而不论他面临何种危机，战神都能化险为夷，因为他知道众人都站在他这边。
heroes.hero_summary_en: The warrior deity Mars thrives in the heart of strife, guarded by the bulk of a deadly shield as he skewers enemies with his legendary spear. He revels in facing opponents in an arena ringed with loyal spearmen—who guarantee that no one escapes and that whatever odds he's facing, the god of war can dictate the terms of battle knowing the crowd is forever on his side.

abilities.name: mars_spear
abilities.description_zh: 玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
notes_zh: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。
notes_en: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.

shard_loc.en: Spear of Mars impales up to %max_impale_targets% heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.
shard_loc.zh: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多%max_impale_targets%名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

abilities.name: mars_gods_rebuke
abilities.description_zh: 玛尔斯举起他的战盾粉碎前方的敌人，将他们击退并且基于自身攻击力造成致命一击伤害。攻击英雄时攻击伤害提升。具有克敌机先效果。
abilities.description_en: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
notes_zh: 神之谴戒的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。
notes_en: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

abilities.name: mars_bulwark
abilities.description_zh: 每当玛尔斯受到来自正面或侧面的攻击时，他就挥舞他那面巨大的战盾来格挡一定百分比的伤害。可以开启，开启后获得相位移动状态，但无法攻击，自身锁定为面朝的方向，并且移动速度降低，但飞向队友的攻击弹道中%redirect_chance%%%将改变方向朝他飞去。
abilities.description_en: Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides. Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs %redirect_chance%%% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
notes_zh: 改向只会在弹道目标位于玛尔斯身后锥形区域内或他身边100范围内才会生效。
破坏会使正面和侧面减伤效果失效。
notes_en: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.

scepter_loc.en: Creates %soldier_count% invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.
scepter_loc.zh: 开启护身甲盾后在玛尔斯的两侧共产生%soldier_count%名无敌的士兵。士兵会随着玛尔斯前进，继承全额攻击力和攻击特效并拥有攻击力加成，附带击退和减速效果。敌人在同一时间只会被1名士兵攻击。

abilities.name: mars_dauntless
abilities.description_zh: %radius%范围内敌方英雄数量更多时，玛尔斯就会获得生命恢复，敌人数量越多，生命恢复也越高。
abilities.description_en: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in %radius% radius.

abilities.name: mars_arena_of_blood
abilities.description_zh: 经过短暂的列队时间，玛尔斯召唤出环绕着战士的竞技场，战士们将阻挡敌人的攻击和动向。竞技场内的敌方英雄靠近边缘时将被战矛攻击，受到伤害并被击退。
abilities.description_en: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.

scepter_loc.en: Lowers cooldown by %bonus_AbilityCooldown%s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%  of their max health and mana and get a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%  attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. This effect stacks.
scepter_loc.zh: 冷却时间降低%bonus_AbilityCooldown%秒，持续时间提升。如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡，玛尔斯和竞技场内所有友军都会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。这个效果可以叠加。

facet_text_en: If Mars is in the Arena when an enemy dies inside of it, he restores %arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%% of his max health and mana and gets a %arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%% attack damage buff for %arena_kill_buff_duration%s. Allies inside the Arena receive %allied_reduction_pct%%% of the bonuses.
Arena of Blood obscures vision and enemies within the arena do not share vision with their allies.
facet_text_zh: 如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡时玛尔斯也在竞技场内，他会回复%arena_kill_buff_heal_pct%%%最大生命和魔法，并且获得一个%arena_kill_buff_damage_pct%%%攻击力加成效果，持续%arena_kill_buff_duration%秒。竞技场内的友军获得%allied_reduction_pct%%%加成效果。
热血竞技场会遮蔽视野，竞技场内的敌人不会与他们的友军共享视野。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_mars_arena_of_blood_hp_regen
talents_raw.name_loc: Arena Of Blood Grants Team +{s:bonus_health_regen} HP Regen

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 掌握着足以粉碎凡人心智的秘密，虚无之灵自他的隐之圣堂现身，同时守卫着战场上多片区域。他能够随时出入凡间，让对手疲于奔命，从任何希望的地点出手，必要之时召唤太虚的力量保护自己。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Privy to secrets that would shatter a mortal mind, the Void Spirit emerges from his Hidden Temple to stand guard over multiple areas of the battlefield at once. Able to step into and out of the mortal plane at will, he easily outmaneuvers opponents to strike from wherever he desires, calling upon the powers of the aether to shield him in times of need.

abilities.name: void_spirit_aether_remnant
abilities.description_zh: 虚无之灵向目标地点派出一个残像。残像观察着一片区域，面朝矢量的方向。当有目标进入其视线，残像会拉扯，并造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.

shard_loc.en: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing %creep_damage_pct%%% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.
shard_loc.zh: 额外产生一道观察路径，会围绕残阴旋转。残阴现在会提供真实视域，不再对非英雄单位触发，而是每秒在两道路径上造成%creep_damage_pct%%%伤害。不会使守卫显形。

abilities.name: void_spirit_dissimilate
abilities.description_zh: 虚无之灵暂时遁入太虚，创造数个灵扉。穿过灵扉他能重组自身。穿出灵扉后，他对区域内所有敌人造成伤害。
abilities.description_en: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.
facet_text_en: Upon exiting Dissimilate, Aether Remnants are created at the %aether_remnant_count% portals furthest from Void Spirit. No effect if reassembling from the center portal. Remnants face towards the center portal and have reduced pull duration and damage.
facet_text_zh: 退出异化时，距离虚无之灵最远的%aether_remnant_count%个灵扉处会产生残阴。如果在中央的灵扉重组则没有效果。残阴会面朝中央的灵扉，牵引时间和伤害降低。

abilities.name: void_spirit_resonant_pulse
abilities.description_zh: 虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性护盾之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，护盾的伤害吸收量都会提升。
abilities.description_en: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.

scepter_loc.en: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain %max_charges% charges.
scepter_loc.zh: 共鸣脉冲可以沉默敌人，并获得%max_charges%点能量点数。

facet_text_en: Resonant Pulse creates a larger all damage barrier instead of a physical barrier.
facet_text_zh: 共鸣脉冲会产生更强的全伤害护盾，而不是物理伤害护盾。

abilities.name: void_spirit_intrinsic_edge
abilities.description_zh: 虚无之灵从每点属性获得的攻击力提升%damage_stat_bonus_pct%%%，并且从力量中获得的生命恢复、敏捷中获得的攻击速度和智力中获得的魔法恢复提升%secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%%。
abilities.description_en: Void Spirit gains %damage_stat_bonus_pct%%% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and %secondary_stat_bonus_pct%%% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

abilities.name: void_spirit_astral_step
abilities.description_zh: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成%pop_damage_delay%秒减速，然后引爆。
abilities.description_en: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for %pop_damage_delay% seconds and then detonates.
notes_zh: 太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。
notes_en: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_void_spirit_dissimilate_outerring
talents_raw.desc_loc: Add a partial outer ring to Dissimilate

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_void_spirit_8
talents_raw.desc_loc: Attacks made with Astral Step deal a critical strike.

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 乐于用她信赖的猎枪轰掉你的腿，也同样乐于用可口又危险的饼干封上你的嘴，电炎绝手碧翠丝非常高兴地与她的龙蜥小莫迪一同驾临战场，时刻准备着用她自制的火炮摧残他们的敌人，或者用小莫迪的密集火痰毁灭他们。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Just as happy to blow your legs off with her trusty scattergun as to fill your belly up with a deliciously-dangerous cookie, Beatrix Snapfire delights in riding into battle with her dragon toad Mortimer, always ready to mow down their enemies with her homemade heavy artillery or finish them off with a steady barrage of Mortimer's firespit globs.

abilities.name: snapfire_scatterblast
abilities.description_zh: 电炎绝手开枪产生大范围的爆炸，对锥形区域内的敌人造成伤害和减速。平射距离内的伤害提升%point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%%，移动速度减缓、攻击速度降低和减速持续时间额外提升%point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%%。
abilities.description_en: Snapfire unloads with a wide blast that damages and slows enemies in a cone. Damage is increased by %point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.
facet_text_en: Scatterblast is narrower and longer. Bonus damage and slow when enemies are not in point blank range.
facet_text_zh: 电光石火更窄更长。对平射距离外的敌人造成额外伤害和减速。

abilities.name: snapfire_firesnap_cookie
abilities.description_zh: 电炎绝手将一块烈性饼干喂给小莫迪或一名队友，使他们短距离跳跃。跳跃的单位将在落地时对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
abilities.description_en: Snapfire feeds a potent cookie to Mortimer or an ally, causing them to hop a short distance. The hopping unit stuns and damages enemies in the landing zone.
notes_zh: 饼干的弹道速度为%projectile_speed%。
notes_en: The cookie projectile has a speed of %projectile_speed%.

shard_loc.en: Firesnap cookies become even more potent, healing the target and launching a Mortimer Kiss that does %shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%% impact damage to the landing destination.
shard_loc.zh: 龙炎饼干变得更具威力，治疗目标，并且朝着陆地点发射一个%shard_damage_multiplier_tooltip%%%冲击伤害的蜥蜴绝吻。

abilities.name: snapfire_lil_shredder
abilities.description_zh: 电炎绝手开动蜥蜴坐骑上的加农炮，快速发动%buffed_attacks%次固定伤害加上自身攻击伤害一定百分比的攻击。每次攻击都将削弱敌人的护甲。在持续时间内提供攻击距离加成。
abilities.description_en: Snapfire heats up her mounted turret to rapidly fire %buffed_attacks% attacks dealing fixed damage plus a percentage of her attack damage. Each attack reduces the enemy's armor. Provides bonus attack range for the duration.
notes_zh: 持续时间内基础攻击间隔变为%base_attack_time%。
霹雳铁手的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。
notes_en: Sets base attack time to %base_attack_time%s for the duration.
Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on Lil' Shredder attacks.

abilities.name: snapfire_gobble_up
abilities.description_zh: 小莫迪吞下一个小兵或一名友方英雄，再朝敌人吐出。单位停留在他肚子里最多可达%max_time_in_belly%秒。
abilities.description_en: Mortimer gobbles up a creep or an allied hero, which he can then spit towards enemies. The unit stays in his belly up to %max_time_in_belly% seconds.
notes_zh: 电炎绝手在小兵被吐出并阵亡后获得相应的金钱。
notes_en: Snapfire earns the creep's bounty after it has been spat out and died.

abilities.name: snapfire_spit_creep
abilities.description_zh: 小莫迪吐出他肚子里的单位，对大片区域造成冲击伤害和眩晕。留下的火痰根据蜥蜴绝吻的当前等级还将持续造成减速和伤害。喷吐没有最小发射距离。
abilities.description_en: Mortimer spits out the unit that's in his mouth, causing impact damage and stun in a large area. The glob leaves a pool of firespit based on the current level of Mortimer Kisses, that slows and applies damage over time. Spit Out has a no minimum launch range.

abilities.name: snapfire_mortimer_kisses
abilities.description_zh: 电炎绝手的伙伴在%duration_tooltip%秒内喷吐出密集的火团。火团造成冲击伤害，在地面上产生炽烈的炎洼，可以使敌人减速并造成持续伤害。电炎绝手在持续时间内转身速率降低，并且具有最小喷吐距离，为%min_range%。点击右键可以选择火团的目标区域。
abilities.description_en: Snapfire's friend launches a barrage of firespit globs over %duration_tooltip% seconds. Globs cause impact damage and create pools of firespit, which slow and apply damage over time. Snapfire has a reduced turn rate for the duration and a minimum launch range of %min_range%. Each glob can be targeted with a right click.
notes_zh: 可以通过停止、停在原位或使用其他技能来终止。
最短飞行时间为%min_lob_travel_time%秒，最长飞行时间为%max_lob_travel_time%秒。
notes_en: Can be cancelled by pressing Stop, Hold Position, or using another ability.
Has a minimum travel time of %min_lob_travel_time% and maximum travel time of %max_lob_travel_time%.

abilities.name: snapfire_boomstick
abilities.description_zh: 电炎绝手对附近的敌人造成更多伤害。
abilities.description_en: Snapfire deals more damage to nearby enemies.

Damage is increased by %point_blank_dmg_bonus_pct%%% and Movement Slow, Attack Slow and Slow Duration are increased by %point_blank_debuff_duration_pct%%% for enemies caught at point-blank range.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 麻烦来临时森海飞霞总是身在左近，她的生活就是与自己视为家乡的诡异林渊中充斥的威胁纠缠不清。 携带着巨大的弩机，同时仍能在密林中轻松奔走，森海飞霞在战斗中来去自如。只要有一瞬间没见到她，她就会从你背后现身——而你目瞪口呆的尸体已经挂在她的一张网里。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Always at hand when trouble's afoot, Hoodwink lives to tangle with the threats that fill the haunted forest she adopted as her home. Toting a massive crossbow while still able to scurry through the woodland with the greatest of ease, Hoodwink is nearly impossible to keep tabs on in battle. Lose track and she'll pop out behind you -- your stunned carcass already dangling in one of her nets.

abilities.name: hoodwink_acorn_shot
abilities.description_zh:
森海飞霞向目标单位发射一颗橡栗，可以弹射至附近敌人，减缓他们的移动速度，并造成攻击伤害的一定百分比和额外伤害。
可以对地面施放，在目标地点种出一棵树，而橡栗会弹射至附近目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后会强制沿用该行为。
abilities.description_en:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
notes_zh: 同一个目标可以被击中超过一次。
弹射会搜寻525范围内战争迷雾中的单位，但无视隐身单位。
种下的树持续20秒。
notes_en: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.
facet_text_en: If there are no bounce targets within range of Acorn Shot, it can bounce off a nearby tree and set the remaining number of bounces to %bounces_after_tree_bounce%.
facet_text_zh: 如果附近没有可弹射的目标，爆栗出击会弹射至附近的树木，剩余弹射次数将设为%bounces_after_tree_bounce%次。

abilities.name: hoodwink_bushwhack
abilities.description_zh: 扔出一张网，对区域内靠近树木的敌人造成眩晕。敌人会持续受到伤害并被拖拽到目标区域内最近的树上，并且眩晕期间视野降低至0。
abilities.description_en: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
notes_zh: 若树木被摧毁，被影响的单位将解除眩晕。
野地奇袭不会击中隐身单位。
notes_en: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.

abilities.name: hoodwink_scurry
abilities.description_zh: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为%evasion_multiplier%倍。
abilities.description_en: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by %evasion_multiplier%.
facet_text_en: Scurry also provides bonus attack and cast range.
facet_text_zh: 密林奔走还会提供攻击和施法距离加成。

abilities.name: hoodwink_decoy
abilities.description_zh: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。
abilities.description_en: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

abilities.name: hoodwink_hunters_boomerang
abilities.description_zh: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。
abilities.description_en: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

abilities.name: hoodwink_sharpshooter
abilities.description_zh:
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加破坏和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，%max_charge_time%秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在%misfire_time%秒后自动发射。
由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退%recoil_distance%距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。
abilities.description_en:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after %max_charge_time% seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after %misfire_time% seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of %recoil_distance% from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.

scepter_loc.en: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.
scepter_loc.zh: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。

facet_text_en: Sharpshooter has a %quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%% reduced cooldown. Damage, debuff duration, and wind-up times are reduced by %quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%. Turn rate is increased by %turn_rate_tooltip%%%.
facet_text_zh: 一箭穿心的冷却时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_pct_cooldown_reduction%%%。伤害、负面状态持续时间和装载时间减少%quick_draw_tooltip_efficacy_pct%%%。转身速率提升%turn_rate_tooltip%%%。

abilities.name: hoodwink_mistwoods_wayfarer
abilities.description_zh: 森海飞霞有几率使敌人的攻击转向至附近的树木。
abilities.description_en: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
notes_zh: 受到转向攻击的树木会被摧毁。
notes_en: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_hoodwink_sharpshooter_vision
talents_raw.desc_loc: Also Grants True Sight. Does Not Reveal Wards.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 破晓辰星在战场的中央散发着万丈光芒，她乐于挥舞来自上界的战锤粉碎敌军，治疗附近的盟友。她也沉醉于将手中巨大的武器抛向敌阵，再与她的战锤在一道炽烈的尾迹中会合，她时刻等待着运用真正的宇宙之力飞去援助她的战友——不论她的敌人身在战场何处都将迎来溃败。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Dawnbreaker shines in the heart of battle, happily crushing enemies with her celestial hammer and healing nearby allies. She revels in hurling her hammer through multiple foes and then converging with it in a blazing wake, always waiting to tap her true cosmic power to fly to the aid of her teammates — eager to rout her enemies on the battlefield no matter where they are.

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_fire_wreath
abilities.description_zh: 破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
abilities.description_en: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
notes_zh: 破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以%movement_speed%的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要%self_stun_duration%秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人%swipe_slow%%%移动速度，持续%sweep_stun_duration%秒。
notes_en: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of %movement_speed% for the duration of the ability and takes a brief %self_stun_duration%s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by %swipe_slow%%% for %sweep_stun_duration%s.

shard_loc.en: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by %shard_movement_penalty%%% down to a minimum of %movement_speed%.
shard_loc.zh: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得减益免疫，%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速%shard_movement_penalty%%%，移速最低为%movement_speed%。

facet_text_en: Dawnbreaker and her allies in a %movespeed_bonus_radius% radius gain attack speed for %movespeed_bonus_duration% seconds at the end of Starbreaker for each swipe that hit enemy heroes.
facet_text_zh: 在星破天惊结束后每次破晓辰星挥击和锤击敌方英雄都会使%movespeed_bonus_radius%范围内她和所有友军获得攻击速度加成，持续%movespeed_bonus_duration%秒。

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer
abilities.description_zh: 破晓辰星向一个目标扔出她的武器，对沿途的敌人造成伤害。战锤会在目的地停留%pause_duration%秒，再飞回她的手中，期间留下一道炽烈之径，减缓敌人的移动速度。破晓辰星可以随时召回战锤，将自身朝战锤牵引，使二者在中点相遇。
abilities.description_en: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for %pause_duration% seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
notes_zh: 战锤在飞出和飞回时都会对敌人造成伤害。
破晓辰星的会合移动距离不会超过技能的施法距离。
星破天惊无法在战锤脱手时施放。
notes_en: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.
facet_text_en: When Celestial Hammer lands on the ground, it creates the healing and damaging effects of Solar Guardian, reduced by %hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%% in a %hammer_solar_guardian_radius% AoE around it. Increases the duration that the hammer can remain stationary to %pause_duration%s.
Allied heroes walking on Celestial Hammer's fire trail gain bonus movement speed.
facet_text_zh: 上界重锤停在地面时，会产生天光现世的治疗和伤害效果，数值减少%hammer_solar_guardian_effectiveness_pct%%%，作用于重锤附近%hammer_solar_guardian_radius%范围。重锤的停留时间提升至%pause_duration%秒。
友方英雄在上界重锤的炽烈之径上行走会获得移动速度加成。

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_luminosity
abilities.description_zh: 破晓辰星在数次攻击后提升了力量，她的下一次攻击会造成致命一击，并治疗她附近%heal_radius%范围内所有友方英雄，治疗量为攻击伤害的一定百分比。攻击小兵和野怪产生的治疗量有所减少。对友军的治疗量为%allied_healing_pct%%%。
abilities.description_en: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within %heal_radius% units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for %allied_healing_pct%%% of the amount.
notes_zh: 熠熠生辉的治疗效果可以通过生命回复增强效果获得提升。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
notes_en: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

scepter_loc.en: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
scepter_loc.zh: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.

facet_text_en: Whenever Dawnbreaker hits a target with a powered up Luminosity, she decreases the cooldowns of all of her abilities.
facet_text_zh: 只要破晓辰星击中目标时触发了熠熠生辉的强化攻击，她所有技能的冷却时间都会减少。

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_break_of_dawn
abilities.description_zh: 只要太阳出来，破晓辰星就会获得基础攻击力加成和额外视野，加成效果会在整个白天内逐渐降低。如果是破晓辰星制造的白天，在整个白天时间内加成效果始终是最大值。
abilities.description_en: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.

scepter_loc.en: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.
scepter_loc.zh: 辰星破晓提供治疗增强，数值等于当前攻击力提升。

abilities.name: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并治疗友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并眩晕敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
notes_zh: 脉冲间隔为%pulse_interval%秒。
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。
notes_en: Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.

scepter_loc.en: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
scepter_loc.zh: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随%scepter_aura_duration%秒。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_dawnbreaker_celestial_hammer_targets_allies
talents_raw.name_loc: Celestial Hammer Trail Grants Movement Speed to Allies
talents_raw.desc_loc: Bonus movement speed is equal to the movement slow

heroes.hero_summary_zh: 玛西证明了永恒的忠诚会带来无与伦比的力量，她进入战场时早已准备好高举拳头来捍卫她的伙伴们。她能轻松地抛起战场周围的敌友，也很乐意跃入任何战斗，为友军带来致命的优势，还能释放出潜藏的力量，就连神明也要重新考虑与她作对是否明智。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Proving that undying loyalty yields unrivaled power, Marci always marches into battle ready to raise fists in defense of her companions. Effortlessly flinging friends and foes around the battlefield, she happily bounds into any brawl, able to grant allies a deadly edge and unleash a hidden power strong enough to make even gods reconsider the wisdom of a hostile path.

abilities.name: marci_grapple
abilities.description_zh: 玛西抓起一个友方或敌方目标，将其轻松地向她身后摔去，敌方目标将受到伤害并被减速。落地区域内所有敌方单位也会受到伤害并被减速。
abilities.description_en: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.

abilities.name: marci_companion_run
abilities.description_zh:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

回身踢设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得%ally_movespeed_pct%%%移动速度加成，持续%ally_buff_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives %ally_movespeed_pct%%% bonus movement speed for %ally_buff_duration%s.
notes_zh: 玛西冲刺时目标单位可以躲避该效果。
不会触发法术反弹。
多样施法时不会带走被缠绕或束缚的友军。
notes_en: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.

shard_loc.en: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.
shard_loc.zh: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。

facet_text_en:
When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination. The ally deals %ally_impact_damage_pct%%% of the Rebound damage to the enemies around it's destination.

 Will not apply to Rooted or Leashed allies.

If Marci has Unleash leveled, after landing from Rebound, Marci gains a %postjump_flurry_charges% strike Fury combo. If Unleash is already active, its duration is instead extended by %postjump_unleash_duration%s.

 If upgraded by Aghanim's Scepter, the resulting Unleashed pulse will not silence enemies.
facet_text_zh:
回身踢设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标）时，玛西会把目标友军带向她的最终目的地。友军落地时对敌人造成%ally_impact_damage_pct%%%回身踢伤害。

不会影响被缠绕或束缚的友军。

如果玛西已升级怒拳破，回身踢落地后玛西会获得一次%postjump_flurry_charges%拳的狂怒连技。如果怒拳破已经开启，则改为持续时间延长%postjump_unleash_duration%秒。

如果拥有阿哈利姆神杖，本次狂怒连技的脉冲效果不会沉默敌人。

abilities.name: marci_bodyguard
abilities.description_zh:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的%max_partner_penalty%%%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的全伤害护盾。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的%shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%%会补充护盾。
abilities.description_en:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with %max_partner_penalty%%% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, %shared_barrier_replenish_amount%%% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
notes_zh: 玛西无法对自身施放护卫术。
吸血效果对非英雄单位减少%creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%%。
不论是玛西或她的搭档受到伤害都会使共用护盾的数值减少。
notes_en: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a %creep_lifesteal_reduction_pct%%% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.
facet_text_en: While bodyguarded, Marci and her partner share %shared_healing_percent%%% of health healed by this ability with each other.
facet_text_zh: 在护卫术效果下玛西和她的搭档会共享本技能%shared_healing_percent%%%的生命治疗量。

abilities.name: marci_special_delivery
abilities.description_zh: 玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。所有友方信使被动获得%bonus_levels%级额外等级和%bonus_hp_tooltip%点额外生命。
abilities.description_en: Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.Passively grants all allied couriers %bonus_levels% bonus levels and %bonus_hp_tooltip% bonus health.
notes_zh: 特快专递的口哨具有%abilitycastpoint%秒施法前摇。
如果信使施放后没有移交任何物品，或还拥有物品，它都会停留在玛西身边。
notes_en: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

abilities.name: marci_unleash
abilities.description_zh:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续%pulse_debuff_duration%秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续%time_between_flurries%秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升%bonus_movespeed%%%。
abilities.description_en:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for %pulse_debuff_duration%s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for %time_between_flurries%s.

Marci gains %bonus_movespeed%%% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
notes_zh: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
移除攻击速度限制。
notes_en: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.

scepter_loc.en: Reduces Unleash cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction% seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for %pulse_silence_duration% seconds.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
scepter_loc.zh: 怒拳破的冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction%秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续%pulse_silence_duration%秒。驱散类型：弱驱散

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_marci_unleash_extend_duration
talents_raw.name_loc: Unleash Duration Extended By {s:bonus_extend_duration}s On Kill

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 在敌友之间野蛮冲撞，獸如同天性闹腾一般奔入战场。在何种战斗中獸都是无法回避的威胁，他可以惩戒攻击者，喜欢抓起猎物反复向地面捶击，直到战场只剩下肉泥。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Rushing savagely through enemies and allies alike, Primal Beast pounds into battle as one born to raise a ruckus. An unavoidable threat amidst any fray, the Beast can punish attackers and relishes grabbing prey to repeatedly slam them against the ground until nothing but mush remains.

abilities.name: primal_beast_onslaught
abilities.description_zh:
獸积蓄力量再向选定方向冲去，将敌人和队友同时击退。敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被眩晕。蓄力时间越长，獸冲的距离越远。

可以随时使用停止指令来中止。
abilities.description_en:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.

abilities.name: primal_beast_trample
abilities.description_zh: 獸践踏一切。每行进%step_distance%距离就会对獸附近范围内所有敌人造成伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上獸攻击力的一定系数。獸在技能期间被缴械。
abilities.description_en: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every %step_distance% units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.
facet_text_en: Trample grants bonus movement speed to Primal Beast and his allies when activated.
facet_text_zh: 踏启动后会使獸和他的友军获得移动速度加成。

abilities.name: primal_beast_uproar
abilities.description_zh:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过%damage_limit%点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续%roar_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of %damage_limit% hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for %roar_duration% seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
notes_zh: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
notes_en: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.

scepter_loc.en: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases %projectile_waves% waves of %projectiles_per_stack% projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.
scepter_loc.zh: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出%projectile_waves%波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有%projectiles_per_stack%个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。

abilities.name: primal_beast_rock_throw
abilities.description_zh: 獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。
abilities.description_en: Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location. Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.

abilities.name: primal_beast_pulverize
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂眩晕。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续%channel_time%秒。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.

abilities.name: primal_beast_colossal
abilities.description_zh: 獸拥有%base_slow_resist%%%基础减速抗性，每拥有%hp_per_threshold%点生命上限就获得+%aoe_per_threshold%%%作用范围加成和+%slow_resistance_per_threshold%%%减速抗性。
abilities.description_en: Primal Beast has %base_slow_resist%%% base Slow Resistance and gains %aoe_per_threshold%%% bonus Area of Effect and %slow_resistance_per_threshold%%% Slow Resistance for every %hp_per_threshold% Max Health.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 琼英碧灵漫步于生者的土地，主宰着死亡，她利用骇人的花式枪弹和召唤的亡魂困住目标，将敌人完全扼杀。她总是准备好用手上备用的枪来解决大意的目标，当她穿越生死之界，用恶灵的超凡愤怒打击敌人，那就是她凶相毕露之时。
heroes.hero_summary_en: Muerta is a master of death who stalks the lands of life, corralling targets with fearsome trickshots and summoning revenants to smother her foes. Always ready to pick off unwary targets with her spare gunhand, Muerta is at her most menacing when she crosses the veil of the dead to strike her enemies with the ethereal fury of the damned.

abilities.name: muerta_dead_shot
abilities.description_zh: 琼英碧灵向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时会对敌人造成伤害和短暂减速，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧。
abilities.description_en: Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
notes_zh: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的%ricochet_distance_multiplier%倍。
可以弹离减益免疫目标。
notes_en: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel %ricochet_distance_multiplier%x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.

scepter_loc.en: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.
scepter_loc.zh: 弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。

facet_text_en: Dead Shot fears increase Gunslinger chance to %gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%x for %gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%s.
facet_text_zh: 弹无虚发恐惧敌人后，神枪在手的触发几率提升至基础几率的%gunslinger_buffed_chance_multiplier%倍，持续%gunslinger_buffed_chance_duration%秒。

abilities.name: muerta_the_calling
abilities.description_zh: 召唤%num_revenants%个亡魂，缓慢地环绕目标地点。在区域内的敌人会被减速。亡魂会在敌人穿过时造成伤害和沉默。
abilities.description_en: Summons a group of %num_revenants% revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.
facet_text_en: Heroes killed inside The Calling refresh its duration, create another Revenant, and expand the radius of The Calling by %kill_radius_expansion%.
facet_text_zh: 唤魂内有敌方英雄阵亡会刷新持续时间，再产生一个亡魂，并且唤魂的作用范围扩大%kill_radius_expansion%。

abilities.name: muerta_gunslinger
abilities.description_zh: 可以开关。开启后，琼英碧灵攻击时有几率对另一个目标再射一枪。
abilities.description_en: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
notes_zh: 如果距离内没有其他单位，她会向原目标发射两枪。
第二枪可以击中琼英碧灵攻击距离加上%target_search_bonus_range%范围内的单位。
第二枪可以触发攻击特效。
以英雄优先，然后是非英雄单位，然后是建筑。
notes_en: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus %target_search_bonus_range%.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.
facet_text_en: Gunslinger procs reduce Dead Shot cooldown by %dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%s.
facet_text_zh: 神枪在手触发时，弹无虚发的剩余冷却时间减少%dead_shot_cooldown_reduction_on_proc%秒。

abilities.name: muerta_spectral_slug
abilities.description_zh: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续%duration%秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加%bonus_spell_damage_pct%%%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。
abilities.description_en: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for %duration%s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and %bonus_spell_damage_pct%%% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.

abilities.name: muerta_pierce_the_veil
abilities.description_zh: 琼英碧灵变身，成为虚无状态，获得基础攻击力加成和相位移动状态。被动使总是可以攻击虚无状态下的目标，并且她在虚无状态下也能攻击。在她或目标处于虚无时，她的所有攻击伤害均为魔法伤害，她的物理吸血被视为技能吸血。驱散类型：弱驱散
abilities.description_en: Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 琼英碧灵在变身期间可以躲避弹道。
琼英碧灵在变身后无法攻击建筑。
notes_en: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.

shard_loc.en: Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.
shard_loc.zh: 琼英碧灵在越界的持续时间内获得%spell_lifesteal%%%技能吸血。越界生效时每次击杀敌方英雄或有敌方英雄在附近阵亡时琼英碧灵都会永久获得%spell_amp_steal%%%技能增强。永久加成具有追溯效果。

abilities.name: muerta_supernatural
abilities.description_zh: 每当琼英碧灵附近%stack_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，她就会获得一层%spell_amp_per_stack%%%技能增强的叠加效果。琼英碧灵阵亡时，她会失去一半（向下取整）的叠加层数。
abilities.description_en: Whenever an enemy hero dies within %stack_collection_range% units of Muerta, she gains a stack of %spell_amp_per_stack%%% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_muerta_calling_hp_regen
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_hp_regen_pct}% Max HP Regen while inside The Calling
talents_raw.desc_loc: Only applies to Muerta.

When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.

heroes.role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
heroes.hero_summary_zh: 整个战场就是一个舞台，而百戏大王正是欢腾的导演。百戏大王利用表演家的架势操控战斗，手中可怕的长鞭和无尽的飞刀可以驯服敌人，狡猾的逃脱表演能将盟友带离危险 ，而且他总能勉强观众去观看迷人的奇观转轮。
heroes.hero_summary_en: All the battlefield's a stage, and Ringmaster is a gleeful director. Controlling fights with a showman's flair, Ringmaster tames enemies with his fearsome whip and endless knives, ushers allies away from danger with his cunning escape act, and always draws a crowd to unwillingly witness the wonders of his mesmerizing wheel.

abilities.name: ringmaster_tame_the_beasts
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 百戏大王卷起他的鞭子，最多持续%abilitychanneltime%秒，然后猛甩出去。被鞭打的敌人会受到伤害，并且被恐惧，逃离百戏大王。持续施法时间会使伤害和恐惧时间成倍增加，但是作用范围减少。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to %abilitychanneltime% second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.

abilities.name: ringmaster_the_box
abilities.description_zh: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.

scepter_loc.en: Escape Act has %max_charges% charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.
scepter_loc.zh: 逃生技拥有%max_charges%点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

abilities.name: ringmaster_impalement
abilities.description_zh: 百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

abilities.name: ringmaster_spotlight
abilities.description_zh: 百戏大王用%spotlight_count%束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞%linger_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster shines %spotlight_count% spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for %linger_duration% seconds after leaving the light.

abilities.name: ringmaster_wheel
abilities.description_zh: 百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速%aura_slow%%%。敌方英雄面对转轮超过%face_duration%秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在%trap_duration%秒后转轮会自动爆炸。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by %aura_slow%%%.Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than %face_duration% seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after %trap_duration% seconds.

abilities.name: ringmaster_dark_carnival_souvenirs
abilities.description_zh: 只要百戏大王附近%souvenir_collection_range%范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。
abilities.description_en: Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within %souvenir_collection_range% units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.
facet_text_en: Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Funhouse Mirror, Strongman Tonic, and Whoopee Cushion.
Ringmaster's Souvenirs are Crystal Ball, Unicycle, and Weighted Pie.
facet_text_zh: 百戏大王的纪念品是哈哈镜，强力水和整蛊垫。
百戏大王的纪念品是水晶球，独轮车和超重派。

abilities.name: ringmaster_funhouse_mirror
abilities.description_zh: 使用：比例失真制造英雄的%images_count%个不完美幻象，持续%illusion_duration%秒。幻象继承%tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%攻击力，承受%tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en: Use: Proportion DistortionCreates %images_count% imperfect image of your hero that lasts %illusion_duration% seconds. Your illusion deals %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%% and takes  %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.
notes_zh: 有%invuln_duration%秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。
notes_en: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

abilities.name: ringmaster_strongman_tonic
abilities.description_zh: 使用：强力吸收暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为%strength_bonus_base% + %strength_bonus_per_level% * 百戏大王等级，持续%duration%秒。效果会维持%effect_strength_max_duration%秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。
abilities.description_en: Use: Forcefully ImbibeTemporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by %strength_bonus_base% plus %strength_bonus_per_level% per Ringmaster's level for %duration% seconds. The effect holds for %effect_strength_max_duration% seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

abilities.name: ringmaster_whoopee_cushion
abilities.description_zh: 使用：噗把英雄向前推动%leap_distance%距离。在身后留下一团%fart_cloud_radius%范围的臭云，持续%fart_cloud_duration%秒，使敌人减速%fart_cloud_slow%%%。
abilities.description_en: Use: WhoopsiePropels your hero forward %leap_distance% units. Leaves a %fart_cloud_radius% radius stink cloud behind for %fart_cloud_duration% seconds that slows enemies by %fart_cloud_slow%%%.

abilities.name: ringmaster_summon_unicycle
abilities.description_zh: 使用：上车召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续%mount_duration%秒。上车%damage_grace_period%秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过%damage_threshold%点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。
abilities.description_en: Use: Saddle UpSummons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for %mount_duration% seconds. %damage_grace_period%s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than %damage_threshold% dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_whip_debuff_immunity
talents_raw.name_loc: Debuff Immunity While Channeling Tame the Beasts
talents_raw.desc_loc: Also grants {s:bonus_magic_resist}% magic resistance.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_dagger_bleed_and_slow_duration
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_bleed_duration}s Impalement Arts Bleed and Slow Duration

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_wheel_radius
talents_raw.name_loc: +{s:bonus_mesmerize_radius} Wheel of Wonder Radius and Range

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_ringmaster_the_box_strong_dispel_and_flying
talents_raw.name_loc: Escape Act Grants Strong Dispel and Flying
